name: Denny
description: The legal currency in New Eridu. Can be used to purchase various items.
secondaryDescription: While there are Denny notes available in larger denominations, many still prefer coins. After all, who doesn't love a hefty purse?

name: Polychrome
description: While each film captures only one single color, when layered together, they produce vibrant, multicolored images.
secondaryDescription: Colored images bring your memories back to life. Some buyers are willing to trade anything for such a rare find.

name: Monochrome
description: Commonly used in antique cameras, this photographic film will reveal an image after being developed.
secondaryDescription: Given its potential to have captured a picture of the old civilization before the Hollow disasters, it holds significant value for some collectors.

name: Master Tape
description: Required item for Signal Searches on Stable Channel.
secondaryDescription: This medium can be used to convert audio band signals into visual information. Video store operators may find master tapes to be the most suitable option for maintaining confidentiality.

name: Encrypted Master Tape
description: Required item for Signal Searches on Exclusive and W-Engine Channels.
secondaryDescription: This medium can be used to convert band signals of specific frequency into visual information, providing an increased level of encrypted security.

name: Boopon
description: Required item for Signal Searches on Bangboo Channel.
secondaryDescription: A coupon for the Bangboo repair and cleaning service issued by the Marcel Group. You can order Bangboo to provide various services for you with this coupon.

name: Residual Signal
description: Can be exchanged for valuable items in the Signal Shop.
secondaryDescription: During the signal search process, it is possible to capture Residual Signals that are too fragmented to be analyzed on their own. However, by recording and combining these Residual Signals, you may extract valuable information from them.

name: Bangbuck
description: Can be exchanged for valuable items in the Signal Shop.
secondaryDescription: Token issued by the Marcel Group. Can be used to purchase Bangboo-related accessories.

name: Fading Signal
description: Can be exchanged for valuable items in the Signal Shop.
secondaryDescription: When converting Signals, fragments of residual echoes are collected, resembling murmurs, making it difficult to distinguish their meanings. Even though recording and assembling them can be very difficult, if achievable, some additional information can still be extracted from them.

name: Z-Merits
description: Used for purchasing valuable items in Outpost Logistics
secondaryDescription: Among investigators, there's a lot of insider lingo, and "you can earn Z-Merits" is the most unique one. It could be a joke on rookies, a threat to juniors, admiration for seniors, or a curse on troublemakers... Because there's only one way to earn Z-Merits — participating in the investigation of Hollow Zero...

name: Investigation Merits
description: Used for purchasing valuable items in Association Supplies.
secondaryDescription: Hollows are practical disasters, and won't become any less dangerous due to your rank, social status, or wealth. Survival depends on skill (and luck). That's why the Hollow Investigative Association's investigator assessments are also practical. So long as you can complete a dangerous Investigation mission, you can obtain merits and with merits, you'll naturally be able to obtain rewards.

name: "Inspiration" Small Pack
description: Can be exchanged for decorations at the Sān-Z STUDIO.
secondaryDescription: Yi's Studio doesn't charge Dennies. If you want to take his creations, you'll need to offer something interesting in return... like a small pinch of "inspiration" picked up from life?

name: Red Bean Bun Token
description:
Obtain from the limited-time event "Moonlight Traces."
Used to redeem special rewards in the event.
secondaryDescription: Red bean bags are the best daily commute companions!

name: Duel Arena Token
description:
Obtain from the limited-time event "The Champion."
Used to redeem special rewards in the event.
secondaryDescription: Under the victor's crown lie endless scars.

name: Memory Shard
description:
Obtain from the limited-time event "Windchaser Harumasa."
Used to redeem special rewards in the event.
secondaryDescription: That is the scar after the wound healed, it is the badge of all his past experiences.

name: Popularity Carrot
description: "Grand Marcel Adventure" Competition Reward
secondaryDescription: Someone once asked Joyous why he called the Hollow route data "Carrot." He replied, "Why not ask that woman why she made those machines look like rabbits?"

name: Video Game Festival Coupon
description: A limited-time voucher obtained in the "Godfinger Ultimate Showdown" event. Can be used to exchange for rewards during the event.
secondaryDescription: Stacking up a ton of coupons doesn't always mean you're a gaming pro, but it sure shows how little sleep you got during the "Urban Video Game Festival."

name: Used Battery
description: Obtained after consuming any amount of Battery Charge for the first time each day during the 141 Eco-Art Exhibition event. Used to exchange for rewards at Sjal's booth in Failume Heights.
secondaryDescription: To implement the environmental protection campaign, Buy, Ask, and Give Change's average daily step count has exceeded thirty thousand — please take out your used batteries and help save these Bangboo!

name: Astra Yao's Event Token
description: Earned by participating in the limited-time event [OVA Event]. Can be used to redeem special rewards during the event.
secondaryDescription: Astra Yao's Event Token Story Description

name: Ellen's Event Token
description: Earned by participating in the limited-time event [Character Storyline Event]. Can be used to redeem special rewards during the event.
secondaryDescription: Ellen's Event Token Story Description

name: Popularity Carrot
description: "Grand Marcel Adventure" Competition Reward
secondaryDescription: Someone once asked Joyous why he called the Hollow route data "Carrot." He replied, "Why not ask that woman why she made those machines look like rabbits?"

name: Cloud Crest
description: General Commemorative Coins, can be used for Suibian Temple repairs and upgrades.
secondaryDescription: Let's revive Suibian Temple in style! Minting coins with the temple's emblem is one of our strategies to boost its presence during the restoration.

name: Omnicoin
description: Tokens exclusively circulated at Devon Pawnshop. Can be used to redeem rewards.
secondaryDescription: "Master of the land and skies, expert in daily necessities" is merely a sweet fantasy of those who deal in currency.

name: Wishletter
description: Souvenir from praying at Suibian Temple.
secondaryDescription: The delicate crepe paper cradles patterns painted with vermilion, each crease holding unspoken wishes. The moment they are released from one's fingertips, those unvoiced prayers transform into threads of light as they ascend, casting gentle shadows through the clouds — like silken cords descending from the heavens, waiting to bind earthly warmth to the highest skies.

name: Seashell
description: Obtained after consuming any amount of Battery Charge for the first time each day. It can be exchanged at A-Qiang's stall for random fishing catches and corresponding rewards.
secondaryDescription: The Investigation Association's uniquely shaped commemorative badges, known for their elegant form and realistic design, have become a hit among seaside tourists. In response, fish stall owner A-Qiang remarks: "Nobody can resist shiny shells... Plus, these ones smell way better than the real deal!"

name: Wish Bottle
description: Obtain upon first daily login or after consuming any Battery Charge: Can be used in the "Wish Bottle Adrift" event. Write down your wishes and throw the wish bottles into the sea to receive corresponding rewards.
secondaryDescription:
A glass bottle with a cork stopper - ordinary in every way, no matter how you look at it. But the Bangboo, who calls itself the "Scion of the Great Sea God," loudly declares:
"This bottle holds divine power! Throw it, and the gods will bless you!"

name: Contribution Points
description: Used to buy various items in "Points Exchange"
secondaryDescription:
Just like carrots come in all sizes, Proxies come in all types. Whether posting or accepting commissions, any contribution to Inter-Knot's reputation will earn you respect from your peers.
And then... take a trip to "Points Exchange" to see how your fellow Proxies' respect translates into real rewards.

name: Commemorative Ticket Stub
description: "Filmgoer Thank-You Gift" event item. During the event, obtain through purchasing Monochrome, New Eridu City Fund, Dawn Seeker's Ticket, select Bundles, Inter-Knot Membership, etc.
secondaryDescription: A gleaming, golden ticket stub — and a token of time itself. With our eager excitement, we traded for a dream worth cherishing; and as the lights flickered and flowed, we walked into a life that never belonged to us.

name: Wish Bottle
description: Obtained upon first daily login or after consuming any Battery Charge. Can be used in the "Wish Filing Station" event.
secondaryDescription: The Cunning Hares, known for their cost-cutting efficiency, somehow got their hands on these surprisingly sturdy bottles from who knows where. Wishes sealed inside could wander the seas for a very, very long time without being worn away by time.

name: Little Golden Carp
description: Once you've collected enough, you can redeem them for exclusive holiday gifts.
secondaryDescription: If carp fish are the embodiment of good fortune in Waifei Peninsula, then golden carp represent an extra dose of luck. Bring some winter sunshine and good vibes to welcome this dazzling messenger of fortune!

name: Stamp Seal
description: A special item custom-made by the HIA Club for this event. Can be exchanged for a card flip opportunity.
secondaryDescription: Collect enough stamps and you can claim a prize — though your drawer's already packed with "souvenirs" from way too many of these expired events. But this time... maybe you'll actually be able to cash in for something?

name: Golden Soda Bottle Cap
description: Obtained after consuming any amount of Battery Charge for the first time each day. Visit the Bangboo Merch stall and open a surprise box to receive the corresponding rewards.
secondaryDescription: A limited-edition soda cap from some boutique beverage brand. Bangboo go crazy over its golden look, but it's really just another ordinary product for the industry.

name: Wish Letter
description: Obtained upon your first daily login or after consuming any Battery Charge. Can be used in the "Ding Dong! Trainee Postie on Delivery" event — drop it in a mailbox to claim your rewards.
secondaryDescription:
Write every unfinished Dream, every unspoken Worship, into this letter…
Then let it drift on the Wind, toward the other side of hope.

name: Investigation Credential
description: Redeem valuable items like Focus Moments and more in the "Association Supplies - Blasting Showcase" store.
secondaryDescription: —A souvenir reserved for the brave.

name: Inter-Knot Credit
description: Virtual credit used on Inter-Knot. Your Inter-Knot Level will increase with enough Credit.
secondaryDescription: "In the world of Proxies, reputation is more precious than Dennies. Because without it, the means of earning Dennies are vastly limited..."

name: Daily Performance
description: Can be exchanged for valuable items in the Potential Archive store, primarily obtained through Ridu Weekly.
secondaryDescription: The everyday isn't a dull routine — it''s a sea of ideas quietly gathering change. In those tiny miracles we repeat day after day, maybe there's a spark of power waiting to unlock our "potential."

name: Special Invitation Letter
description: When an S-Rank Agent's Mindscape reaches the max level, you will receive 1 "Special Invitation Letter" when obtaining that Agent again, which can be exchanged for valuable items in the "Collectible Exchange" Store under "Agent Exchange".
secondaryDescription: A high-tech invitation card. What kind of magic does this tiny screen possess to make so many exceptional Agents eagerly accept? —More often than not, the name "Phaethon" inspires far more trust than Dennies.

name: W-Engine Microcontroller Unit
description: An item that can be exchanged for valuable items in the "Collectible Exchange" Store under "W-Engine Exchange."
secondaryDescription: A pristine W-Engine Microcontroller Unit with virtually no signs of use — perfect for crafting higher precision, more effective W-Engines. These units are rare, expensive, and highly specialized. Keep it out of sight to avoid getting reported.

name: Season EXP
description: Season EXP that boosts your Season Level. Resets each cycle.

name: Outpost Trust
description: Used to increase Permission Level, obtainable by completing commissions from other Proxies.
secondaryDescription: Leveling up your Permission Level unlocks new titles and adds more items to the Points Exchange shop.

name: W-Engine Chip
description: Used to craft W-Engines at the gadget store.
secondaryDescription: When you dismantle W-Engines, it's possible to preserve their core rotors if you handle them properly. These chips can then be used to craft new W-Engines or... simply kept as collectibles.

name: Doggy Voucher
description: A voucher obtained in the Soul Hounds III special event. Can exchange for rewards at the Godfinger Arcade.
secondaryDescription: When you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss gazes also into you.

name: Snaky Voucher
description: A voucher obtained in the Snake Duel special event. Can exchange for rewards at the Godfinger Arcade.
secondaryDescription: Anything in my way will become my food!

name: HIA Commemorative Marble
description: Exchange rewards in the Exchange Store of the Mr. Hello's Savior event.
secondaryDescription: Issued by Mr. Hello, these commemorative marbles bear witness to investigators' efforts in driving forth the Association's mission, and can be exchanged for rewards. You can almost hear Mr. Hello saying "My favorite investigator!" if you stare long enough at the design.

name: Lost Supply Box
description: A very sturdy storage chest. It looks quite valuable.
secondaryDescription: There seems to be an unfamiliar company logo on the corner of the chest. From the make and quality, this appears to be for military use. Though it's covered in dust, there are no signs of Ether corruption.

name: Engagement Record Points
description: Points earned from completing the "Back in Business" activity accumulate, and upon reaching a certain amount or activity milestones, you can claim the corresponding rewards.
secondaryDescription: A small note documenting every work accomplishment after the reopening of the video store and Proxy's business. It encapsulates the excitement of witnessing everything unfold alongside your closest kin.

name: Revenue
description: The revenue from the diner can be used to invest
secondaryDescription: You can obtain a certain amount of revenue upon clearing a management challenge. The higher the ratings of customers, the greater the revenue obtained

name: Management Insights
description: Insight that is required in order to invest in new decor
secondaryDescription: Obtained via <color=#FFAF2C>event Side Commissions</color>. Head to Tasks to check related Commissions.

name: Engagement Record Points
description: Points earned from completing the "Back in Business" activity. Upon accumulating a certain amount and reaching milestones, you can claim the corresponding rewards.
secondaryDescription: A small note documenting every work accomplishment after the reopening of the video store and Proxy business. It encapsulates the excitement of witnessing everything unfold alongside your closest kin.

name: Orchidea's Letter
description: A token from the florist. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
secondaryDescription: Caring for fresh flowers is time-consuming and labor-intensive, which might be too much for the Convenience Store Bangboo to handle... The meticulous Miss Orchidea has prepared some potted plants for the customers at "141" to choose from.

name: Coco's Letter
description: A token from the teamilk store. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
secondaryDescription: "141" Convenience Store x Richard Teamilk Collaboration — Enjoy the Rich Flavor Anytime, Anywhere!

name: Beaverson's Letter
description: A token from the salon. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
secondaryDescription: Exclusive Care Set, brought to you by the salon with the longest wait times at Lumina Square — nourish your hair with precision. Now, no appointment is needed. Enjoy the luxury at home!

name: Chop Junior's Letter
description: A token from the noodle shop. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
secondaryDescription: The young noodle shop owner made a decision that went against his father's wishes... But did General Chop really know nothing, or did he silently approve of his child's attempt?

name: Duyi's Letter
description: A token from the massage parlor. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
secondaryDescription: The portable massager developed by Old Duyi offers a total of 10 massage angles and 5 levels of air pressure, providing an ideal relaxation experience for all residents of the city.

name: Stellar Trek's Letter
description: A token from the clothing store. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
secondaryDescription: Trek Leisurely Among the Stars!

name: Simmer's Letter
description: A token from the hot pot restaurant. Give it to Sjal during the 141 Friendship Fair event in exchange for rewards.
secondaryDescription: The new spicy dishes from Simmer are made from the same ingredients as the soup base in the store! However, whether it is suitable for "141" to introduce... I'm afraid someone needs to be brave enough to try it.

name: Field Experience
description: Used to increase Investigation Level which in turn gives Combat Permits.
secondaryDescription: A document used to keep a written record of Field Experience. Words may seem powerless, but they can stand as proof of strength.

name: Supply Voucher
description: For redeeming rewards in Combat Supply.
secondaryDescription: Even if the Void Hunter herself shows up, as long as New Eridu isn't on the verge of destruction, no extra supplies can be taken from Logistics without a Supply Voucher.

name: Assessment Score
description: Congratulations on leading the Bangboo to victory over the Ethereals! Although this happened in the VR exam field, the test score already shows — you're an outstanding combat assistant!

name: Combat Permit
description: Enhances Agents' combat capabilities in Gear Deployment.
secondaryDescription: Unchecked force will surely invite disaster, particularly with powers that have the potential to bring great harm. Only with this permit may one train freely in lands beset by calamity.

name: Angler Points
description: You can earn rewards by participating in the Elpis Ultimate Angler Championship, completing Port Anecdotes, or updating the Fishing Encyclopedia.
secondaryDescription: Ridu Fishing Association has set up Fishing Permit Points. Accumulating points can increase your permit level and unlock various rewards.

name: Fantasy Capsule
description: A capsule filled with crystals formed from condensed dream energy and carefully stored in a protective shell. It serves as a potent medicine to cross into fantasy.
secondaryDescription: Fantasy: The floating fantasy, the overflowing fantasy, the fantasy that refracts itself like a crystal. When fantasy gradually expands, will you get lost in its jungle, or will you instead gain the courage to transcend reality?

name: Flower Shop Revenue
description: Revenue earned during the flower shop's operation. It turns out that the temporary manager of Dew Gardening Shop has quite the talent for both "floristry" and "business"!

name: Movie Points
description: Watch movies at Gravity Cinema to earn points that can be used to upgrade your Gravity VIP membership card.
secondaryDescription: "If heaven really exists, it probably looks like a movie theater."

name: Angler Commemorative Coin
description: Penguinboo Empy from Fantasy Resort is a master Bangboo fisher at Port Elpis, and he's well acquainted with the old-timers at the Port Elpis Fishing Association.
secondaryDescription: With Empy acting as go-between, the Fishing Association has agreed that the Bangboo would be able to buy more advanced fishing gear, aquarium decorations, and various other items at discounted prices as long as they sell their catches to the association. To facilitate the transactions further, the association has even specially created a unique currency for the Bangboo — the Angler Commemorative Coin.

name: Visitor Traffic
description: A ticket with Fantasy Resort guest information on it.
secondaryDescription: On one hand, the staff can offer personalized service to each guest using the information above. On the other hand, the growing number of tickets is also a sign of the resort's rising popularity.

name: Dream Data
description: Data shards that can increase the stability value of simulated dreams.
secondaryDescription: The HIA research team discovered the key to brain wave decoding and image synchronization lies in collecting complete high-frequency data. On this basis, psychological intervention can then be used to enhance a patient's mental stability.

name: Dusty Old Coin
description: Dust-covered Porcelume coins that can be taken to the shopkeeper at Buyan for a reward.
secondaryDescription: Wealth once forged from radiance now lies buried under the dust of time.

name: Mystery Points
description: Used to raise your Mystery Level and trade for rewards at the Buyan store.
secondaryDescription: Records the stories and achievements you've gathered along your journey of discovery.

name: Sword Mastery
description: Enhancement item obtained through combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving in the Qingming Realm.
secondaryDescription: A note recording experience gained in real combat. While it may seem like trivial details, accumulating these over time can lead to mastering powerful sword techniques.

name: Sword Will Essence
description: Advanced enhancement item obtained by challenging powerful foes, completing explorations, and solving puzzles in the Qingming Realm.
secondaryDescription: A fragment of an ancient tome containing the accumulated insights of countless swordmasters — a treasure found only within the hidden realm, and capable of greatly advancing the Sword Keeper's abilities.

name: Sword Mastery
description: Enhancement item obtained through combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving in the Qingming Realm.
secondaryDescription: A note recording experience gained in real combat. While it may seem like trivial details, accumulating these over time can lead to mastering powerful sword techniques.

name: Sword Will Essence
description: Advanced enhancement item obtained by challenging powerful foes, completing explorations, and solving puzzles in the Qingming Realm.
secondaryDescription: A fragment of an ancient tome containing the accumulated insights of countless swordmasters — a treasure found only within the hidden realm, and capable of greatly advancing the Sword Keeper's abilities.

name: Victory Points
description:
Used to measure each contestant's performance in the "En-Nah" Chess Legend event.
Accumulate Victory Points to reach specified milestones and unlock fantastics surprise rewards!

name: Survey Data
description: Exploration route data gathered in the Papago Hollow. Accumulate a certain amount to increase Proxy's Exploration Level.
secondaryDescription: If guiding people within the Hollow is the most important part of a Proxy's job, then the path data would be the most important information in the Hollow. Just as cooking requires ingredients, path data is the crux of Hollow navigation.

name: Mini Cargo Truck
description: After opening a Mini Cargo Truck, you have a chance to obtain Gear, Resonium or emotes.
secondaryDescription:
The Mini Cargo Truck: Your sturdiest safety net. A general logistics vehicle used by the HIA to deliver all kinds of supplies to aid investigators in harvesting Ether resources. Some lost Mini Cargo Trucks will end up as a sweet bonus for Hollow Raiders looking around for loot.
If you see a lost Mini Cargo Truck, please use whatever is inside as you see fit... It's not like they'll fight back.

name: Star Point
description: Accumulate Star Points to boost Star Progress and increase the popularity of the Angels of Delusion Official Account.
secondaryDescription:
Shimmering, sparkling, dazzling...
Starting now, rack up those Star Points and kick off your wish-granting journey with the Angels of Delusion!

name: Lucky: Wish Come True Boo
description: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Lucky" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 1.
secondaryDescription:
"Every Denny should bring its friends to me, so I can have lots of Dennies to buy batteries!"
—The mumbled sleep-talk of a certain little Bangboo.

name: Lucky: Dragon & Pheonix Dance Boo
description: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Lucky" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 1.
secondaryDescription:
"Every day! Happy! Everything! Goes great! I'm a happy little lion!"
—The excited ehn-ne sounds from a Bangboo bobbing its head during the lion dance.

name: Lucky: Skyward Soar Boo
description: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Lucky" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 1.
secondaryDescription:
"Light up the sky with pretty fireworks, and luck will fall down like snow, right?"
—The careful ehn-ne sounds from a Bangboo cautiously lighting fireworks.

name: Gilded: Back-to-Back Luck Boo
description: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Gilded" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 2.
secondaryDescription:
"Surprise~! I hope you get little surprises like this every day!"
—The sudden ehn-ne sounds from a Bangboo suddenly popping out of a gift box.

name: Gilded: Riches and Good Fortune Boo
description: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Gilded" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 2.
secondaryDescription:
「One for you, and one for you... don't worry, everyone gets their share of good fortune on Gilded Carrot Day~」
——The diligent ehn-ne sounds of a Bangboo helping its owner hand out lucky money.

name: Gilded: Rolling in Riches Boo
description: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Gilded" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 2.
secondaryDescription:
"You want my gold ingots? Come and get 'em then. I'll be waiting for you deep in the Hollow!"
—The triumphant en-nah sounds of a Bangboo proudly clutching gold ingots.

name: Gilded: Blessings Come Knocking Boo
description: A single Bangboo Badge from the "Gilded" series, obtained from the "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns" Event Phase 2.
secondaryDescription:
"The light from this lantern is so warm and cozy... feels like it could light up the whole New Year!"
—The lively ehn-ne sounds of a Bangboo hopping around while holding a lantern.

name: "Gilded Fortune" Series Bangboo Badge
description: Event-exclusive Bangboo badges for "Gilded Surprise, Wonderful Boo-ns," featuring both the "Lucky" and "Gilded" series. These badges were a total hit thanks to their festive vibes.
secondaryDescription: No one knows what surprise awaits until the box is opened. Heart pounding with anticipation and festive dreams, step forward and embrace the golden glow of good fortune!

name: ActivityBangkov_Coin_Name
description: Internal currency used within the Marcel Group.
secondaryDescription: Only valid at the Employee Exclusive Store.

name: Interboo Coins
description: The digital currency of Interboo. Can be used to level up your Interboo account.
secondaryDescription: Whether in the real world or the virtual one, bottle caps are always the hard currency of Roscaelifer's Bangboo.

name: Marcel Storage Coupon
description: Upon obtaining, increases exclusive Storage capacity in "Operation: Save Bootopia" by +1
secondaryDescription: A storage redemption coupon provided by Marcel Group, printed with different months and the corresponding Bangboo ambassador. Distributed as a monthly employee benefit, it grants free storage space for internal circulation only (valid for the current month only).

name: Gear Coins
description: Common Currency in Labyrinth Zone
secondaryDescription: N/A

name: Lucky Bottle Cap
description: Collect all the rare bottle caps redeemable with data cards from Roarin' Brekkies and toss them into the Fountain of the Bottle Cap Fairy to make a wish.
secondaryDescription: A bottle cap recognized by the Bangboo of Roscaelifer as the "most precious" of all. Rumor has it this cap possesses the conceptual power to make wishes come true... though that's only a rumor.

name: Decor Shop Revenue
description: Item_Summer_TideTreasure_Desc
secondaryDescription: Item_Summer_TideTreasure_Story

name: Season Token
description: Season Token in Labyrinth Zone
secondaryDescription: N/A

name: Item_BMW_BottleBangbooZone
description: Item_BMW_BottleBangbooZone_Desc
secondaryDescription: Item_BMW_BottleBangbooZone_Story

name: Battery Charge
description: You can have up to 1,000 Battery Charge. When Battery Charge is lower than 240, recover 1 Battery Charge every 6 minutes.
secondaryDescription: The power source for Bangboo. Before going exploring in a Hollow, make sure that your Bangboo is sufficiently charged.

name: Ether Battery
description: Gain 60 Battery Charge when used. Can also be used for auto-combat in Combat Simulation or Area Patrol missions to instantly receive one mission reward.
secondaryDescription: A special battery designed for multiple Ether technology electronic gadgets, capable of supplying power for a small ether-powered vehicle to travel 20 meters or a Bangboo running frantically for 2 hours.

name: Backup Battery Charge
description:
Once Battery Charge reaches 240, recover 1 Backup Battery Charge every 18 minutes. You can have up to 2,400 Backup Battery Charge.
Consume Backup Battery Charge to gain an equal amount of Battery Charge.
secondaryDescription:
Battery Charge stored in a backup battery, ready for use whenever needed.
If Ether technology can be applied to produce batteries, their efficiency might be further improved. Luckily, this backup battery has a large capacity, turning Battery Charge into a valuable long-term asset.

name: Victoria Housekeeping Coupon
description: After use, you can directly receive the reward for a Area Patrol task.
secondaryDescription: Victoria Housekeeping Co. presents a special service voucher for our esteemed clients. Even the most difficult tasks — including "troublesome matters" within the Hollows — are no match for our skilled professionals.

name: Prepaid Power Card
description: Complete HDD commissions without meeting the usual first-clear requirements and earn the corresponding rewards. Can also be used for crafting Ether Batteries.
secondaryDescription: A prepaid power card commonly used in New Eridu. While commissioning Fairy for Hollow exploration will cause high HDD load, this card won't solve the skyrocketing power bills, but it'll save you from a heart attack when it arrives.

name: Camellia Golden Week Challenge Ticket
description: Camellia Golden Week Challenge Ticket

name: Investigation Point
description: Completing explorations of Hollow Zero earns you Investigation Points, which can be used to upgrade your Investigation License Level and get extra supplies.
secondaryDescription: Observation Data, Ether Samples, risk reports... Info and intel are critical for maintaining a Hollow investigation business, and for gauging an investigator's accomplishments.

name: Shadow Crystal Data
description: The analysis data of a special type of Ether crystal. It will increase your current investigation progress.
secondaryDescription: The analysis data of a special type of Ether crystal within Hollow Zero, allowing for further analysis of a specific frequency of Ether resonance.

name: Item_AbyssPoint_Name_703
description: Completing explorations of Hollow Zero earns you Investigation Points, which can be used to upgrade your Investigation License Level and get extra supplies.
secondaryDescription: Observation Data, Ether Samples, risk reports... Info and intel are critical for maintaining a Hollow investigation business, and for gauging an investigator's accomplishments.

name: "Deep Cleaning" Service Card
description: Allows the Proxy to quickly complete stages in Hollow Zero: Withered Domain and The Mystery of Arpeggio Fault and claim the corresponding rewards directly.
secondaryDescription: "Dear Master, Victoria Housekeeping Co.'s cleaning services have never been limited to just rooms."

name: Item_AbyssPoint_Name_705
description: Item_AbyssPoint_705_Des

name: Item_RoarinStore_Name_801
description: Item_RoarinStore_Desc_801
secondaryDescription: Item_RoarinStore_Story_801

name: Item_RoarinStore_Name_802
description: Item_RoarinStore_Desc_802
secondaryDescription: Item_RoarinStore_Story_802

description: Item_RoarinStore_Desc_803
secondaryDescription: Item_RoarinStore_Story_803

name: Item_RoarinStore_Name_804
description: Item_RoarinStore_Desc_804
secondaryDescription: Item_RoarinStore_Story_804

name: Item_RoarinStore_Name_805
description: Item_RoarinStore_Desc_805
secondaryDescription: Item_RoarinStore_Story_805

name: Anby
description: Use it to obtain the Agent or unlock the Agent's Mindscapes.
secondaryDescription:
Snapshots from Anby's daily life and from in combat, recording important moments before and after she became an Agent.
These images also provide insights into her fighting style and favorite weapons, helping to better understand her strengths.

Who knows why there are so many pics of hamburgers taking up storage space, all nicely edited and using filters...

name: Nekomata
description: Use it to obtain the Agent or unlock the Agent's Mindscapes.
secondaryDescription:

Wearing gloves smudged with engine oil and holding her ever-present wrench, the "Iron Witch" stays devoted to creating her mechanical potions, unwavering as ever.

name: Branch & Blade Song [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: "East he went, in his youth, encountering evil monkeys on the barren roads. A spring branch from a tree to serve as his blade, driving away the beasts that plagued the people."

name: Branch & Blade Song [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: "West he went, now mature, where the croaks of frogs occupy the walls. A single strike sends astonishment through the crowds, for what they once knew was merely the stars they could see from the bottom of a well."

name: Branch & Blade Song [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: "North he went, aging now, facing a dire wolf devouring the lands. With orange leaves grasping bloodied fangs, a perfect new blade he now has."

name: Branch & Blade Song [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: "South he went, elderly now, where swarms of locusts invade the fields. A guardian, he cleaves through with a single slash, giving hope of survival until the thaw."

name: Branch & Blade Song [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: "Home he goes, hair now white, with his feats told in every corner. Hoping for peace and quiet, he hides his blade, and meanders to the feast with the wandering crowd."

name: Branch & Blade Song [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: "Suddenly, he sees the guests of honor, the villainous monkeys he bested in the past, dressed in regal facades. Their cunning fangs and deceiving lips spin empty tales of miracles and false promises. He throws back his cloak with a wrinkled hand, and righteous anger flows. Stepping through the mud and into the courtyard, he breaks off a branch, becoming the youth he once was."

name: Astral Voice [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: "A symptom of staying in Hollows for too long, it's damaged your hearing." The doctor has given a strict warning that if I don't want to go deaf, I had better never go into a Hollow again. Welp... no can do. While my Proxy career is important, but having enough hearing to listen to Astra Yao's new song is more important.

name: Astral Voice [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: I couldn't help it, I ended up accepting a job where I had to go into a Hollow. Like expected, the doctor was mad when I came for another check-up. This time the doctor told me that my hearing wasn't normal for someone my age and if I didn't take care of myself, I'd end up completely deaf within two months... Alright, alright, looks like I'd really be better off switching jobs...

name: Astral Voice [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: Well, that's that, I've wrapped things up, told all my friends, and they all understand. Now to just get a normal job and live a normal life. Though, I do have ample time to go to Astra's concerts now. You lose some you gain some, I suppose.

name: Astral Voice [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: I met a group of super outgoing girls at Astra's album signing. Though we're pretty far apart in age, we have endless things to say when it comes to Astra. With them, I had the pleasure of experiencing the journey of a true fan chasing their idol and going all around the city. It was honestly kinda like back when I worked in Hollows... I even agreed to go check out their place sometime.

name: Astral Voice [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: Their apartment's pretty simple, but they have a lot of meaningful and even discontinued and limited posters and albums of Astra's. This certainly opened my eyes, even though I'd count myself an old fan. But... I do worry. To save money, the place they rented is way too close to a high sub-Hollow risk area.

name: Astral Voice [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: They've invited me to one of Astra's concerts as a thank-you for rescuing them from the Hollow. I happily agreed. We waved our hands, singing and dancing together in the packed concert hall... Even though... Even though my ears were filled with nothing but silence, I could hear that familiar voice every time Astra's lips moved as she sang.

name: Shadow Harmony [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Birdsong dances with the shade of trees,
The flowers sway in the afternoon breeze.
Sunlight sneaks, unnoticed by all,
Leaning down to admire your gentle call.
You can't open your eyes, so I'll describe,
The moment when our worlds first collide.

name: Shadow Harmony [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
A sturdy hand, a gentle touch,
A smiling face, loving so much.
Something's stirring, a dream yet so young,
Your name is murmured, softly sung.
You can't understand it, so I'll tell you the way,
Each whisper's a part of my life today.

name: Shadow Harmony [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Even with laughter mocking in my ear,
I follow your steps, year after year.
The pain of falling belongs to yesterday.
No matter where we go, what dangers may lay,
You haven't spoken, so I'll describe.
I'll run ahead of you, all my life.

name: Shadow Harmony [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
I seek you out when there's no one near,
In those times, your loneliness is clear.
We both sigh, gazing at the streetlamp's light,
But you never lift your head to face your own fight.
You never see it, so let me describe,
No matter who you wish to be, your shadow's your guide.

name: Shadow Harmony [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
When you pick up your helmet and sword,
I wrap myself in shadows, my heart ignored.
When you wave goodbye to your love so true,
I stand beneath the lamp, weeping too.
You're driven by ideals, so here's what I'll say,
The person you dream of may not be that way.

name: Shadow Harmony [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Your reason fades, it falls away,
Like madness creeping, here to stay.
Your twisted arms grow fierce and tight,
Like danger lurking out of sight.
You've locked yourself in endless night,
Where even I can't reach your light.
You shut me out, you look away,
So let me speak before I stray...
When light returns and breaks the gloom,
Your shadow slips back into view.
No matter what, love, hate, or fear,
I'll stay right here—I'm always near.

name: Phaethon's Melody [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Descends upon the Hollow.
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Guidance of the Hollow Raiders.
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
The legend of the Proxy! The legend of the Inter-Knot! The legend of New Eridu!

name: Phaethon's Melody [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Green eyes shooting out a laser beam,
With a whoosh, the whole building starts to steam.
Black and white ears wiggle and sway,
Hearing mice move in the Hollows, making their way.

name: Phaethon's Melody [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Notorious Ethereal that won't obey,
Lifts up a leg and kicks the melon-head away.
The girl in tears wants to go home,
She waves her hand, and the Hollow door's shown.

name: Phaethon's Melody [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Swings a thousand-pound hammer with might,
Smashes villains' armor flat as a pancake, what a sight.
Hoists a missile launcher with ease,
Sends rogues flying from the Hollow — no farewells, please!

name: Phaethon's Melody [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Lord Phaethon, Lord Phaethon!
A red scarf flutters in the wind, a legend reborn!
Who dares defy? Who dares defy?
Which Ethereal still refuses to comply?

name: Phaethon's Melody [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Ruler of New Eridu.
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Savior of the Hollow Raiders.
Phaethon, oh Phaethon,
Loyal Proxy, we listen to your command!

Roar roar roar
The Tiger King climbs the mountain
All animals bow
And cry
"Oh king, oh king, so mighty!"

Scaring all the bad guys

Even moving mountains and the tide

secondaryDescription:

description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities

"I imagine what the world could be—

description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription: "A youth unsheathes his sword by the rain-washed tower's shadow, and rides on singing freely, with no urge to take it slow."

name: White Water Ballad [3]

name: White Water Ballad [4]

secondaryDescription: "His body, like river water, fading and thin. Old friends lost in the mountains, no path leads him in."

name: White Water Ballad [5]

name: White Water Ballad [6]

secondaryDescription: "He prays that his sword will ring morning and night. And cut through the darkness for miles in its light."

name: Shining Aria [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
"On tiptoes I feel the weight rise, lifting me above the skies
Against the wind's shifting tides, brushing where the sunlight lies
(Dreams, take flight!)"

name: Shining Aria [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
"Imperfect dreams in my hand, warming softly where I stand
I believe someday they'll land right beside you, just as planned
(By your side!)"

name: Shining Aria [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
"In the practice room's bright glow, mirrors show how much I've grown
Sweat becomes the seed I sow; one day hope will fully bloom
(It will bloom!)"

name: Shining Aria [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
"Though my voice is small today, not enough to loud convey
Still this feeling on its way forms an angel's wings to stay."

name: Shining Aria [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
"When the city's neon glow drowns out every single sound
Will you hear me then? Will you see me now?
An idol born from daydreams, rising from the clouds."

name: Shining Aria [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
"This is not the final call, this is where our dreams stand tall
Now our music starts for all, hear our anthem rise and fall
(Angels of Delusion — We're Number One!)"

March sunlight lowers its gaze
A snow-white rabbit tumbles into a fluffy abyss
Tell me, who is the riddle behind the dream?

Lighter than dewdrops, clearer than tree shadows
Dandelions carry the whispers of feathers

A black cat at the treetop hides a smiling face

description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
To the left lies the scarecrow's garden
To the right, the rabbit earl's courtyard

name: Bunny in Wonderland [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities

A rainbow bridge rises from the teacup
A pocket watch sleeps in the jam
Ding-a-ling, all the frozen clocks begin to dance

When waking, the world tilts slightly

name: Notes From the Chained [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Rust gnaws at time upon the wrists
Cold walls stand as the only thing to lean on
Long accustomed to this crushing weight
Stifled breaths repeat in endless cycles
Until worn down into a single grain of decayed dust

name: Notes From the Chained [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Thoughts melt like wax, dripping into a bottomless lake
The world peels like lacquer, shadows dancing on the ceiling
Distant birds sweep past, leaving behind fractured cries
Weightless descent blurs the line between dreams and wandering delusion

name: Notes From the Chained [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
In shattered mirrors of bygone days, that irreversible loss is reflected
One misstep buries countless stars by one's own hand
Thus retreat into shadow, a sentence of eternal confinement pronounced
Amid the ruins of repentance, that heavy door is sealed shut by one's own hand

name: Notes From the Chained [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Silence crashes like thunder, cold sweat extinguishing the remnants of dreams
Deep within the chest, a withered heart begins to beat with unrest—
A sudden weariness of this immortal stillness
A longing to see once more that sky, both cursed and long forgotten

name: Notes From the Chained [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Trembling fingertips search every inch of every seam
No echo of iron, no chill of any lock
The gate was never truly closed
And so no key or incantation is needed

name: Notes From the Chained [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
A golden tide surges forth, swallowing the imagined prison garb
Beyond the cage, wet snow drifts as warm sunlight hangs low
Shackles at the wrists grow light as nothing
The self-bound prisoner walks the road home

A golden tide surges forth, swallowing the imagined prison garb
Beyond the cage, wet snow drifts as warm sunlight hangs low
Shackles at the wrists grow light as nothing
The self-bound prisoner walks the road home

name: Notes From the Chained [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Rust gnaws at time upon the wrists
Cold walls stand as the only thing to lean on
Long accustomed to this crushing weight
Stifled breaths repeat in endless cycles
Until worn down into a single grain of decayed dust

name: Notes From the Chained [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Thoughts melt like wax, dripping into a bottomless lake
The world peels like lacquer, shadows dancing on the ceiling
Distant birds sweep past, leaving behind fractured cries
Weightless descent blurs the line between dreams and wandering delusion

name: Notes From the Chained [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
In shattered mirrors of bygone days, that irreversible loss is reflected
One misstep buries countless stars by one's own hand
Thus retreat into shadow, a sentence of eternal confinement pronounced
Amid the ruins of repentance, that heavy door is sealed shut by one's own hand

name: Notes From the Chained [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Silence crashes like thunder, cold sweat extinguishing the remnants of dreams
Deep within the chest, a withered heart begins to beat with unrest—
A sudden weariness of this immortal stillness
A longing to see once more that sky, both cursed and long forgotten

name: Notes From the Chained [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Trembling fingertips search every inch of every seam
No echo of iron, no chill of any lock
The gate was never truly closed
And so no key or incantation is needed

name: Notes From the Chained [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
A golden tide surges forth, swallowing the imagined prison garb
Beyond the cage, wet snow drifts as warm sunlight hangs low
Shackles at the wrists grow light as nothing
The self-bound prisoner walks the road home

name: Wuthering Salon [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Act I
Silver hair cascades before the desk, steam from tea drifts up the stairs
The clock shifts time forward tick by tick — the salon waits for curtain call, but the guests have yet to arrive

name: Wuthering Salon [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Act II
The Chief seat remains empty as ever, the ruler lurks behind the veil
Change is coming but hasn't landed yet, the world keeps moving in its natural order, but that order's stretched thin and taut

name: Wuthering Salon [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Act III
A small figure settles into the seat, the computational order flows on without cease, never forgetting
But the child had long since abandoned all that wore away: the vast stretch of years, the long goodbyes

name: Wuthering Salon [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Act IV
The watch is not yet over, a guest arrives, preceded by laughter
Silence sweeps in like a bitter frost, but collapses into ruin at her side alone

name: Wuthering Salon [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Act V
The last guest arrives... her robes trailing with ash
The islands fall silent, the hearth dims, and the storm draws near
Flint's oath, forged in blood and fire, tempered to this day

name: Wuthering Salon [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Act VI
Silver hair cascades before the desk, the long night wuthering past
As always, a golden utopia stands unshaken in the sky, defiant against the dark stars and moon

name: The Sky Ablaze [1]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Immeasurable shadows and light,
Flowing along scorching trails.
A shroud of darkness buries the earth,
Yet the golden arrow seeks to pierce the throat of the abyss.

name: The Sky Ablaze [2]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
The vast sea's experiences converge in one's view like a tidal wave,
Longing for the chariot's blaze to ride across the deep,
Scattering golden wheat seeds upon the mortal world.
Such mercy, such arrogance.

name: The Sky Ablaze [3]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
A throne blazing in glory and splendor,
Violence that scorched the earth to ash,
The yoke of fate forged around the neck,
The blood of kin smeared upon the altar.

name: The Sky Ablaze [4]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
The blazing sun falls, a god's life comes to an end.
A helpless cub's fate with no one to rely on,
The last survivor scattered, the road comes to an end.

name: The Sky Ablaze [5]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Forge the reins of yesterday into a compass,
That ever-burning child leads and guides us,
Through digital cages and the night's hollow lies,
Turning rigid time into a crown of soft flowers.

name: The Sky Ablaze [6]
description: Equip to increase Agents' combat capabilities
secondaryDescription:
Dusk bleeds crimson, dawn soft as ever.
The long night is but a prelude to sunrise,
The beasts of darkness howl in vain,
The knight's chains shall melt away.

secondaryDescription: A fairly simple seal made through basic forging techniques. It's popular amongst Agents for its low-key style and matte finish.

name: Master Component
description: <color=#FFAF2C>[Universal W-Engine Breakthrough Item]</color>Can be used in place of W-Engine Components when you don't have enough. A different number of Master Components must be used to substitute different rarities of W-Engine Components.
secondaryDescription: A mysterious legend known among W-Engine enthusiasts. This item may look like nothing special, but it'll add the finishing touch to your sound quality.

name: Original Chip
description: <color=#FFAF2C>[Universal Skill Level-Up Item]</color>Can be used in place of Tactical Chips when you don't have enough. A different number of Original Chips must be used to substitute different rarities of Tactical Chips.
secondaryDescription: An original chip, unmarred by time or sedimentation. Its immense memory bank awaits training data to be uploaded so Agents can use it to hone their skills.

name: Ferocious Grip
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Dead End Butcher. Despite being completely shredded, it still retains the shape of something trying to grab.

name: Living Drive
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Unknown Corruption Complex. It looks just like a normal joint, but keeps writhing around as though alive — like it's trying to power some colossus in a wild dance.

name: Finale Dance Shoes
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Twin Marionettes. Just one look is enough to feel the hostile loneliness it exudes. Everything must come to an end, except in the Hollows.

name: Scarlet Engine
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: Etheric coagulum preserved in a rare form, extracted from the Corrupted Overlord - Pompey. Although it appears to be merely a broken component, the immense Etheric energy contained within seems to rumble incessantly.

name: Sycophant's Refinement
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: A rare form of Etheric coagulum obtained from "Sacrifice" Bringer. There is no explanation, and further investigation is prohibited. This is Ether in a bizarre form, whispering to those who desire it of the consequences of greed.

name: Exuvia of Refinement
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: A rare form of Etheric coagulum retrieved from the Miasma Priest. The cast-off remains of one who commanded and wielded miasma. A nauseating filth still surges and grows upon it, like some twisted, undying faith.

name: Crimson Miasma Spike
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: A rare form of etheric coagulum preserved from the "Corrupted Wandering Hunter". A spiky crystalline formation with an ominous red hue reminiscent of Miasma. Yet it emits no intense waves - only a crystal-like, unwavering persistence.

name: Clouded Crystalline Substance
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: An etheric coagulum preserved in a rare form, taken from the giant beast "Sobek" controlled by The Thrall. An indescribable crystalline substance, with tainted patterns clinging to its surface that seem to whisper tales of the abyss to whoever possesses it.

name: Marrow-Draining Thorn
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: An etheric coagulum preserved in a rare form, extracted from the Sanguine Sweeper. A lethal blade that decides life and death with ease, its edge still exuding the rusty-sweet scent of countless blood-soaked kills. The sadistic hunger is never sated, and blood only deepens the thirst, a void that cannot be filled.

name: Timeworn Husk
description: An important item required to upgrade your Agent's advanced Core Skills.
secondaryDescription: A rare form of etheric coagulum retrieved from Girtablullu. Even as its shell crumbled into ruin, its burning desire to become Metamorphosed never faded.

description: Increases Combat Bangboo HP by 10%.

description: Increases Combat Bangboo DEF by 15%.

name: Charge Booster
description: Increases Combat Bangboo Daze inflicted by 45%.
secondaryDescription: Spring-loaded boosters installed on a Bangboo's legs that let it generate several times its own weight in impact with just one kick.

name: Trainee Investigator Log
description: Provides 100 EXP for an Agent.
secondaryDescription: A newbie Hollow investigator's operation video logs, recorded by their companion Bangboo.

name: Official Investigator Log
description: Provides 600 EXP for an Agent.
secondaryDescription: This provides far more combat-related details compared to the newbie investigator's records.

name: Senior Investigator Log
description: Provides 3,000 EXP for an Agent.
secondaryDescription: Detailed and meticulous operation logs. Watching this makes you feel as if you have explored Hollows yourself.

name: W-Engine Battery
description: Provides 100 EXP for a W-Engine.
secondaryDescription: A special storage battery containing electrolytes with trace amounts of Ether crystals, providing a reliable power supply for the W-Engine.

name: W-Engine Power Supply
description: Provides 600 EXP for a W-Engine.
secondaryDescription: A high-performance power supply capable of converting power. It can adapt to various W-Engine models and provide an accurate power supply based on real-time power consumption.

name: W-Engine Energy Module
description: Provides 3,000 EXP for a W-Engine.
secondaryDescription: A high-efficiency energy module made of various Etheric matter, providing stable and long-lasting energy for all models of W-Engines.

name: Molded Plating Agent
description: Provides 100 EXP for your Drive Disc.
secondaryDescription: A plating agent used to enhance Drive Discs, providing a certain level of resistance to corruption.

name: Crystallized Plating Agent
description: Provides 500 EXP for your Drive Disc.
secondaryDescription: A plating agent used to enhance Drive Discs. It forms a coating on the surface that provides superior protection against corruption and exhibits a crystalline polish. As a result, it has also been utilized on decorations to enhance their appearance.

name: Ether Plating Agent
description: Provides 2000 EXP for your Drive Disc.
secondaryDescription: A plating agent used to enhance Drive Discs and another example of how Ether technology can benefit daily life. The Ether resources extracted from Hollows are ultimately used to explore even deeper into these Hollows.

name: Bangboo Software Patch
description: Provides 100 EXP for a Bangboo.
secondaryDescription: A software patch storing a large amount of behavioral data. It can initially train a Bangboo's logic core and improve its computational capability.

name: Bangboo Algorithm Module
description: Provides 600 EXP for a Bangboo.
secondaryDescription: A large data module specifically designed for Bangboo logic algorithms, enabling rapid improvement of a Bangboo's computing power.

name: Bangboo System Widget
description: Provides 3,000 EXP for a Bangboo.
secondaryDescription: A comprehensive data package that can upgrade a Bangboo's logic core, resulting in a significant improvement in its overall capabilities.

name: Lost W-Engine
description: One of the lost W-Engines from the gadget store. Get it back to Susie.
secondaryDescription: Susie says the gadget store lost a batch of limited-edition collectibles to a Hollow disaster. This must be one of them.

name: Wild Duck Out of Its Cage
description: A duck that escaped from a Pegasos truck. Catch it and take it back.
secondaryDescription: A new breed of domestic duck bred by a famous farm in Eridu Valley. The driver Gael from Pegasos was responsible for transporting them but for unknown reasons, the vehicle's cargo compartment was opened, and these priceless ducks scattered and escaped.

name: Lost W-Engine
description: One of the lost W-Engines from the gadget store. Get it back to Susie.
secondaryDescription: Susie says the gadget store lost a batch of limited-edition collectibles to a Hollow disaster. This must be one of them.

name: Damaged Small Safe
description: This is a standard small safe found in Hollows, but its lock is jammed and can't be opened normally. Consult a professional modifier if you need to open it.
secondaryDescription: The memories of your journey together are cherished here.

name: "Starlight Knight" Film Case
description: A film case containing the "Starlight Knight" videotape

name: The Port Peak Videotape
description: A movie lent out from Random Play to bribe the Mountain Lion Gang.
secondaryDescription: A thriller based on a true story. The film tells the tale of a group of adventurers who encounter the ruthless villain known as "The Lumberjack" in The Port Peak. Many viewers say they're left with a fear of the woods after watching it.

name: Keycard for the Equipment Room
description: A keycard in the shape of a work card. It can be used to swipe open the door to Public Security's equipment room.
secondaryDescription: Technically, every Public Security Officer can swipe their work card to get into the equipment room, but sometimes they forget to bring it. This master keycard is just for when this happens.

name: Master E-Keycard
description: A master keycard that can be used on most mid-to-large electronic machines. It can be used to open the final mechanism leading to the Lion's Den.
secondaryDescription: The master keycard stored in the NEPS equipment room is a low-level asset. This renders most — or rather, all criminal syndicate hideout defenses based on an outdated IT system obsolete.

name: Lost Supply Box
description: A very sturdy storage chest. It looks quite valuable.
secondaryDescription: There seems to be an unfamiliar company logo on the corner of the chest. From the make and quality, this appears to be for military use. Though it's covered in dust, there are no signs of Ether corruption.

name: Focus
description: Unlocking course nodes requires consuming specific Focus points. When your focus points decrease to a level where you cannot unlock or participate in the next course, please take time to rest and recover. Focus points are restored by 150 points daily at 4:00 AM, with a maximum capacity of 500 Focus points.
secondaryDescription: Over time, your mind will gradually become clearer.

name: Nitro-Fuel
description: Borrowed Nitro-Fuel
secondaryDescription: Nitro-Fuel borrowed from the residents of Blazewood for a showdown with Lighter.

name: Nitro-Fuel Raffle Ticket
description: Simply-Made Nitro-Fuel Raffle Ticket
secondaryDescription: A voucher from the Settlement Days celebration used to support your chosen contestant. You can exchange this voucher for double the Nitro-Fuel if they win!

name: Raffle Ticket
description: The raffle ticket given to us by Hugo.
secondaryDescription: I wonder what kind of prize we'll get...

name: Auction Invitation
description: An invitation required for entry to the auction.
secondaryDescription: An exquisitely crafted invitation card, giving off a subtle fragrance of perfume.

name: A Rather Abstract Piece of Art
description: An art piece acquired at an auction.
secondaryDescription: Abstract beauty is still beauty.

name: Old Skyletter
description: Prayers That Failed to Take Flight
secondaryDescription: The skyletter preserved by Mr. Mo has straight and clean creases, as if freshly folded. Yet upon closer inspection of the paper's color, one can still see traces left by the passage of time. The skyletter's owner must have taken great care in preserving it.

name: Skyletter
description: Prayers to Take Flight
secondaryDescription: A skyletter crafted by Yixuan and distributed to the mystics of Suibian Temple. On the night of the Tidefaire, these paper birds will flutter their delicate wings, carrying the blessings and hopes of the Waifei Peninsula's people to the Hollow. After a perilous night, through storms and surging waves, where will these birds finally come to rest?

name: Strange Copper Coin
description: Looks pretty weird, but weird in a good way
secondaryDescription: A strange copper coin Sweety received from a customer, engraved with patterns she's never seen before. Maybe Master Vince at Devon Pawnshop would know what it is.

name: Fortune's Tea Pet
description: Obtained from Mini Cargo Truck in Failume Heights. Used to submit a Yum Cha Sin order commission.
secondaryDescription:
"Hold onto your 'Fortune's Tea Pet' and sip some tea - it'll bring you luck in everything you do!"
Once a best-selling tea pet set in the Waifei Peninsula, it gained widespread popularity for its adorable design and meaningful symbolism. After the manufacturing company's unfortunate closure following the fall of the old capital, these sets became increasingly rare. Today, a small number of enthusiasts still collect them.

name: The Quizmaster's Card
description: The Quizmaster's card. It's also a clue to finding them.
secondaryDescription: A card left by a mysterious trickster who repeatedly posed riddles to others in the Lemnian Hollow. Made of expensive Porcelume material, it reads "Congratulations on solving all the puzzles - your reward is the journey itself! Looking forward to another mind-bending adventure with you~". This could be a clue to finding this person. What kind of individual could they be?

name: "To Delulus" Performance Ticket
description: Tickets prepared by the Angels of Delusion for "Delulus" coming to watch the Gilded Carrot Day performance. Make sure you're there on time and dive into the world of delusion with them together!
secondaryDescription: Help the Angels of Delusion hand out the tickets to their friends.

name: Yixuan's Lucky Money
description:
An opened Lucky Money envelope from Yixuan, with a blessing written on it:
"Wishing you safety, peace, and happiness."
secondaryDescription: Waifei Peninsula has a special custom where elders prepare Lucky Money to give to the kids on the evening of Gilded Carrot Day packed with heartfelt care and wishes for peace and health in the coming year... and a few dozen Dennies.

name: Uncle Baorong's Lucky Money
description:
An opened Lucky Money envelope from Uncle Baorong, with a blessing written on it:
"May you keep discovering and creating. Endless wonders are still waiting for you in the new year, young one."
secondaryDescription: Waifei Peninsula has a special custom where elders prepare Lucky Money to give to the kids on the evening of Gilded Carrot Day packed with heartfelt care and wishes for peace and health in the coming year... and a few dozen Dennies.

name: Wise's Lucky Money
description:
An opened Lucky Money envelope from Wise, with a blessing written on it:
"I'll be right by your side in the new year, Belle."
secondaryDescription: Waifei Peninsula has a special custom where elders prepare Lucky Money to give to the kids on the evening of Gilded Carrot Day packed with heartfelt care and wishes for peace and health in the coming year...

name: Belle's Lucky Money
description:
An already opened Lucky Money envelope from Belle, with a blessing written on it:
"Let's stick together in the new year too, Wise!"
secondaryDescription: Waifei Peninsula has a special custom where elders prepare Lucky Money to give to the kids on the evening of Gilded Carrot Day packed with heartfelt care and wishes for peace and health in the coming year...

name: Institute Strongbox
description: A strongbox stolen from an institute by the Red Fang Gang.
secondaryDescription: It ended up making its way into the Cunning Hares' hands. The box has lost all value since the contents have been used for survival, and it's currently stashed at the video store.

name: Photo of Six People
description: A group photo from Nekomata.
secondaryDescription:
It was taken at a buffet restaurant after the Vision demolition crisis was taken care of. Just as Nekomata claims, it's a very good picture.
Looking at it brings back memories of a delicious meal, relaxed spirits, and slight whiplash at the sight of the bill.

name: Site Diagram
description: A low-res image sent by Fairy to Grace's tablet.
secondaryDescription: It shows the area near the prototype before it was swallowed up by the Hollow. You can make out a strange tower in the picture.

name: External Memory Unit
description: A microchip-like object that Koleda gave us for safekeeping.
secondaryDescription: It looks like an external memory unit that's been taken from the prototype. There could still be some clues contained within from before everything with Khors went down...

name: Photo of a Young Girl
description: A photo from Nicole.
secondaryDescription:
This should be the hacker Rain.
But the girl looks really familiar... You're pretty sure you've seen her before.

name: Joran's Legacy
secondaryDescription:
An unofficially recorded album.
It was secretly recorded by a fan known as "SofaCushions&PotatoChips" during Joran's fan meeting. By a twist of fate, this became the last semi-public recording of Joran. Never officially released or leaked, it has since become a legendary album among music enthusiasts, hailed as "Joran's legacy."

name: ClueName_306019
description: A stained cushion.
secondaryDescription: A pillow from the staff breakroom in the abandoned observation center of Hollow Zero that's completely different in style to any other device surrounding it. Filthy dark brown stains adorn the pillow.

name: ClueName_306020
description: A letter of recommendation addressed to an academic at the White Star Institute.
secondaryDescription: It's recommending a person called Dylan, and signed by Joyce.

name: Old Photo of Woman with Covered Eyes
description: A somewhat aged photograph, though the image remains fairly clear. A blond young woman with her eyes covered leans against a wall. For some reason, her silhouette seems so fragile - as if she might shatter into pieces at any moment, filled with such profound sadness.

name: Lyre Squad's Tape
description:
A tape from Lyre Squad, discovered by Nathan, Lethe's younger brother. This long-sealed recording sparked the series of events that would follow.
Years have passed, and while the tape's surface shows some wear, the audio within remains pristine - as crystal clear as if it was recorded just yesterday.

name: Anby Doll
description:
A doll meticulously crafted by Nekomata, looking somewhat similar to Anby.
"Why is it top-heavy?"
"To simulate how someone often dives headfirst into the Hollow, meow."

name: Sacrifice Core
description:
A weird Core extracted from a Sacrifice, radiating an ominous aura.
It seems to be hiding a mysterious power.

name: Bringer's Notebook
description:
Bringer's notebook — old and worn-looking.
It seems to have a lot of locations of interest marked down.

name: Paranormal Exploration Journal
description: A letter of recommendation addressed to an academic at the White Star Institute.
secondaryDescription:
A time-worn document.
On the first page, the words "Paranormal Expedition" are scrawled. The journal details a paranormal exploration of Ballet Twins. Some pages are missing, and the handwriting is blurred, providing only a faint glimpse into the bizarre experiences of the explorers.

name: External Memory Unit
secondaryDescription:
Bangboo's external memory unit.
It stores key records of the paranormal exploration team's past operations. When accessed, it reveals logs of the team's activities and analysis data. However, the records abruptly cut off at a critical moment, hinting at a grim and unfortunate outcome. This sudden interruption stirs a deep sense of curiosity and unease about the truth of what happened.

name: Astra-nomical Lightstick
secondaryDescription:
A custom-made lightstick designed for Astra's New Year concert.
This unique stick combines a microphone with a Harmonic Core. When activated, the Harmonic Core causes the red section of the stick to rotate slowly, making it feel more like a magical wand than an ordinary lightstick.

name: Fancy Collectible
description:
A collectible gifted by Vivian.
It looks like an expensive and exquisite piece of art, but it seems hollow inside... Might that mess with its value?

name: Fancy Collectible
description:
A collectible gifted by Vivian.
It looks like an expensive and exquisite piece of art, and no one could have guessed it could be opened.
Inside, it conceals the mysterious Sacrifice Core.

name: Sparkstone
description: The flint that Appon threw into the mine when he was hiding from Ethereals.
secondaryDescription: The product of lost technology, and an object of interest for Engineer Bangboo's research. The Flame Spark, capable of igniting the Cinder Lake, might also... help it ignite a certain cage.

name: Blooming Wind
description: Used to upgrade the Gilded Blossom W-Engine
secondaryDescription: A special W-Engine component obtained in Hollow C41. It can be used to upgrade the W-Engine, Gilded Blossom, increasing its Ether resonance. A seed that can cause the gilded golden flowers to bloom, etched with the radiance of a season that slips by like sand through your fingers.

name: Roaring Tides
description: Used to upgrade the Marcato Desire W-Engine.
secondaryDescription: A specialized W-Engine Component obtained from the unique Melinoe Hollow, capable of enhancing the Ether Resonance performance of the Marcato Desire W-Engine. Even in the pale abyss, let the song of mortals resound.

name: 16mm Film
description: Can be used to upgrade W-Engine Reel Projector.
secondaryDescription: A commemorative W-Engine Component distributed by Gravity Cinema that can be used to enhance the Ether resonance performance of the W-Engine Reel Projector. A trace of inspirational light for engraving images, captured in a fleeting moment within 16mm film.

name: Cerulean Echoes
description: Used to upgrade the Cauldron of Clarity W-Engine.
secondaryDescription: A special engine component obtained from the Qingming Realm, capable of enhancing the Ether Resonance performance of the Cauldron of Clarity W-Engine. Countless waves of Sword Will, like echoes of the heart, resonating within this small stretch of sky.

name: Blazing Chili
description: Used to upgrade The Simmering Pot W-Engine.
secondaryDescription: A special W-Engine Component infused with searing Fire Energy, used to enhance the Resonance performance of The Simmering Pot W-Engine. Not spicy enough? Then crank up the heat!

name: Child at Heart
description: Used to upgrade the Boisterous Echoes W-Engine.
secondaryDescription: A special W-Engine Component that produces a pleasant sound when struck. It can be used to improve the Resonance performance of the W-Engine "Boisterous Echoes" and is highly favored by both faculty and students at Aurelia Academy.

name: Dusk Afterimage
description: Can be used to upgrade the W-Engine "Sol Exuvia".

description: Places a time bomb that explodes in a cross after 3 turns, <color=#2BAD00>clearing away most event tiles in its blast area.</color>
secondaryDescription: Send mini Bangboo to carpet bomb in all directions to eradicate any uncertainty on the road ahead.
