name: Mysterious Carrot II
description: Leave the Hollow right now
secondaryDescription: A Carrot map plug-in from an unidentified source. It can take you to the safest of places by the most efficient of means.

name: Concentrated Medicine
description: <color=#2BAD00>Restores 10% of all squad members' Max HP.</color>
secondaryDescription: A plug-in used to adjust Med Kit's potency. Enhances its healing effects.

name: Concentrated Medicine II
description: <color=#2BAD00>Restores 20% of all squad members' Max HP.</color>
secondaryDescription: A plug-in used to adjust Med Kit's potency. Largely enhances its healing effects.

name: Short Distance Collection
description: Spin the wheel once. You may get: Gear Coins, a deadly trap, restorative medicine, or a Resonium.
secondaryDescription: Release an auto-collection device to explore in a random direction, with a chance to bring back anything found on the way, which may include trouble.

name: Short Distance Collection II
description: Spin the wheel once <color=#2BAD00>with a good chance of winning something nice</color>. You may get: Gear Coins, a deadly trap, restorative medicine, or Resonia.
secondaryDescription: Release an auto-collection device to explore in a random direction, with a chance to bring back anything found on the way, which may include trouble.

name: Powerful Excavation
description: Enter an unknown area that cannot be scanned.
secondaryDescription: Excavate in directions with no path and discover new areas.

name: Powerful Excavation II
description: Enter a mysterious unknown area that cannot be scanned.
secondaryDescription: Excavate in directions with no path and discover new areas.

name: Gold Calling
description: Turns 8 adjacent empty tiles into <color=#2BAD00>Gear Coin event tiles</color>.
secondaryDescription: Come to me, Gear Coins! Enough hiding, it's time to come home!

name: Gold Calling II
description: Turns all empty tiles into <color=#2BAD00>Gear Coin event tiles</color>.
secondaryDescription: Come to me, Gear Coins! Enough hiding, it's time to come home!

name: Concentrated Sedative
description: Reduces Pressure by <color=#2BAD00>40</color>.
secondaryDescription: A plug-in used to adjust Sedative's potency. Enhances its pressure-reducing effect.

name: Concentrated Sedative II
description: Reduces Pressure by <color=#2BAD00>80</color>.
secondaryDescription: A plug-in that adjusts Sedative's potency and largely enhances its Pressure reducing effects.

name: Raid Type Ethereal Decoy
description: <color=#2BAD00>Clears most event tiles along the way</color>, instantly claiming any positive outcomes while destroying any negative outcomes. Lasts 3 turns.
secondaryDescription: A plug-in that sends out strong signals to irritate and attract specific Ethereals. Used in a destructive strategy to lure Ethereals and sweep the road ahead.

name: Capture Type Ethereal Decoy
description: <color=#2BAD00>Clears most event tiles along the way</color>, doubling any positive outcomes while destroying any negative outcomes. Lasts 3 turns.
secondaryDescription: A plug-in that sends out strong signals to irritate and attract specific Ethereals. While sweeping the road ahead, it will attempt to collect usable resources. Apparently, a certain degree of damage has enabled it to gather resources more efficiently.

name: Integrated Supply
description: <color=#2BAD00>Fully restores all members' HP</color> and <color=#2BAD00>removes all traps</color>.
secondaryDescription: A multi-functional supply plug-in that provides a large amount of Recovery Medicine and Detection Devices.

name: Integrated Supply II
description: <color=#2BAD00>Fully restores all members' HP</color>, <color=#2BAD00>removes all traps</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>obtain 1 random Resonium</color>.
secondaryDescription: This multi-functional supply plug-in provides a large amount of Recovery Medicine and Detection Devices... and even a Resonium!

name: Stereoscopic Photocopy
description: <color=#2BAD00>Doubles</color> your currently held <color=#2BAD00>Gear Coins</color>.
secondaryDescription: A plug-in that instantly copies Gear Coins. Bangboo merchants are strongly against this plug-in, but they can't tell the difference between the genuine coins and their replicas, so they can only repeatedly declare their opposition.

name: Stereoscopic Photocopy II

name: Notes From the Chained
secondaryDescription:
A mysterious track posted on Inter-Knot by an anonymous creator, inspired by the hallucinations of a lost Hollow wanderer. The melody cuts off abruptly halfway through, yet its hauntingly precise evocation of the despair and disorientation of deep Hollow exploration made it a brief sensation.
It is said that an investigator, once lost, abandoned rescue efforts and instead followed the melody as his guide, wandering within the Hollow. The agony brought on by Corruption nearly blinded him, yet the tune continued to echo in his ears. In the end, he miraculously found a way out.
Later, this investigator who returned from the abyss became a well-known composer and finished writing the second half of the melody.

name: Trainee Investigator's Supply Box
description: Supply box contains Trainee Investigator Logs, W-Engine Batteries, and Dennies.
secondaryDescription: The accomplishments of our predecessors will serve as a ladder, or more specifically, a portable ladder stored in a chest.
