description: Supply box contains Trainee Investigator Logs, W-Engine Batteries, and Dennies.
secondaryDescription: A smart mind is an investigator's most powerful weapon, and the materials in this chest provide efficient ways to use this weapon.

name: Elite Investigator's Supply Box
description: Supply box contains Official Investigator Logs, W-Engine Power Supplies, and Dennies.
secondaryDescription: Here lies the glorious years of a legendary investigator.

name: [Ignite] Molten Gloves
description: When an Agent with Motivation <color=#FF5521>Burns</color> an enemy, the <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> DMG interval is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Each finger has a small lighter. If the other hand had a frost glove, that would be pretty cool.

name: [Ignite] Flamethrower
description: <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Once you start to spray this flame, you won't want to stop until you've passed out first.

name: [Ignite] Kerosene Lamp
description: When an Agent has Motivation, their <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> attacks have <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> bonus PEN Ratio.
secondaryDescription: A versatile item that can serve as a cool decoration, a handy source of light, and even a makeshift throwing weapon in a pinch.

name: [Ignite] Blowtorch
description: Dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> grants 1 stack of Motivation to all squad members. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s.
secondaryDescription: It releases a sweet roaring flame.

name: [Ignite] Molotov Cocktail
description: Agent <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Someone was trying to do the right thing and threw it into the Hollow. Where exactly it fell and what it might have burned is a mystery.

name: [Ignite] Top-Notch Charcoal
description: Launching an EX Special Attack grants <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Motivation to all squad members.
secondaryDescription: High-end charcoal that emits a fruity fragrance when lit. If used to roast fruit, perhaps it could double the fruity flavor.

name: [Ignite] Camping Stove
description: Inflicting <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> grants <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Motivation to all squad members.
secondaryDescription: With this handy tool, you can enjoy hot food wherever you go.

name: [Ignite] Deluxe Lighter
description: Agents <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An elaborately decorated lighter. It looks like the favorite item of the head of a certain gang.

name: [Ignite] Electric Torch
description: <color=#FF5521>Fire CRIT DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
secondaryDescription: It is known as the Eternally Inextinguishable, but it has gone out more than a few times.

name: [Ignite] Pulse Igniter
description: <color=#FF5521>Burning</color> enemies have their ATK reduced by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A tool that housewives use to light the stove. It can light up places that need to be lit.

name: [Ignite] Solid Alcohol
description: <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> lasts <color=#2BAD00>2</color>s longer.
secondaryDescription: A convenient and portable item for various occasions. For example, it can be particularly useful when you want to confess your love but can't find enough candles to make a heart pattern.

name: [Ignite] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Ignite] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Come, turn the scattered sparks into a blazing inferno.

name: [Energy] Scarlet Noble Special
description: Launching an EX Special Attack increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 30s, stacking up to 5 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
secondaryDescription: Scarlet Noble of a random flavor. You never know what flavor you have bought until after you drink it. There's supposedly a 0.01% chance of getting the secret flavor: blood.

name: [Energy] Neon Cola
description: Upon entering the battlefield, generates <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> Energy for 1 random Agent.
secondaryDescription: The champion beverage consumer for five years in a row. Sugar-free and healthy drinks only. Even the color of the drinks is white.

name: [Energy] Raging Taurine
description: Ultimate DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
secondaryDescription: "Be brave! Be wild!" The commercial is memorable, particularly the part where the actor pours the half-finished drink over his head and then crushes the can into dust.

name: [Energy] TANKA: BBQ Flavor
description: Launching a Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy for the Agent.
secondaryDescription: A brand of soda that is constantly putting out new flavors. This barbecue flavor is supposed to give you that lovely nostalgic taste of barbecue and cola.

name: [Energy] Power Up
description: Launching an Ultimate generates <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy for all squad members.
secondaryDescription: Re-hydrate and restore electrolytes in a flash as fast as lightning!

name: [Energy] Orange God
description: Triggering Perfect Dodge generates 6 Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10s</color>.
secondaryDescription: This orange juice is popular among girls. Each can packs the nutritional punch of thirty oranges. "We carefully choose only the finest oranges. One of ours is as good as ten of another kind. That means with just three oranges, you're getting the nutrients of thirty!"

name: [Energy] Captain Cow
description: Agents Decibel Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
secondaryDescription: "Help me grow taller, Captain Cow!" This pure milk drink is loved by both children and adults alike. After all, who wouldn't want to add a few inches to their height?

name: [Energy] Sharp Smile
description: Basic Attack Energy Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
secondaryDescription: No additives and sugar free. Who wouldn't love a combo like this?

name: [Energy] Scarlet Noble: Lemon
description: EX Special Attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An energy drink that is all the rage with young people. Green lemon concentrate covers the taurine flavor.

name: [Energy] Leman
description: Defeating an enemy generates 8 Energy for all squad members. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s.
secondaryDescription: "Hey, you. Yeah, you. Drink me and we'll be besties for life. Come on. Drink me."

name: [Energy] Mr. Bright's Probiotics
description: Launching an EX Special Attack increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 15s.
secondaryDescription: "Healthy inside and out with a bottle of Mr. Bright."

name: [Energy] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Energy] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Energy! Activity! Huge Excitement!

name: [Critical] Sniper Scope
description: Landing a critical hit increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
secondaryDescription: Take it easy. Aim and then shoot. If you miss, it's because you are in too much of a hurry.

name: [Critical] Sawn-Off Shotgun
description: All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Insight upon entering the battlefield. Agents <color=#2BAD00>no longer lose</color> Insight stacks when attacked.
secondaryDescription: It packs a punch but is small and convenient to carry. You can even keep it in your waistband. (There are over 200 accidental discharge incidents each year for this very reason)

name: [Critical] Weapon Crate
description: Each Standard [Critical] Resonium owned increases Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Don't be fooled by this unassuming box — it's not just a crate for weapons, but rather a portal to an entire arsenal of them. You will never know how many weapons you can pull out of it.

name: [Critical] RPG Shell
description: Triggering a critical hit increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 3s.
secondaryDescription: Regular soldiers should get out of the way!

name: [Critical] Gatling Gun
description: Triggering Perfect Dodge grants all squad members 1 stack of Insight. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>8</color>s.
secondaryDescription: Once you pull the trigger, you'll never want to let go. Offense is the best defense, so a constant attack is the ultimate defense!

name: [Critical] Doombringer
description: Increases Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Smart ignition and precision blasts. How far it explodes all depends on how far you throw it.

name: [Critical] Tactical Goggles
description: All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Insight upon entering the battlefield.
secondaryDescription: Sometimes, good cover is all you need to get a clear view of your target.

name: [Critical] Duelist
description: Defeating an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Insight.
secondaryDescription: Add a little high-tech flare to your duel. Who cares if it is fair?

name: [Critical] Spare Magazine
description: Landing a critical hit on an enemy reduces the target's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: Better prepare for the next enemy early.

name: [Critical] Muzzle Compensator
description: When hitting an enemy from behind, Agent CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An essential accessory for firearms, it enhances your prowess in combat.

name: [Critical] Laser Scope
description: Each non-critical hit increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color>. This effect is reset after the Agent triggers a critical hit.
secondaryDescription: Precise, and with clear intent.

name: [Critical] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Critical] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
More guns, bigger guns, stronger guns...

name: [Shield] Fingerless Gloves
description: Shielded Agents' <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt level</color> increases, and they receive <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> less DMG.
secondaryDescription: People into punk love wearing this style of gloves.

name: [Shield] Elastic Kneepads
description: Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack generates Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> of the Agent's Max HP. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
secondaryDescription: It offers the flexibility needed for all those weird and wonderful leg positions.

name: [Shield] Battery-Charged Baton
description: Increases CRIT DMG of Shielded Agents by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> and Anomaly Mastery by <color=#2BAD00>15</color>.
secondaryDescription: Don't touch it while it's charging — it's super hot.

name: [Shield] Riot Helmet
description: Generates Shield for all squad members equal to <color=#2BAD00>150%</color> of their initial DEF upon entering the battlefield.
secondaryDescription: Rabbit ears were added to display closeness and power.

name: [Shield] Punk Belt
description: Shielded Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to enemies within 6m.
secondaryDescription: With this spiky belt, no one is going to bother you when you're out and about.

name: [Shield] War Boots
description: Defeating an enemy generates Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> of Max HP for all squad members, lasting 10s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
secondaryDescription: It may look handsome, but it has a strong smell.

name: [Shield] Exoskeleton Armor
description: Each Standard [Shield] Resonium owned increases Agent DEF by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Provides excellent protection while allowing you to launch powerful elbow strikes.

name: [Shield] Blast Shield
description: Agents take <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> less DMG.
secondaryDescription: Justice must win! Or at least it can't lose.

name: [Shield] Warm Bracers
description: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 25%, immediately generate Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of Max HP for 10s. (This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent in each combat.)
secondaryDescription: It's not practical to hope it will stop damage. But graffiti lovers like wearing it to protect their wrists.

name: [Shield] Flak Jacket
description: Increases Agent DEF by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Heavy attacks bounce right off. The only problem is you bounce forward.

name: [Shield] Tactical Mask
description: Triggering Perfect Dodge grants the Agent Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> of Max HP for 5s. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
secondaryDescription: Strong filtration and fresh circulation. You can even wear it while using the bathroom.

name: [Shield] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Shield] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Pile on the thickest armor... what was next again?

name: [Shock] Current Gloves
description: <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Gloves that release a shocking voltage. Remember what these gloves look like, and be careful when shaking hands.

name: [Shock] Stun Gun
description: Inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> on an enemy generates <color=#2BAD00>10</color> Energy for all squad members. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
secondaryDescription: It won't do direct damage, but it is still recommended that you take a shot before a fight.

name: [Shock] Amplification Bracelet
description: Agents with Zap deal <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> more <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
secondaryDescription: According to those who have used this device, running with it feels like an invisible muscle-man is gripping your wrist and yanking you forward as hard as he can.

name: [Shock] Tesla Sphere
description: Agents generate <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> Decibels upon hitting a <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color> enemy. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
secondaryDescription: Look cool when the power is on or use it for divination when the power is off (and still look cool).

name: [Shock] Lightning Trident
description: Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>6</color> stacks of Zap.
secondaryDescription: You can't take this with you to ponds to harpoon fish!

name: [Shock] Electric Baton
description: Inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> on an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>10</color> stacks of Zap.
secondaryDescription: This weapon is a must for any lady's purse. Once you've shocked the perv, follow it up with a slap to the face.

name: [Shock] Mosquito Swatter
description: Each stack of Zap increases the Agent's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>2%</color>.
secondaryDescription: With this powerful and convenient tool, you won't need to tap with your hands anymore. The only downside is that it may emit the smell of burnt meat if you use it for too long...

name: [Shock] Conductive Coil
description: Dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> grants all squad members 1 stacks of Zap. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>3</color>s.
secondaryDescription: A crude method: wrapping the weapon to increase its conductivity.

name: [Shock] Thunder Whip
description: <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> lasts <color=#2BAD00>3</color>s longer.
secondaryDescription: Sure, it's not practical, but you can look like a villain.

name: [Shock] EMP Grenade
description: Agent <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Stay clear of electrical devices when throwing this; otherwise, you'll get carried off too.

name: [Shock] Hand Crank Generator
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more DMG to <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color> enemies.
secondaryDescription: The strongest person will find themselves as the poor soul cranking the generator alone on a camping trip.

name: [Shock] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Shock] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
If we gather enough, can we unleash 100,000 volts?

name: [General] Stimulant
description: When below 50% HP, the buff effects of B-Rank and A-Rank Adversity Resonia increase by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Quickly break past human limitations. Boost every body function. Side effects include becoming talkative and fidgety.

name: [General] Band-Aid
description: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent takes <color=#2BAD00>1.2%</color> less DMG.
secondaryDescription: A band-aid with ointment that can stop bleeding and cause a wound to close quickly.

name: [General] Concentration Pills
description: For every 10% of HP lost, the Agent generates <color=#2BAD00>7%</color> Energy.
secondaryDescription: Totally safe and has no side effects. You can eat it like candy.

name: [Duel] Chain Mace
description: For each stack of Rush, Agents' Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> when hitting a Stunned enemy.
secondaryDescription: If you get hit, then you only have yourself to blame for not throwing it far enough.

name: [Duel] Shock Gloves
description: Launching a Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> Decibels.
secondaryDescription: A direct hit to the jaw is all you need to bring the opponent to their knees.

name: [Duel] Homemade Spiked Mace
description: When triggering a Chain Attack, all squad members receive 1 stack of Rush, and the Stun DMG Multiplier of enemies hit is increased by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, up to a max of <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Who even cares if it's sturdy or practical? As long as it looks terrifying and painful, it's good enough!

name: [Duel] Tonfa
description: Enemies are Stunned for <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> longer.
secondaryDescription: Attack and defense are one. The more you hit, the faster you'll become.

name: [Duel] Joiner's Hammer
description: When an enemy is inflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, all squad members gain a stack of Rush. If the target is not Stunned, its Daze increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A decisive blow. Go forth, little nail!

name: [Duel] Bench
description: When an enemy is Stunned, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> Decibels and <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Rush. Can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s.
secondaryDescription:
"I can't bear to watch. I want in, too!"
And then they strike with the power of a substitution that catches enemies off guard.

name: [Duel] Ergonomic Brick
description: Chain Attacks deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: Convenient to have on your person, everyone gets one.

name: [Duel] Baseball Bat
description: Basic Attacks inflict <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more Daze.
secondaryDescription: If you accidentally let go, one extra combatant will be stunned.

name: [Duel] Nunchucks
description: EX Special Attacks inflict <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more Daze.
secondaryDescription: Once you start playing, you can't put it down. Even if you hit yourself, it doesn't hurt.

name: [Duel] Brass Knuckles
description: Triggering Perfect Dodge increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 5s.
secondaryDescription: Frighten the enemy with your imposing manner and then rain down the punches.

name: [Duel] Gong of Jubilation
description: Upon Stun recovery, the enemy's ATK is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 30s.
secondaryDescription: Hit it hard by your ear... and you'll see double all day.

name: [Duel] Rolling Pin
description: Chain Attacks and the Ultimate deal <color=#2BAD00>significantly more DMG</color>. (Appears only in Rally Commissions.)
secondaryDescription: Who beats you depends on who cooks tonight.

name: [Duel] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Duel] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Since a duel is inevitable, let's make sure we have every advantage on our side.

name: [Dodge] Sports Shades
description: Dodge Counter DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription:
Pro goggles designed to keep the eyes safe during high-speed sports.
"See! I can see everything!"

name: [Dodge] Skateboard
description: When in the Counter state, Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
secondaryDescription: "Hey, everyone! Eyes on me!"

name: [Dodge] Shuttlecock
description: On triggering Perfect Dodge, Agents gain <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Agility and enter Vital View for 4s This effect can trigger once every 10s.
secondaryDescription: One must remain calm and ensure precision during a spike; otherwise, you'll only end up snapping fragile feathers with a roar.

name: [Dodge] Tennis Racket
description: When entering Vital View by triggering Perfect Dodge, the post-Dodge Dash Attack is replaced by Dodge Counter that can be used repeatedly up to <color=#2BAD00>4</color> times.
secondaryDescription: If you can't hit back, at least try to dodge. Getting smacked by that ball hurts.

name: [Dodge] Fencing Sword
description: Extends the duration of the Counter state by <color=#2BAD00>5</color>s.
secondaryDescription: A fragile but formidable weapon.

name: [Dodge] Yoga Ball
description: The post-Dodge Dash Attack is replaced by Dodge Counter. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>5</color>s. Triggering this effect grants the Agent 1 stack of Agility.
secondaryDescription: If you can maintain one pose without moving, then you can slow down the flow of time.

name: [Dodge] Killer Paddle
description: Upon being attacked, quickly press Dodge to <color=#2BAD00>immediately break free</color> and recover 50% of the DMG taken as HP. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>6</color>s.
secondaryDescription: It's all about the final, show-stopping spike.

name: [Dodge] Skate Shoes
description: Dodge Counter DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>35%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Made for those who seek the ultimate sprinting speed. If you can't stop, you'll probably crash.

name: [Dodge] Sneakers
description: Perfect Dodge is <color=#2BAD00>easier</color> to trigger.
secondaryDescription: Every kick is a trend.

name: [Dodge] Skis
description: Triggering Dodge Counter generates <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy for the Agent.
secondaryDescription: Gracefully dodge obstacles or eat snow like no one else.

name: [Dodge] Hard Hat
description: Using Dodge increases the Agent's DEF by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 5s.
secondaryDescription: All defensive measures are a means to better offense.

name: [Dodge] Diving Goggles
description: Every 3 times Perfect Dodge is triggered, Vital View activates for 4s. During this period, Agents inflict <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> more Daze.
secondaryDescription: Wearing it makes you feel like you've transformed into someone from another world.

name: [Dodge] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Dodge] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Reduces the dodge rate of dodge Resonia when pulled...

name: [Dodge] Exercise Stopwatch
description: Enter Vital View for 4s after a Perfect Dodge. Hidden Gear Coins are revealed for this duration. (Appears only in Rally Commissions)
secondaryDescription: If you keep staring at it, you'll feel as if everything is gradually getting larger.

name: [General] Hero's Cape
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> more DMG but also take <color=#CF4029>15%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: A cape made in the style of a hero from another game. It might look super impressive during a fight, but it's a whole other story if your enemy gets a hold of it.

name: [General] Cat Comb
description: When hitting an enemy from behind, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
secondaryDescription: The only time it won't violently resist is when its back is being brushed.

name: [General] Bag of Salt
description: Attacks against enemies with less than 50% HP deal <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: Ouch! Ouch! Knock it off!

name: [General] Duel Invitation
description: When there are no more than 3 enemies on the battlefield, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A brush that appears to have come from some kendo school.

name: [General] Moisturizing Mask
description: Limits each instance of DMG taken to <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of the Agent's Max HP.
secondaryDescription: Retains moisture (a little bit) and blocks UV rays (for a little while).

name: [General] Mosquito Swatter
description: Defeating an enemy increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: If you are trying to swat at a fly buzzing through the air, it won't help. You have to wait for it to be still and then strike.

name: [General] Cleavers
description: When your squad is full, all squad members deal <color=#2BAD00>16%</color> more DMG. Each missing member reduces this effect by 4%.
secondaryDescription: Only a powerful and accurate slash can bring out the true power of a cleaver.

name: [General] Best Man's Bowtie
description: When your squad is full, all squad members take <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> less DMG. Each missing member reduces this effect by 4%.
secondaryDescription: The more grooms, the merrier. Gather all the friends you can. You can't afford to not look impressive.

name: [General] Basketball Tactical Board
description: When your squad is full, all squad members take <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> less DMG and deal <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> more DMG. Each missing member reduces this effect by 4%.
secondaryDescription: Three basketball players work in unison, perfectly in sync with each other's movements. This is the basis for the triangular combat technique.

name: [General] Rusted Shackles
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>35%</color> more DMG but <color=#CF4029>will no longer trigger critical hits</color>.
secondaryDescription: Sturdy shackles designed to restrain violent prisoners. Sometimes it can have the opposite effect.

name: [General] Kettle
description: After being in combat for 30s, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color>. This effect expires upon leaving combat.
secondaryDescription: You'll have to wait a bit before you can hear the sound of boiling water.

name: [General] Disposable Gloves
description: Each Agent takes <color=#2BAD00>70% less DMG</color> from the first melee attack received in each combat.
secondaryDescription: "Oh, I'll just wash it off." You're just lying to yourself.

name: [General] Guide's Flag
description: Upon entering combat, the active Agent's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>. This effect expires upon leaving combat.
secondaryDescription: With great power comes great... well you know.

name: [General] Insecticide
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to normal enemies.
secondaryDescription: Doesn't matter what kind of bug it is or where it is. The person who catches it first is the strongest.

name: [General] Fruit Peeler
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to elites.
secondaryDescription: Seeing coils of apple peels totally unbroken produces a meaningless pride.

name: [General] Wooden Slingshot
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> more DMG. Additionally deal <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more DMG to bosses.
secondaryDescription: A slingshot made from a weak branch. It breaks easily. Nevertheless, any child that has it will become a king.

name: [General] Scarlet Goblet
description: Off-field Agents with 25% or lower HP <color=#2BAD00>slowly recover HP</color>.
secondaryDescription: This goblet looks a bit strange. Is it a prop or an actual goblet?

name: [General] Antique Pocket Watch
description: When an Agent is the sole remaining member in the squad, they deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: A pocket watch with a blurry picture. It brings up memories of the good old days.

name: [General] Dog Tags
description: When an Agent is the sole remaining member in the squad, they take <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> less DMG.
secondaryDescription: Who cares if I'm by myself? I'll pick up my allies' work and keep going.

name: [General] Aromatic Candle
description: When the on-field Agent is defeated, all other Agents recover<color=#2BAD00>50%</color> of their HP.
secondaryDescription: Light a candle and pray for your fallen comrades... Ah... a peach-scented candle is the best.

name: [General] Multi-Functional Tactical Knife
description: Attacks deal additional DMG equivalent to <color=#2BAD00>3%</color> of the target's Max HP. This effect can trigger once every 0.1s.
secondaryDescription: Sure, spring-assisted blades look cooler than regular ones, but whether it will actually be useful is a whole different matter.

name: [General] Zoom Lens
description: Non-critical hits deal additional DMG equivalent to <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> of ATK. This effect can trigger once every 0.4s.
secondaryDescription: It will keep taking photos and changing focus until it gets the clearest photo.

name: [General] Cleavers
description: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Slash-type</color> skills.
secondaryDescription: Only a powerful and accurate slash can bring out the true power of a cleaver.

name: [General] Sashimi Knives
description: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Pierce-type</color> skills.
secondaryDescription: Its needle-sharp edge can skin and descale with ease, making it an indispensable part of any quality kitchen.

name: [General] Heavy Knives
description: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Strike-type</color> skills.
secondaryDescription: A chef's understanding of the role and use of ingredients is crucial, as just wielding a brutal mallet will only leave a mess.

name: [General] Cleavers
description: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Slash-type</color> skills.
secondaryDescription: Only a powerful and accurate slash can bring out the true power of a cleaver.

name: [General] Sashimi Knives
description: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Pierce-type</color> skills.
secondaryDescription: Its needle-sharp edge can skin and descale with ease, making it an indispensable part of any quality kitchen.

name: [General] Heavy Knives
description: Enhances the Counter effect of all <color=#2BAD00>Strike-type</color> skills.
secondaryDescription: A chef's understanding of the role and use of ingredients is crucial, as just wielding a brutal mallet will only leave a mess.

name: [General] Miracle Starlight
description: Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A transformation badge featured in "Starlight Knight." It symbolizes the miraculous power brought upon by shooting stars. "Breaking the limits of what's possible, I arrive in the chariot of stars. Lower the hand that blocks out their brilliance and face your undoing!"

name: [General] Aromatic Candle
description: Defeating an enemy recovers <color=#2BAD00>2%</color> HP for the Agent.
secondaryDescription: Light a candle and pray for your fallen comrades... Ah... a peach-scented candle is the best.

name: [General] Antique Pocket Watch
description: Increases Agent Max HP by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A pocket watch with a blurry picture. It brings up memories of the good old days.

name: [General] Multi-Functional Army Knife
description: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>3.5%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: Sure, spring-assisted blades look cooler than regular ones, but whether it will actually be useful is a whole different matter.

name: [General] Zoom Lens
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to enemies with a higher percentage HP.
secondaryDescription: It will keep taking photos and changing focus until it gets the clearest photo.

name: [General] Disposable Gloves
description: <color=#2BAD00>Blocks the first instance</color> of fatal DMG taken. (This effect can only be triggered once in each combat.)
secondaryDescription: "Oh, I'll just wash it off." You're just lying to yourself.

name: [Affinity] Fully Charged
description:
Anby has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Charging Field]</color> After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Charging Field: When Anby uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she gains 8 stacks of Charge (max 8 stacks). When she hits an enemy with her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, 1 stack of Charge is consumed, increasing that attack's DMG by 45%.
secondaryDescription: Anby has had enough rest, and she's now ready for a big fight. Wherever she goes, she can hear the crackling of electricity around her.

name: [Affinity] Apex Predator
description:
Nekomata has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Bird Hunter]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Bird Hunter: When Nekomata hits an enemy from behind, she ignores 16% of her target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. If the enemy is Stunned, all Nekomata's attacks against them are considered back attacks.
secondaryDescription: Nekomata is coiled and ready to pounce, just like an apex predator ready to leap out and disappear at any second.

name: [Affinity] Full Firepower
description:
Nicole has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Field Expansion]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Field Expansion: When Nicole uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, the diameter of the energy field generated at the target location is increased by 3m.
secondaryDescription: If fear towards the enemy often stems from a lack of firepower, then Nicole flexing full firepower is what instills fear in them.

name: [Affinity] Absolutely Flawless
description:
Soldier 11 has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Indulgent Blaze]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Indulgent Blaze: If <color=#FFFFFF>Fire Suppression</color> is triggered during the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd hit of Soldier 11's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG received is reduced by 18% during skill activation.
If <color=#FFFFFF>Fire Suppression</color> is triggered during the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, she becomes invulnerable during skill activation.
secondaryDescription: Soldier 11 is fully prepared, and in better shape than she's ever been.

name: [Affinity] My BGM is On
description:
Billy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Roaming Gunslinger]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Roaming Gunslinger: Billy's <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> DMG increases by 25%. Rolling Shots during his <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> count as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during skill activation and able to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodges</color>. When a Rolling Shot triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, it will automatically follow up with a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>.
secondaryDescription: Billy hums the theme song to Starlight Knights while confidently declaring "Nobody can beat me while my BGM is on!" Clearly... he's in high spirits.

name: [Affinity] Muscle Mayhem
description:
Anton has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Warm-Up Exercises]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Warm-Up Exercises: When <color=#FFFFFF>Drill Attack</color> hits an enemy, Anton gains additional Energy, up to a maximum of 5 Energy per skill use.
secondaryDescription: Anton is in excellent shape, effortlessly moving through chest exercises as if he's powered by endless energy and he's looking for a punching bag to hammer.

name: [Affinity] Un-Bear-Able Rage
description:
Ben has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Agile Adaptation]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Agile Adaptation: When successfully blocking enemy DMG with Ben's invulnerable effect during his <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the following counter deals 30% more DMG.
secondaryDescription: Ben quotes an "angry price," an amount most ordinary people couldn't even dream of affording. Luckily, some unsavory characters down in the Hollows are going to cover the bill.

name: [Affinity] Exercise Before Dinner
description:
Soukaku has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Northern Wind]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Northern Wind: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Frosted Banner</color> state, the number of usable enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and enhanced <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attacks</color> is increased to 12, and also deal 45% more DMG.
secondaryDescription: Soukaku radiates with an unprecedented level of energy, clearly driven to complete all her tasks before the restaurant closes.

name: [Affinity] Frosty Eviction
description:
Lycaon has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Full Moon Momentum]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Full Moon Momentum: When Lycaon's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color> hits an enemy, the attack's Daze increases by 12%. This effect can trigger once every 8s. When he charges his <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Thrill of the Hunt</color> to completion, this buff will increase by an additional 10%.
secondaryDescription: Lycaon is as elegant as always, but he has a particularly relentless look in his eye. Any uninvited guest would be met with a cold kick out the front door before they got the chance to say a thing.

name: [Affinity] Bangboo Give Me Strength
description:
Grace has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Lightning Piercer]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Lightning Piercer: When Grace's thrown grenade hits an enemy during a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color> is reduced by 8.5%, and <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup RES</color> is reduced by 8.5%, lasting for 8s.
secondaryDescription: Grace is in fine form. A Bangboo's hug doesn't just relieve exhaustion, it also bring a steady stream of strength.

name: [Affinity] Hostile Wake-Over
description:
Ellen has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Arctic Ocean Predator]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Arctic Ocean Predator: The 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming</color> can be directly followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sharknami</color>. For each point of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> when using an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the current attack's CRIT DMG is increased by 20%, up to a max of 60%.
secondaryDescription: The bad news is that Ellen did not get a good night's sleep. The good news is that she's now refreshed and eager to clear any obstacles for the next night's quality sleep.

name: [Affinity] Up to the Task
description:
Rina has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Dance Duet]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Dance Duet: After being sent out to launch an attack, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.
The effect gained from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner</color> by characters within 10m is increased to 130% of the original value.
secondaryDescription: Rina and her little Bangboo are in excellent condition. Navigating through the dangerous Hollows is as easy as playing a game of tag.

name: [Affinity] Passionate Cleanup
description:
Corin has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Accumulated Release]</color>.
Accumulated Release: When Corin's extended slash hits an enemy, she obtains a stack of Charge (max 40 stacks).
During a <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, when her chainsaw detonation hits an enemy, consumes all stacks of Charge. Each stack consumed causes the attack to deal an additional 3% of ATK as DMG.
secondaryDescription: With the uplifting effects of genuine compliments and rejuvenating sleep, Corin is now brimming with enthusiasm, even in her spirited "Sorry!"

name: [Affinity] Hammer Sparks
description:
Koleda has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Kinetic Recovery]</color>.
Kinetic Recovery: When Koleda's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.
secondaryDescription: Koleda and her formidable hammer have been finely tuned to their best shapes. Now, even her casual strikes now ignite more sparks than ever before.

name: [Affinity] Solid Companionship
description:
Zhu Yuan has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Quick Reload]</color>.
Quick Reload: When Zhu Yuan activates <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimates</color>, gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Reload</color> effect. When Zhu Yuan has the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Reload</color> effect and uses up all <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Reload</color> effect will be consumed to instantly gain 6/9 <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Shotshells</color>.
secondaryDescription: When Zhu Yuan confronts dangers and perils, she is never alone — Somewhere beyond her sight, numerous fellow officers stride alongside her. This camaraderie is the source of her confidence and pride as a Public Security officer.

name: [Affinity] Lady-Like Charge
description:
Lucy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Fierce Fangs of Fire]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Fierce Fangs of Fire: When another squad member in the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state hits an enemy with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, a guard boar will drop from the sky and cause an explosion, dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 300% of the guard boar's ATK. This will extend the duration of the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> buff for all squad members and Bangboo, and for the guard boars themselves by 5s. The duration can increase up to 3 times, with a maximum duration of 30s. Refreshing the <color=#FFFFFF>Cheer On!</color> state resets the stack count. After the guard boar's explosion, it will launch <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Boars: Spinning Swing!</color>.
secondaryDescription: Lucy and her boars have had a good rest, and were all bursting with energy.

name: [Affinity] Fighting Style: Mixed Fruit Flavor
description:
Lighter has evoked the Mindscape <color=#FFAF2C>The Champion</color>.
The Champion：Among the debuffs imposed by <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Accelerant</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect increases Stun duration by 5s, while further reducing <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's <color=#FFFFFF>Morale</color> is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.
secondaryDescription: Lighter's fighting style is more elusive than ever: rapid hooks, fierce jabs, brutal straight punches, and... is that a subtle mixed fruit aroma?

name: [Affinity] Power of Hope
description:
Piper has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Mild Excitement]</color>.
Mild Excitement: Increases the duration limit of <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Engine Spin</color> by 2s and extends the duration of <color=#FFFFFF>Power</color> by 4s.
secondaryDescription: Piper is full of energy, full of hope, obsessed with the lottery, and can't wait to go back and check her ticket.

name: [Affinity] Like a Fish in Water
description:
Qingyi has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Insulation Breakdown]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
[Insulation Breakdown]：When Qingyi enters combat, <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms</color>, if <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Connect Voltage</color> is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.
secondaryDescription: Qingyi has achieved her daily water intake goal, and she is in her optimal state for the day.

name: [Affinity] Partners in "Crime"
description:
Jane has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Crime Counsel]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Crime Counsel: The maximum uses of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color> are increased by one. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state, Jane's <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by an extra 15% and each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency increases her DMG by 0.1%, up to a maximum increase of 30%.
secondaryDescription: Being recruited by Jane as an "accomplice" is no small feat, and it means she will unleash her full strength.

name: [Affinity] Path of Honor
description:
Seth has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Idealist]</color>.
Idealist: When Seth lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified</color>, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.
secondaryDescription: The pain didn't affect Seth's condition. Instead, it raised his spirit. These wounds are his medal of honor as a Public Security officer.

name: [Affinity] Overlord's Accompaniment
description:
Caesar has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Spearhead Advance]</color>.
Spearhead Advance: When Caesar becomes the active character in combat, she instantly buffs all squad members with a <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> shield. This effect can trigger once every 300s. While <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color> is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% All-Attribute RES reduction.
secondaryDescription: For Caesar, obstacles on the path are irrelevant. As long as she can roll over them, they're not obstacles anymore.

name: [Affinity] Nitro-Fuel Feast
description:
Burnice has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Extra at No Additional Charge]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
Extra at No Additional Charge: When triggering the <color=#FFFFFF>Afterburn</color> effect, <color=#FFFFFF>Thermal Penetration</color> is applied to the enemy, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any allied unit in the squad hits the enemy, the attack's PEN Ratio is increased by 4% for each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Thermal Penetration</color>, up to a max of 20%.
secondaryDescription: In Burnice's world, solving problems is simple... Gather some good friends from the squad and have a lively Nitro-Fuel Feast together!

name: [Affinity] 17-Item Check-Up
description:
Yanagi has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Outstanding Adaptability]</color>.
[Outstanding Adaptability]：During her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, the rapid thrust's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup</color> increases by 20%. Holding down the Special Attack button after a rapid thrust hits an enemy will consume 10 additional Energy to launch another thrust. If Energy is insufficient or the button is released, the attack automatically follows up with the downward attack. When the downward attack hits an enemy suffering an Anomaly and triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Polarity Disorder</color>, the DMG multiplier increases to 20% of the original <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> effect. Each additional thrust increases this multiplier by 15%, up to a maximum of 2 extra thrusts.
secondaryDescription: After completing a series of thorough check-ups, Yanagi is very satisfied with the results and confident in her teammates' conditions going forward.

name: [Affinity] Haiku Swordplay
description:
Hoshimi Miyabi has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Breath Technique]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
[Breath Technique]: <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Kazahana</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> DMG increases by 30%. Hoshimi Miyabi gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> when the final move of the 5th hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Kazahana</color> hits an enemy. Upon entering the battlefield, Hoshimi Miyabi immediately obtains 6 points of <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color> and her CRIT Rate increases by 15%.
secondaryDescription: Hoshimi Miyabi has begun a new round of training. The focus of her training this time is "reciting haikus while slashing away at enemies." Gotta admit it's quite the sight and her swordsmanship is impeccable. Could the haikus really be making her stronger...?

name: [Affinity] Efficient Surge
description:
Asaba Harumasa has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>["High Spirit"]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
["High Spirit"]: The maximum stack limit of <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Prison</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya</color> increases to 14 stacks. When an <color=#FFFFFF>Electro Quiver</color> is triggered, 2 consecutive <color=#FFFFFF>Ha-Oto no Ya</color> will be fired at the target.
secondaryDescription: Asaba Harumasa is rested and recharged. Time to get things done!

name: [Affinity] Encore Time
description:
Astra Yao has evoked the Mindscape <color=#FFAF2C>[Art of Greed]</color>.
[Art of Greed]: The ATK buff from <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: "Graceful Andante"</color> is further increased by 19%, with an increased maximum of 400. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, when other squad members switch in through a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> and 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tone Clusters</color> to attack. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
secondaryDescription: Astra Yao has had enough rest and is feeling great. It's time for her to hit the stage again!

name: [Affinity] Back to Prime
description:
Evelyn has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Dance of Fire]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo.
[Dance of Fire]: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form</color>, the <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color> consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color> to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.
secondaryDescription: Evelyn's in perfect condition — or rather, her skills are on point. She said, "It feels like I'm back in my prime when I used to go on missions." As for the details, let's just say it's best not to ask...

name: Affinity: Silver Heart's Resonance
description:
Soldier 0 - Anby has awakened the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>[Static Charge]</color>.
[Static Charge]: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> 3 times. This effect does not consume any <color=#FFFFFF>White Thunder</color> stacks.
secondaryDescription: Silver Heart Tin Soldiers are born for combat, but here beside you is Anby. Her blade speaks of things that cannot be forgotten.

name: Affinity with Your Rhythm
description:
Trigger has awakened the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>[Sharpened Senses]</color>.
[Sharpened Senses]: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze</color> is increased by an additional 20%. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot</color>, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in <color=#FFFFFF>Sniper Stance</color> increases by 25%. Maximum <color=#FFFFFF>Purge</color> increases to 125.
secondaryDescription: Remembering lost loved ones and those beside me, "Trigger" blew an original harmonica tune. The powerful will to protect now transforms into soaring fervor.

name: [Affinity] Nail It Big Time
description:
Pulchra has evoked the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>[Behind the Mask]</color>.
[Behind the Mask]: <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's</color> DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2. <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Business Partner</color>'s <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color> effect now also applies to all damage types, not just <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG.
secondaryDescription: Pulchra, brimming with fighting spirit, pulled out various eyeshadows, lipsticks, and compacts... "Are these disguise bombs?" "They're hot-selling resale items. Hold onto them carefully - if they break, they'll lose their value."

name: [Affinity] The Girl's Parasol
description:
Vivian has evoked the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>["Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"]</color>.
["Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"]: When a total of 4 <color=#FFFFFF>Guard Feathers</color> are consumed, gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Flight Feather</color>. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG received by targets under <color=#FFFFFF>Vivian's Prophecy</color> increases by 16%.
secondaryDescription: The hem of her dress and the parasol are more than just a girl's way of attracting attention. When Vivian opens her parasol, her fierce protective instinct sweeps any obstacles, shielding her from all hostility.

name: [Affinity] The Phantom Thief's Magic
description:
Hugo has evoked the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>[The Child Within]</color>.
[The Child Within]: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Blaspheme</color> triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color>, it will not end the enemy's Stunned state. Additionally, when <color=#FFFFFF>Totalize</color> is triggered, the skill will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF.
secondaryDescription:
In New Eridu, there's only Ether, no magic — unless you trust the mischievous glint in the eyes of the phantom thief.
Here, you see the unyielding flames and the quiet frost intertwining, revealing a harsh truth mingled with gentle lies.

name: [Affinity] Guarding Tranquility
description:
Yixuan has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Spiritual Path]</color>.
[Spiritual Path]: Upon entering combat, CRIT Rate increases by 10% and immediately gain 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Technique Points</color>. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can only trigger once every 180s. When any squad member lands a hit on an enemy, Yixuan automatically summons an extra lightning strike, dealing DMG equal to 50% of her Sheer Force and restoring 5 additional Adrenaline. This can trigger once every 6s.
secondaryDescription:
"True training is like drawing spring water beneath the moon — you touch the surface gently, leaving the moon's reflection undisturbed, not stirring the stars into chaos."
She's always behind you, quietly shielding you from it all, steady and serene, as if it were nothing.

name: [Affinity] "Such Might"
description:
Ju Fufu has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Super Scary Little Tiger]</color>.
[Super Scary Little Tiger]: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color>. When Ju Fufu's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.
secondaryDescription:
According to your dear senior Fufu herself, tiger Thirens naturally possess a protective aura called Might during battle.
Although it can't be explained by either science or sorcery, Fufu's fighting spirit is definitely all fired up.

name: [Affinity] A Soup to Bring Everyone Together
description:
Pan Yinhu has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Meridian Theory]</color>.
[Meridian Theory]: The <color=#FFFFFF>Meridian Flow</color> effect provided by <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment</color> increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
secondaryDescription: Senior Yinhu is doing his best to figure out how to score the finest ingredients from the market at the lowest prices. This bowl of ten-treasure nutrition soup is proof of his trust and gratitude.

name: [Affinity] Perfect Symmetry
description:
Alice has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Sage at the Sword's Tip]</color>.
[Sage at the Sword's Tip]: When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starfall Finale</color>'s Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers <color=#F0D12B>Polarity Assault</color>. All squad members' <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> DMG increases by 15%. <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> DMG against enemies suffering from <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color> increases by 15%. Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
secondaryDescription: After all sorts of tweaking and adjusting, Eous is finally perfectly symmetrical, and Alice finally feels a deep sense of relief she's never felt before! As for the tweaking process... Well, some details are better left unsaid.

name: [Affinity] Lucky Plum Cookie
description:
Yuzuha has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Full of Colorful Company]</color>.
[Full of Colorful Company]: When Yuzuha's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief</color> hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomaly Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, it will trigger a forced <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attacks</color> can only occur once every 20s. Whenever another character enters through a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, Yuzuha gains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Points</color>. Yuzuha's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot</color> cooldown is reduced by 25%.
secondaryDescription: The street snacks of Failume Heights are infamous for their mouth-puckering sourness. While this makes them perfect for Yuzuha's pranks, they also work wonders for folks who wish to stay alert and awake!

name: [Affinity] Three Musketeers
description:
Orphie & "Magus" have awakened the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>Luxurious Cat House</color>.
Luxurious Cat House: Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>, and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.
secondaryDescription:
One gunner, one gun. Two gunners, one gun. Three gunners... still just one gun!
But at least with Orphie and Magus around, you won't have to worry about running out of ammo.

name: [Affinity] Flowers on the Ruins
description:
Seed has awakened the Mindscape Cinema: <color=#FFAF2C>"Hibernation Period"</color>.
"Hibernation Period": When Seed's <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> reaches 100, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color> can be triggered, and the total <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> consumed is reduced to 100. The amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> required to gain one chance to quickly release <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter</color> is reduced to 100. Accumulate an additional 40/20 <color=#FFFFFF>Steel Charge</color> when entering the battlefield/using <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>. Increases <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall</color> CRIT DMG by 30%.
secondaryDescription:
Once, in ruins like these, humanity had nothing left. But now, she truly saw it... flowers blooming upon the ruins.
At this moment, she offers you flowers filled with love. Please don't ask why - just accept them and don't be shy.

name: [Affinity] Changing Tides
description:
Yidhari has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss</color>.
The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss: The Adrenaline cost to activate Yidhari's <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> is reduced by 10. After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Frost Coil</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>, keeping hold of the Basic Attack or Special Attack button consumes 35 Adrenaline to forgo healing and immediately chain into another <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color>. The HP restored by this <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color> is increased by 100% of the original value. Yidhari's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attacks</color> ignore 20% of targets' <color=#98EFF0>Ice RES</color>.
secondaryDescription:
Around you, her emotions have always ebbed and flowed like gentle tides, whispering softly only when washing over the shore.
But in this moment, you truly sense her feelings surge into silent waves, condensing into a force of immense weight within those rolling swells.

name: [Affinity] Moonlit Adventure
description:
Lucia has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Secret Friend</color>.
Secret Friend: When <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate. Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Echo</color>, stacking up to 4 times. When <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> ends, if Lucia has any <color=#FFFFFF>Echo</color> stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply <color=#FFFFFF>Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme</color> to all squad members.
secondaryDescription:
Keen Ether perception, vast Ethereal knowledge, exceptional combat skills, and an ever-growing curiosity — without a doubt, Lucia is one of the finest Hollow companions.
...And after agreeing to seek the "Doppelganger" together, that boundless energy has reached even greater heights.

name: [Affinity] Tempered Blade
description:
Komano has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Beyond Dreams of the Past</color>.
Beyond Dreams of the Past: When <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Return to Ashes</color> hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing <IconMap:Icon_Normal> will launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> hits an enemy, Manato's <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
secondaryDescription:
Manato's body and soul are hardened by years of labor and countless brushes with death.
So rest assured, as long as he can still swing that heavy greatsword, he won't let danger come near you.

name: [Affinity] The Dead Dials
description:
Dialyn has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[24/7 Hotline]</color>.
24/7 Hotline: Enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color> gain an additional 20% Stun DMG Multiplier when Stunned, and all units deal 15% increased DMG to targets affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Malicious Complaint</color>.
secondaryDescription: Only spirits can dial Dialyn's phone. When it rings, it signals the start of a judgment where yesterday's truth condemns today's sins.

name: [Affinity] Greater Heights
description:
Banyue has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Greed Burns Like Fire]</color>.
Greed Burns Like Fire: When Banyue hits an enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: One's Path</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker</color>, he inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state. In this state, enemies' <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color> is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s. When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tremor</color> state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%. When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks</color> hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.
secondaryDescription:
Beyond every peak lies an even higher summit. Whether in martial arts or character, Banyue always strives to reach greater heights.
Looking back now, his achievements stand tall and proud.

name: Sword of the Solitary Heart
description:
Ye Shunguang has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Light & Shadow</color>.
[Light & Shadow]: The max stack count of <color=#FFFFFF>Bearer</color> increases to 6, and <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color> can stack up to 9 times. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Enlightened Mind</color> state, each point of <color=#FFFFFF>Qingming Sword Force</color> consumed grants 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Culmination</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens</color>'s DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.
secondaryDescription:
The Hollow is filled with treacherous places and requires vigilance and caution to remain safe.
But right now, you can rest easy — your senior walks by your side, her sword's light guarding the path ahead.

name: Double Lucky Bunny Ears
description:
Zhao has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Righteous Verdict</color>.
[Righteous Verdict]: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.
secondaryDescription: Xiao'Zhao says clean bunny ears bring luck to everyone, so with me and Xiao'Zhao together, we've got two pairs: that's double the luck!

name: Wings of Steel
description:
Aria has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Energetic Sound Waves</color>.
Energetic Sound Waves：When Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup RES</color>. Additionally, when Aria triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.
secondaryDescription: I'll protect every single one of your delusions — whether on stage or on the battlefield, same as always.

name: Strawberry Paradise
description:
Sunna has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>"Feline Go-With-the-Flow"</color>.
"Feline Go-With-the-Flow"：While Sunna is within any <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, all squad members gain 10% ATK and she obtains 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Claw Sharpener</color> every 10s. The number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> is reduced, and the DMG Multiplier on trigger is increased:
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 200%.
When triggered by an <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 300%.
secondaryDescription:
She picked up that sheet music, and with it, an entire summer that had withered away in the strawberry garden.
In this awakened paradise, as long as it's her wish, every delusion can come true!

name: Flawless Plumage
description:
Nangong Yu has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Lazy Spotlight]</color>.
[Lazy Spotlight]: When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: The Unbearable Weight of Love</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's All-Attribute RES decreases by 18% for 40s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeat</color> is restored to the maximum. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
secondaryDescription:
There's no such thing as a flawless genius idol, or wings of pure white.
But at least for this one moment, I'll deliver the perfect delusions.

name: Guidepost Home
description:
Cissia has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Hunger and Hard Truths]</color>.
[Hunger and Hard Truths]: After a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Gang Operation</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Ophidiophobia</color> hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Venom</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color> deals 35% increased DMG.
secondaryDescription: Her innate sharp senses always lead Cissia to her destination — be it prey, truth, or just a warm corner where she can curl up. Yet what she craves most is a beacon to take her home.

name: Beyond the Shackles
description:
Promeia has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Faltering Conviction]</color>.
Faltering Conviction: Promeia's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40. The multiplier of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> triggered by consuming <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color> increases by 120%.
secondaryDescription: Promeia never uncuffs herself if it's not necessary, but... it seems a certain special client's presence has turned it into a necessity.

name: Starlight Beacon
description:
Starlight - Billy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Wasteland Automaton]</color>.
Wasteland Automaton：Increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full-Throttle Starlight</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Starlight Knight Flying Kick</color> by 50%. Activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color>, or hitting a Stunned enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> grants the <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> effect: <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color> consumes this effect to immediately follow up with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Cool Wheelie</color>, and increases that instance's CRIT DMG by 50%. Only 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Turbocharged</color> can be held.
secondaryDescription: The starlight that guides hope may not exist, but there will always be someone who becomes the beacon leading people toward hope.

name: Like the Spring Breeze
description:
Velina has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Saturation Project]</color>.
[Saturation Project]：When Velina triggers <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, she can also gain 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. This effect can trigger once every 5s. After <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Chromatic Tint</color> effect, it can accumulate the corresponding attribute's Anomaly Buildup. The buildup accumulated by this attack is excluded from Anomaly DMG calculations. The DMG increase effects of Velina's <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Vortex</color> from <color=#FFFFFF>Additional Ability: Tea Party Etiquette</color> are further increased by 15%.
secondaryDescription: Even a gentle breeze sometimes hides its sting, yet Velina has already read the shifting winds. Wherever the path ahead may lead, all lies within her grasp with a single fold of her fan.
