description: Agent <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Everyone loves it for its ice-cold touch. It's even popular among cats and dogs.

name: [Freeze] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Freeze] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Ice three feet thick doesn't form in a day... So we need more of the cold.

name: [Onslaught] Claw Hammer
description: Upon triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, the Agent inflicts additional Daze equal to <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> of Max Daze +<color=#2BAD00>100</color> Daze. This effect can only be triggered against each enemy once every 5s.
secondaryDescription: It out may not be that they lack the strength if they can't pull it out, but rather that they fear the pain.

name: [Onslaught] Utility Knife
description: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
secondaryDescription: Pain can creep close in the subtlest of ways...

name: [Onslaught] Window Breaker
description: Launching an EX Special Attack enables the Agent's <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color> attacks to inflict <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more Daze for 15s.
secondaryDescription: Hopefully, this stuff will always stay behind an intricate little window and will never have to be used.

name: [Onslaught] Gardening Shears
description: <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> deals <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: If all you have is a pair of gardening shears, everything looks like a branch out of place.

name: [Onslaught] Lightweight Wrench
description: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
secondaryDescription: These little, lightweight tools are also used as a juggling prop or makeshift throwing weapons.

name: [Onslaught] Steel File
description: Triggering Perfect Assist increases the Agent's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 15s.
secondaryDescription: The term "grind" beautifully encapsulates the idea of complete and extreme destruction.

name: [Onslaught] Roller Brush
description: Each Standard [Onslaught] Resonium owned increases Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>32%</color>.
secondaryDescription: One can never truly know what a wet, sticky roller brush has just been through.

name: [Onslaught] Pitchfork
description: Launching an EX Special Attack increases Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 12s.
secondaryDescription: Once you're holding it, the urge to stab something is always irresistible... and that's where the holes in these haystacks come from.

name: [Onslaught] Lumber Axe
description: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> generates <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy for the Agent.
secondaryDescription: Once you've found the best spot for chopping, each blow will become more effortless than the last.

name: [Onslaught] Steel Handsaw
description: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> reduces the target's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 30s.
secondaryDescription: A saw's serrated shape contributes to only 1% of its overall intimidating presence, while the remaining 99% comes from horror movies.

name: [Onslaught] Pointed Shovel
description: Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Many people associate shovels with painful memories of the wooden handle bouncing off their faces when they stepped on it.

name: [Onslaught] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Onslaught] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Hooks, axes, hammers, chisels, shovels, saws, scissors... We've got all the tools.

name: [Assist] Gate Breaker
description: Vital View triggered by Evasive Assist lasts <color=#2BAD00>5</color>s. Defensive Assist inflicts <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more Daze.
secondaryDescription: Harnessing the power of inertia, this device can help break through a target's defense. Don't forget to release your grip at the right moment, or else you'll go flying off with it.

name: [Assist] Hydraulic Buffer
description: Assist Follow-Up DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>70%</color>.
secondaryDescription: During rescue operations, this device will provide a buffer for you and your teammates to make sure you don't collide with each other's bodies... or lips.

name: [Assist] HF Communicator
description: Triggering Perfect Assist generates <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color> Decibels.
secondaryDescription: This device emits loud and clear sound that is perfect for communication with your teammates. Its excellent voice amplification ensures that your voice is always delivered to your teammates... and also your enemies.

name: [Assist] Ether Reaction Device
description: Triggering a Perfect Assist increases all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: This device analyzes the Ether activity of your squad members and adjusts its algorithms accordingly to facilitate Ether integration.

name: [Assist] Impact Feedback Device
description: Triggering Perfect Assist grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Rush.
secondaryDescription: This device can absorb and store a certain amount of impact, that you can then release at precisely the right moment.

name: [Assist] Dynamic Calibration Device
description: Triggering Perfect Assist grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Insight.
secondaryDescription: This device ensures visual calibration while moving quickly. While it can be a real game-changer in combat, it causes great strain on the operator's optic nerves.

name: [Assist] Holographic Decoy
description: Hitting enemies with an Assist Follow-Up increases all squad members' PEN Ratio by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for 15s.
secondaryDescription: This device projects illusions in all directions, disrupting its target.

name: [Assist] Activity Transfer Device
description: Triggering Perfect Assist increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: This support device, resembling a relay baton, transfers active Ether energy from a target surface to the user.

name: [Assist] Hand Operated Generator
description: Triggering Perfect Assist generates <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
secondaryDescription: This device converts kinetic energy into electric energy. In short, it generates power as long as you are running.

name: [Assist] Emergency Enhancement Device
description: Triggering Perfect Assist increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: A micro enhancement device that works on the surface of the skin. While its effect is limited and temporary, it's incredibly convenient. All you need to do is attach it to your skin like a plaster, and you're good to go.

name: [Assist] Backup Shield Generator
description: Triggering Perfect Assist grants the Agent a Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> of their Max HP for 10s.
secondaryDescription: A portable shield generator that sacrifices some of its protection for portability. Since it only provides a very limited level of protection, some would even say you get about as much protection as picking up a trash can lid.

name: [Assist] Impact Stacker
description: Defensive Assist and Assist Follow-Up Daze increases by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> against normal enemies, <color=#2BAD00>75%</color> against Elite enemies, and <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> against Bosses. (Appears only in Rally Commissions.)
secondaryDescription: An enhancement device that can amplify impact effects for a short time. It's design is said to take inspiration from a woodpecker.

name: [Assist] Cycle Drive Unit
description: Triggering Perfect Assist has a <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> chance to restore 1 Assist Point. (Appears only in Rally Commissions.)
secondaryDescription: A support device mounted on the legs and feet, allowing runners to store kinetic energy during initial acceleration.

name: [Assist] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Assist] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Even a hero needs the help of three friends.

name: [Artifice] Sensory Poker
description:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, <color=#CF4029>lose all Energy and Decibels</color> upon being hit by an enemy attack.
Once reconstructed, Agents will instead generate Energy and Decibels <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> faster.
secondaryDescription: Not only does he know which card you chose, he also knows that your awe and praise are insincere.

name: [Artifice] Pitch Dark Cape
description:
Each movement on the current floor causes an additional <color=#CF4029>100%</color> Pressure.
Upon reaching the next floor, the Pressure increase from movements is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>.
secondaryDescription: The cloak is the most reliable partner for a magician. It can even be used to shield oneself from rotten eggs and tomatoes when exposed.

name: [Artifice] Ornate Cane
description:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, Agent CRIT Rate decreases by <color=#CF4029>40%</color>.
Once reconstructed, Agent CRIT DMG instead increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
secondaryDescription: With each hidden prop removed, the magician's cane juggling becomes effortlessly smooth.

name: [Artifice] Hypnotic Pocket Watch
description:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, enemy Stun duration decreases by <color=#CF4029>40%</color>.
Once reconstructed, enemy Stun duration increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
secondaryDescription: From how your eyelids start to get heavy when you stare at it, these hypnotic pocket watches are basically the same as your summer homework.

name: [Artifice] Mechanical Pigeon
description:
The amount of Gear Coins you gain from Gear Coin events is <color=#CF4029>halved</color> on the current floor.
When you reach the next floor, the repayment will be reduced by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Since everyone knows the magic is fake, there's no need to use real pigeons either, right?

name: [Artifice] Top Hat of Wonders
description:
For the current floor, exploring an unexplored tile causes all squad members to lose <color=#CF4029>1%</color> HP.
Upon reaching the next floor, at the end of every combat, all squad members instead recover <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> HP.
secondaryDescription: Pulling a Bangboo out of a hat everyone thinks contains a rabbit... Now that's magic!

name: [Artifice] Burning Rose
description:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, Agent Anomaly Buildup Rate decreases by <color=#CF4029>80%</color>.
Once reconstructed, Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A beautiful rose that can ignite and burn. Actually, it's just a fake flower with a fire starter in the stem.

name: [Artifice] Magician Gloves
description:
For {CReplaceCardParam:ProgressLeft,1,2} combats, Chain Attacks replenish <color=#CF4029>1</color> less Assist Point.
Once reconstructed, Defensive Assist inflicts <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> more Daze, and Assist Follow-Up DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>.
secondaryDescription: If you don't want to play the role of the embarrassed fool in a show, then don't shake the hand of a gloved magician.

name: [Artifice] Extendable Short Sword
description: Chain attacks deal <color=#2BAD00>considerably more DMG </color>, but the damage taken by your allies is also <color=#2BAD00>greatly increased</color>.
secondaryDescription: When the expansion button is functioning properly, it's a great magic prop for intimidating people. But when the button malfunctions... well, that's even more intimidating.

name: [Ether] Scrap Amplifier
description: Each point of Anomaly Proficiency increases the Agent's <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>0.2%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An operational amplifier regulates the cycling speed of the surrounding Ether. As for the malfunctioning ones... they are typically repurposed into wireless speakers.

name: [Ether] Rusty W-Engine
description: <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
secondaryDescription: When your W-Engine completely fails in the Hollow, don't hesitate to use it as a disposable throwing weapon.

name: [Ether] Net Launcher
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to <color=#FE437E>Corrupted</color> enemies.
secondaryDescription: This device launches a special Etheric grid that temporarily reduces the Ether activity of Ethereals upon contact.

name: [Ether] Cracked Drive
description: <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> lasts <color=#2BAD00>2</color>s longer.
secondaryDescription: A drive disc covered in cracks. Playing it despite the cracks will only produce stress-inducing noises.

name: [Ether] Suppressive Bracelet
description: Launching an EX Special Attack grants <color=#2BAD00>1</color> stack of Activity to all squad members.
secondaryDescription:
"Ah! This bracelet just won't stop sending me alerts! It's so annoying!"
"Just take it off. See? Problem solved."

name: [Ether] Deteriorating Filter
description: Dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> grants all squad members 1 stack of Activity. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10s</color>.
secondaryDescription: Once a trendy accessory popular in New Eridu, it was later banned due to concerns about causing anxiety among the public.

name: [Ether] Invalid Adapter
description: Each Standard [Ether] Resonium owned increases Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>4%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>32%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Much like a mobile phone data cable, it connects multiple Bangboo for data connection. However, it also shares another trait with data cables: it's prone to breaking.

name: [Ether] Frozen Timer
description: Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A device used to calculate the recommended exploration duration within the Hollows. The readings are frozen at the moment of its destruction.

name: [Ether] Depleted Battery
description: Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A discarded battery, its power depleted, possibly discarded by a Bangboo with a backup battery module.

name: [Ether] Broken Chip
description: Launching a Chain Attack increases all squad members' Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>25</color> for 15s.
secondaryDescription: A discarded broken Bangboo core chip, with its owner nowhere to be found.

name: [Ether] Faulty Jammer
description: <color=#FE437E>Corrupted</color> enemies have their ATK reduced by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Originally designed as an interference device to be installed on a Bangboo's head, capable of disrupting Ethereals, a hat version was developed, allowing Hollow Raiders to wear it themselves.

name: [Ether] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Ether] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Etheric matter exhibits mutual attraction... to a certain extent, this is true.

name: [Ether] Lightning Rod
description: Ether currents deal <color=#2BAD00>significantly more DMG</color>. (Appears only in Rally Commissions.)
secondaryDescription: Never stand in open areas during a thunderstorm!

name: [Ether] High-Efficiency Lightning Rod
description: Ether currents deal <color=#POSITIVE_WITH_RED>overwhelmingly more DMG</color>! Agents and enemies won't be able to take it! Please be sure to dodge and use these currents to defeat enemies!
secondaryDescription: From now on, if there are no lightning rods, everyone can be efficient lightning catchers.

name: [Synergy] Feather Cat Wand
description: Launching a Bangboo Chain Attack enables the Bangboo to deal <color=#2BAD00>40%</color> more DMG for 30s.
secondaryDescription: A Bangboo-shaped cat teaser that can provoke fierce attacks from cats, provided the user is swift and diligent enough.

name: [Synergy] Jingling Bell
description: Bangboo ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> for each Combat Bangboo and Ally Bangboo in your squad.
secondaryDescription:
When your pet presses it, a corresponding voice will ring out, such as "hug me," "feed me," and "play with me"...
The dog at the newsstand on Sixth Street also uses such bells, but the voice is not as sappy.

name: [Synergy] Roly-Poly Bunny
description: Bangboo Active Skill DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>40%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Everyone's hands will eventually get sore, so the tumbler always gets back up in the end.

name: [Synergy] Laser Pointer
description: Launching an Active Skill or Bangboo Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>10</color> Energy for the active Agent. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
secondaryDescription: A cute laser pointer, extremely attractive to animals.

name: [Synergy] Teething Toy
description: When a Bangboo hits an enemy, Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to that enemy for 10s.
secondaryDescription: A bone-shaped teething toy that will help keep your dog's teeth clean and sharp.

name: [Synergy] Dog Frisbee
description: When an Agent launches an EX Special Attack, Bangboo CRIT Rate is increased by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: Catching a Frisbee in mid-air is always an impressive feat, no matter who or what catches it.

name: [Synergy] Goldfish Hideout
description: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Hide in the little house underwater, and the fish can avoid that bossy round face outside.

name: [Synergy] Wave Cat Scratcher
description: Bangboo ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Thank you, for saving the couch from unbearable pain.

name: [Synergy] Dash Tunnel
description: Bangboo CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>24%</color>.
secondaryDescription: It takes hours to wiggle and prepare, and the dash lasts only 1 second.

name: [Synergy] Insane Running Wheel
description: Bangboo Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A hamster decides to give the wheel a spin, and soon finds itself on an uncontrollable crazy ride!

name: [Synergy] Happy Merry-Go-Round
description: Bangboo PEN Ratio increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
secondaryDescription: This toy is designed for three cats to play together. The ideal scenario is one cat monopolizing all three balls, while the worst-case scenario is none of the cats showing any interest.

name: [Synergy] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Synergy] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
Help me, Bangboo!

name: [Research] Overload Distribution
description: Each Pressure Overload restores <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> of Max HP and increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>. (Current Bonus: {CReplaceCardParam:StressOverloadCount,0.01,2}%. Maximum: 50%.)
secondaryDescription:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on overload-related matters.

name: [Research] Resource Conversion
description: Every 100 Gear Coins spent increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>0.5%</color> (Current Bonus: {CReplaceCardParam:DamageShow,0.1,2}%. Maximum: 50%.)
secondaryDescription:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on resource conversion-related matters.

name: [Research] Trigger Instinct
description: For every 1% of HP lost, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>1%</color>. (Current increase: Please see Resonium Details. Maximum increase: 80%)
secondaryDescription:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on survival instinct-related matters.

name: [Affinity] Attack Tactical Exchange
description: Increases Attack specialty Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Attack tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

name: [Affinity] Stun Tactical Exchange
description: Stun specialty Agents inflict <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> more Daze.
secondaryDescription: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Stun tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

name: [Affinity] Anomaly Tactical Exchange
description: Increases Anomaly specialty Agent Anomaly Mastery by <color=#2BAD00>20</color>.
secondaryDescription: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Anomaly tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

name: [Affinity] Support Tactical Exchange
description: Increases Support specialty Agent Energy Regen by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Support tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

name: [Affinity] Defense Tactical Exchange
description: Defense specialty Agents take <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> less DMG.
secondaryDescription: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Defense tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

name: [Affinity] Rupture Tactical Exchange
description: Increases Rupture specialty Agent Sheer DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Using the break as an opportunity, everyone shared their combat experience, with the members good at Rupture tactics becoming the focal point of the discussion.

name: [Tenacity] Guiding Lantern
description: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>8%</color> more CRIT DMG.
secondaryDescription: Guides the way to hope while signaling to the hunters lurking in the shadows.

name: [Tenacity] Medical Kit
description: When an Agent is attacked, the DMG is <color=#2BAD00>shared between all squad members</color>. When any off-field Agent has less than 10% HP, they will share DMG but not lose HP.
secondaryDescription: From large items like first-aid supplies to small items like cold medications, it all fits inside.

name: [Tenacity] Flames of Survival
description: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: In the depths of despair, only the light of the flame can restore one's reason and confidence.

name: [Tenacity] Cut-Resistant Gloves
description: Triggering Perfect Assist or gaining a Shield increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 20s.
secondaryDescription: Only the hardest gloves can handle the sharpest blades.

name: [Tenacity] Military Canteen
description: Triggering an Ultimate grants the Agent Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of their lost HP.
secondaryDescription: A canteen with dual filtration. It not only filters outdoor freshwater into drinkable water but also reduces the risk of consuming Ether from water sources in the Hollow.

name: [Tenacity] Toothpick-sized Can
description: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 30%, DMG taken is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color> for 20s. This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent in each combat.
secondaryDescription: Each bite was hard to swallow, but every one of them kept hunger at bay.

name: [Tenacity] High-Pressure Insulated Boots
description:
Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to enemies with a higher percentage HP.
Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> more DMG to enemies with a lower percentage HP.
secondaryDescription: Extra-thick at the bottom for enhanced protection and kicking power.

name: [Tenacity] Wilderness Map
description: When an Agent is attacked or triggers Perfect Assist, the Agent restores <color=#2BAD00>5</color> Energy. This can be triggered once every 7s across all squad members.
secondaryDescription: The red crosses marked as "no entry" on the map were all earned through pain.

name: [Tenacity] Survival Kit
description: Upon entering combat, the Agent gains Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> of lost HP.
secondaryDescription: All preparations are made to survive.

name: [Tenacity] Emergency Flashlight
description:
When the Agent's HP is below 50%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
When HP is above 50%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An adjustable brightness flashlight. Save the battery by keeping it dim unless it's an emergency.

name: [Tenacity] Insulated Sleeping Bag
description: Increases Agent Max HP by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An exceptionally warm sleeping bag. No need to worry about oversleeping. When it gets too hot, you'll naturally crawl out.

name: [Tenacity] Collective Emblem
description: Increases the chance for [Tenacity] Resonia to appear.
secondaryDescription:
Kindred spirits gather, and emblems fall into groups.
The price of accelerating your sprint is accelerating your use of oxygen.

name: [Affinity] Fully Charged
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Anby has had enough rest, and she's now ready for a big fight. Wherever she goes, she can hear the crackling of electricity around her.

name: [Affinity] Apex Predator
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Nekomata is coiled and ready to pounce, just like an apex predator ready to leap out and disappear at any second.

name: [Affinity] Full Firepower
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: If fear towards the enemy often stems from a lack of firepower, then Nicole flexing full firepower is what instills fear in them.

name: [Affinity] Absolutely Flawless
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Soldier 11 is fully prepared, and in better shape than she's ever been.

name: [Affinity] My BGM is On
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Billy hums the theme song to Starlight Knights while confidently declaring "Nobody can beat me while my BGM is on!" Clearly... he's in high spirits.

name: [Affinity] Muscle Mayhem
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Anton is in excellent shape, effortlessly moving through chest exercises as if he's powered by endless energy and he's looking for a punching bag to hammer.

name: [Affinity] Un-Bear-Able Rage
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Ben quotes an "angry price," an amount most ordinary people couldn't even dream of affording. Luckily, some unsavory characters down in the Hollows are going to cover the bill.

name: [Affinity] Exercise Before Dinner
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Soukaku radiates with an unprecedented level of energy, clearly driven to complete all her tasks before the restaurant closes.

name: [Affinity] Frosty Eviction
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Lycaon is as elegant as always, but he has a particularly relentless look in his eye. Any uninvited guest would be met with a cold kick out the front door before they got the chance to say a thing.

name: [Affinity] Bangboo Give Me Strength
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Grace is in fine form. A Bangboo's hug doesn't just relieve exhaustion, it also bring a steady stream of strength.

name: [Affinity] Hostile Wake-Over
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: The bad news is that Ellen did not get a good night's sleep. The good news is that she's now refreshed and eager to clear any obstacles for the next night's quality sleep.

name: [Affinity] Up to the Task
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.
secondaryDescription: Rina and her little Bangboo are in excellent condition. Navigating through the dangerous Hollows is as easy as playing a game of tag.

name: [Affinity] Passionate Cleanup
description: In specific areas of Hollow Zero, there's a chance to trigger special events for agents in the squad, activating specific Mindscapes for the Agent for the current round.

description: Contains 3 random Catalyzed [Dodge] Resonia
secondaryDescription: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

name: Freeze Resonium Supply
description: Contains 3 random Catalyzed [Freeze] Resonia
secondaryDescription: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

name: Onslaught Resonium Supply
description: Contains 3 random Catalyzed [Onslaught] Resonia
secondaryDescription: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

name: Assist Resonium Supply
description: Contains 3 random Catalyzed [Assist] Resonia
secondaryDescription: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

name: Ether Resonium Supply
description: Contains 3 random Catalyzed [Ether] Resonia
secondaryDescription: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

name: Synergy Resonium Supply
description: Contains 3 random Catalyzed [Synergy] Resonia
secondaryDescription: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?
