description: Contains 3 random Catalyzed [Tenacity] Resonia
secondaryDescription: Resonium supplies specially distributed by the Defense Force to squads carrying out blitz operations. Please don't blame the logistics personnel who packed the supplies for having poor eyesight. He was just a bit rushed... Perhaps it will bring a surprise?

name: Resistance Decline
description: Traps become more deadly.
secondaryDescription: Your body and mind are weakened, as fragile as wreckage in the Hollow.

name: Resonium Repulsion
description: When selecting Resonium, you have fewer choices.
secondaryDescription: This stuff makes me feel sick... It smells like Ethereal... it's not an embryo, is it?

name: Frightened
description: When Pressure overloads, all squad members lose HP.
secondaryDescription: "Oh nooooo... We're done for!" "I just sneezed. Am I going to die?"

name: Energizing Effect
description: Enemy Daze diminishes over time, but the Stun DMG Multiplier is increased.
secondaryDescription: Squad members are shrouded in a mist of special Ether. It seems to be provoking the Ethereals.

name: Demotivation
description: Off-field characters gradually lose Energy.
secondaryDescription: Your raging battlelust has dried out. You fight only to survive.

name: Sinister Resonance
description: Boss attacks have a chance to deal critical damage.
secondaryDescription: Don't breathe easy just yet.

name: Suspicion
description: When Pressure increases, there is a chance your Pressure either does not increase or increases by a lot.
secondaryDescription: The intensifying uneasiness in your soul is taking its toll.

name: Rampage
description: The Bangboo merchant offers discounts, but also fewer items.
secondaryDescription: For some reason, everyone has become tough and fierce, and not even the resourceful Bangboo merchant can handle these difficult customers.

name: Self Reassurance
description: You receive Gear Coins when Pressure increases, but can only possess up to 3,333 Coins.
secondaryDescription: "Calm down... Yeah... I will survive as long as I have Gear Coins..."

name: Assimilation
description: Agents gain less Pressure, but lose HP when obtaining Resonia.
secondaryDescription: You grow accustomed to the burning pain of the restless Ether as you gradually become one with the Hollow... This is the path to total collapse.

name: Toxic Dependency
description: HP is restored at the conclusion of combat, but Pressure is increased.
secondaryDescription: The enemy explodes in a puff of Ether, and bathing in it you feel a sense of soothing like never before. Who cares about the price. More! More enemies!

name: Weakened
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> has a longer cooldown.
secondaryDescription: The old signature fighting moves and combos... It's a struggle now just to recall how they went.

name: Exhausted
description: Decreases HP when exploring through the monitor. In combat, on-field characters will lose HP gradually.
secondaryDescription: Like air, the corruption of the Ether seeps into every being, humans or robots alike.

name: Shadow of Horror
description: The Dead End Butcher deals <color=#CF4029>20%</color> more DMG. He <color=#CF4029>restores Daze and a small amount of HP</color> when he hits squad members.
secondaryDescription: Fear slumbers within the recesses of memory, stirring awake with each uncontrolled, pounding heartbeat.

name: Megalophobia
description: Corruption Complex deals <color=#CF4029>30% more DMG</color>. Attacks from allies <color=#CF4029>no longer accumulate Daze</color>, but breaking weak spots <color=#2BAD00>inflicts a substantial amount of Daze</color>.
secondaryDescription: Upon realizing their insignificance, their attempts to evade falter, and endeavors to attack appear futile.

name: Uncanny Valley
description: Twin Marionettes deal <color=#CF4029>50% more DMG</color> and revive <color=#CF4029>much faster</color>.
secondaryDescription: Hesitation emerges from semblance and shatters under the weight of disparities.

name: Harshness
description: Bangboo merchants only sell S-Rank items.
secondaryDescription: The concept of "tolerance" has been stripped from the mind, leading to a critical outlook on everything.

name: Insatiable Greed
description: Gear Coin events generate more Gear Coins but also inflict more Pressure.
secondaryDescription: Unleash yourself from all restraints and moderation, releasing the overwhelming burden by plundering everything in your path.

name: Overcaution
description: Upon entering the next floor and starting the final battle, lose 300 Gear Coins and recover 10% of Max HP for all squad members. However, failure to pay will immediately deduct 15% Max HP from all squad members.
secondaryDescription: Caution becomes a feeble pretext for the fear of moving forward, urging one to pursue an illusory path of safety amid the Hollow's malevolence.

name: Destructive Urge
description: Rest Areas and Swift Supplies no longer recover HP. Instead, after each battle, all squad members recover 3% of Max HP. Before the next floor and final battle, recover 10% of Max HP.
secondaryDescription: The insatiable craving for destruction overrides reason, providing momentary respite only when completely sated.

name: Grasping Fervor
description: Purchasing items from Bangboo merchants costs HP instead of Gear Coins.
secondaryDescription:
An appetite for all that lies within sight, regardless of the cost.
Seize them, and take them away.

name: Primal Malice
description: Typhon Slugger deals <color=#CF4029>30% more DMG</color> and has <color=#CF4029>Immunity to all Attribute Anomalies</color>.
secondaryDescription: Just like a gorilla mimicking a human with a weapon, the beast, devoid of reason, skillfully pulls the trigger. This evokes thoughts of the primal malice encountered only in barbaric lands.

name: Parasitic Mycose
description: When an Agent's HP is above 50%, HP recovery speed is significantly reduced. When an Agent's HP is below 50%, HP recovery speed is significantly increased.
secondaryDescription: Greedy when you are strong, merciful when you are weak...

name: [Ignite] Molten Gloves
description: When an Agent with Motivation <color=#FF5521>Burns</color> an enemy, the <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> DMG interval is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Each finger has a small lighter. If the other hand had a frost glove, that would be pretty cool.

name: [Ignite] Flamethrower
description: <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Once you start to spray this flame, you won't want to stop until you've passed out first.

name: [Ignite] Kerosene Lamp
description: When an Agent has Motivation, their <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> attacks have <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> bonus PEN Ratio.
secondaryDescription: A versatile item that can serve as a cool decoration, a handy source of light, and even a makeshift throwing weapon in a pinch.

name: [Ignite] Blowtorch
description: Dealing <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> grants 1 stack of Motivation to all squad members. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>6</color>s.
secondaryDescription: It releases a sweet roaring flame.

name: [Ignite] Molotov Cocktail
description: Agent <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Someone was trying to do the right thing and threw it into the Hollow. Where exactly it fell and what it might have burned is a mystery.

name: [Ignite] Top-Notch Charcoal
description: Launching an EX Special Attack grants <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Motivation to all squad members.
secondaryDescription: High-end charcoal that emits a fruity fragrance when lit. If used to roast fruit, perhaps it could double the fruity flavor.

name: [Ignite] Camping Stove
description: Inflicting <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> grants <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Motivation to all squad members.
secondaryDescription: With this handy tool, you can enjoy hot food wherever you go.

name: [Ignite] Deluxe Lighter
description: Agents <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An elaborately decorated lighter. It looks like the favorite item of the head of a certain gang.

name: [Ignite] Electric Torch
description: <color=#FF5521>Fire CRIT DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: It is known as the Eternally Inextinguishable, but it has gone out more than a few times.

name: [Ignite] Pulse Igniter
description: <color=#FF5521>Burning</color> enemies have their ATK reduced by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A tool that housewives use to light the stove. It can light up places that need to be lit.

name: [Ignite] Solid Alcohol
description: <color=#FF5521>Burn</color> lasts <color=#2BAD00>3</color>s longer.
secondaryDescription: A convenient and portable item for various occasions. For example, it can be particularly useful when you want to confess your love but can't find enough candles to make a heart pattern.

name: [Energy] Scarlet Noble Special
description: Launching an EX Special Attack increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 30s, stacking up to 5 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
secondaryDescription: Scarlet Noble of a random flavor. You never know what flavor you have bought until after you drink it. There's supposedly a 0.01% chance of getting the secret flavor: blood.

name: [Energy] Neon Cola
description: Upon entering the battlefield, generates <color=#2BAD00>100%</color> Energy for 1 random Agent and increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>.
secondaryDescription: The champion beverage consumer for five years in a row. Sugar-free and healthy drinks only. Even the color of the drinks is white.

name: [Energy] Raging Taurine
description: Ultimate DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: "Be brave! Be wild!" The commercial is memorable, particularly the part where the actor pours the half-finished drink over his head and then crushes the can into dust.

name: [Energy] TANKA: BBQ Flavor
description: Launching a Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy for the Agent.
secondaryDescription: A brand of soda that is constantly putting out new flavors. This barbecue flavor is supposed to give you that lovely nostalgic taste of barbecue and cola.

name: [Energy] Power Up
description: Launching an Ultimate generates <color=#2BAD00>12</color> Energy for all squad members.
secondaryDescription: Re-hydrate and restore electrolytes in a flash as fast as lightning!

name: [Energy] Orange God
description: Triggering Perfect Dodge generates 6 Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>5s</color>.
secondaryDescription: This orange juice is popular among girls. Each can packs the nutritional punch of thirty oranges. "We carefully choose only the finest oranges. One of ours is as good as ten of another kind. That means with just three oranges, you're getting the nutrients of thirty!"

name: [Energy] Captain Cow
description: Agents Decibel Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: "Help me grow taller, Captain Cow!" This pure milk drink is loved by both children and adults alike. After all, who wouldn't want to add a few inches to their height?

name: [Energy] Sharp Smile
description: Basic Attack Energy Generation Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: No additives and sugar free. Who wouldn't love a combo like this?

name: [Energy] Scarlet Noble: Lemon
description: EX Special Attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An energy drink that is all the rage with young people. Green lemon concentrate covers the taurine flavor.

name: [Energy] Leman
description: Defeating an enemy generates 8 Energy for all squad members. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>5</color>s.
secondaryDescription: "Hey, you. Yeah, you. Drink me and we'll be besties for life. Come on. Drink me."

name: [Energy] Mr. Bright's Probiotics
description: Launching an EX Special Attack increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 15s.
secondaryDescription: "Healthy inside and out with a bottle of Mr. Bright."

name: [Critical] Sniper Scope
description: Landing a critical hit increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color> for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
secondaryDescription: Take it easy. Aim and then shoot. If you miss, it's because you are in too much of a hurry.

name: [Critical] Sawn-Off Shotgun
description: All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>3</color> stacks of Insight upon entering the battlefield. Agents <color=#2BAD00>no longer lose</color> Insight stacks when attacked.
secondaryDescription: It packs a punch but is small and convenient to carry. You can even keep it in your waistband. (There are over 200 accidental discharge incidents each year for this very reason)

name: [Critical] Weapon Crate
description: Each Standard [Critical] Resonium owned increases Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>64%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Don't be fooled by this unassuming box — it's not just a crate for weapons, but rather a portal to an entire arsenal of them. You will never know how many weapons you can pull out of it.

name: [Critical] RPG Shell
description: Triggering a critical hit increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 3s.
secondaryDescription: Regular soldiers should get out of the way!

name: [Critical] Gatling Gun
description: Triggering Perfect Dodge grants all squad members 1 stack of Insight. <color=#2BAD00>This effect no longer has a cooldown</color>.
secondaryDescription: Once you pull the trigger, you'll never want to let go. Offense is the best defense, so a constant attack is the ultimate defense!

name: [Critical] Doombringer
description: Increases Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>35%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Smart ignition and precision blasts. How far it explodes all depends on how far you throw it.

name: [Critical] Tactical Goggles
description: All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>3</color> stacks of Insight upon entering the battlefield.
secondaryDescription: Sometimes, good cover is all you need to get a clear view of your target.

name: [Critical] Duelist
description: Defeating an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Insight.
secondaryDescription: Add a little high-tech flare to your duel. Who cares if it is fair?

name: [Critical] Spare Magazine
description: Landing a critical hit on an enemy reduces the target's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: Better prepare for the next enemy early.

name: [Critical] Muzzle Compensator
description: When hitting an enemy from behind, Agent CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An essential accessory for firearms, it enhances your prowess in combat.

name: [Critical] Laser Scope
description: Each non-critical hit increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>. This effect is reset after the Agent triggers a critical hit.
secondaryDescription: Precise, and with clear intent.

name: [Shield] Fingerless Gloves
description: Shielded Agents' <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt level</color> increases, and they receive <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> less DMG.
secondaryDescription: People into punk love wearing this style of gloves.

name: [Shield] Elastic Kneepads
description: Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack generates Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of the Agent's Max HP. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
secondaryDescription: It offers the flexibility needed for all those weird and wonderful leg positions.

name: [Shield] Battery-Charged Baton
description: Increases CRIT DMG of Shielded Agents by <color=#2BAD00>35%</color> and Anomaly Mastery by <color=#2BAD00>25</color>.
secondaryDescription: Don't touch it while it's charging — it's super hot.

name: [Shield] Riot Helmet
description: Generates Shield for all squad members equal to <color=#2BAD00>200%</color> of their initial DEF upon entering the battlefield.
secondaryDescription: Rabbit ears were added to display closeness and power.

name: [Shield] Punk Belt
description: Shielded Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to enemies within 6m.
secondaryDescription: With this spiky belt, no one is going to bother you when you're out and about.

name: [Shield] War Boots
description: Defeating an enemy generates Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> of Max HP for all squad members, lasting 10s. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
secondaryDescription: It may look handsome, but it has a strong smell.

name: [Shield] Exoskeleton Armor
description: Each Standard [Shield] Resonium owned increases Agent DEF by <color=#2BAD00>4.5%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Provides excellent protection while allowing you to launch powerful elbow strikes.

name: [Shield] Blast Shield
description: Agents take <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> less DMG.
secondaryDescription: Justice must win! Or at least it can't lose.

name: [Shield] Warm Bracers
description: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 25%, immediately generate Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of Max HP for 10s. (This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent in each combat.)
secondaryDescription: It's not practical to hope it will stop damage. But graffiti lovers like wearing it to protect their wrists.

name: [Shield] Flak Jacket
description: Increases Agent DEF by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Heavy attacks bounce right off. The only problem is you bounce forward.

name: [Shield] Tactical Mask
description: Triggering Perfect Dodge grants the Agent Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> of Max HP for 5s. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
secondaryDescription: Strong filtration and fresh circulation. You can even wear it while using the bathroom.

name: [Shock] Current Gloves
description: <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>75%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Gloves that release a shocking voltage. Remember what these gloves look like, and be careful when shaking hands.

name: [Shock] Stun Gun
description: Inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> on an enemy generates <color=#2BAD00>15</color> Energy for all squad members. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
secondaryDescription: It won't do direct damage, but it is still recommended that you take a shot before a fight.

name: [Shock] Amplification Bracelet
description: Agents with Zap deal <color=#2BAD00>35%</color> more <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>.
secondaryDescription: According to those who have used this device, running with it feels like an invisible muscle-man is gripping your wrist and yanking you forward as hard as he can.

name: [Shock] Tesla Sphere
description: Agents generate <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color> Decibels upon hitting a <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color> enemy. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
secondaryDescription: Look cool when the power is on or use it for divination when the power is off (and still look cool).

name: [Shock] Lightning Trident
description: Hitting an enemy with an EX Special Attack grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>10</color> stacks of Zap.
secondaryDescription: You can't take this with you to ponds to harpoon fish!

name: [Shock] Electric Baton
description: Inflicting <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> on an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>15</color> stacks of Zap.
secondaryDescription: This weapon is a must for any lady's purse. Once you've shocked the perv, follow it up with a slap to the face.

name: [Shock] Mosquito Swatter
description: Each stack of Zap increases the Agent's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>3%</color>.
secondaryDescription: With this powerful and convenient tool, you won't need to tap with your hands anymore. The only downside is that it may emit the smell of burnt meat if you use it for too long...

name: [Shock] Conductive Coil
description: Dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> grants all squad members 1 stacks of Zap. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>2</color>s.
secondaryDescription: A crude method: wrapping the weapon to increase its conductivity.

name: [Shock] Thunder Whip
description: <color=#2EB6FF>Shock</color> lasts <color=#2BAD00>4.5</color>s longer.
secondaryDescription: Sure, it's not practical, but you can look like a villain.

name: [Shock] EMP Grenade
description: Agent <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Stay clear of electrical devices when throwing this; otherwise, you'll get carried off too.

name: [Shock] Hand Crank Generator
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> more DMG to <color=#2EB6FF>Shocked</color> enemies.
secondaryDescription: The strongest person will find themselves as the poor soul cranking the generator alone on a camping trip.

name: [Duel] Chain Mace
description: For each stack of Rush, Agents' Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> when hitting a Stunned enemy.
secondaryDescription: If you get hit, then you only have yourself to blame for not throwing it far enough.

name: [Duel] Shock Gloves
description: Launching a Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> Decibels.
secondaryDescription: A direct hit to the jaw is all you need to bring the opponent to their knees.

name: [Duel] Homemade Spiked Mace
description: When triggering a Chain Attack, all squad members receive 1 stack of Rush, and the Stun DMG Multiplier of enemies hit is increased by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>, up to a max of <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Who even cares if it's sturdy or practical? As long as it looks terrifying and painful, it's good enough!

name: [Duel] Tonfa
description: Enemies are Stunned for <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> longer.
secondaryDescription: Attack and defense are one. The more you hit, the faster you'll become.

name: [Duel] Joiner's Hammer
description: When an enemy is inflicted with an Attribute Anomaly, all squad members gain a stack of Rush. If the target is not Stunned, its Daze increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A decisive blow. Go forth, little nail!

name: [Duel] Bench
description: When an enemy is Stunned, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>9%</color> Decibels and <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Rush. Can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10</color>s.
secondaryDescription:
"I can't bear to watch. I want in, too!"
And then they strike with the power of a substitution that catches enemies off guard.

name: [Duel] Ergonomic Brick
description: Chain Attacks deal <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: Convenient to have on your person, everyone gets one.

name: [Duel] Baseball Bat
description: Basic Attacks inflict <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more Daze.
secondaryDescription: If you accidentally let go, one extra combatant will be stunned.

name: [Duel] Nunchucks
description: EX Special Attacks inflict <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more Daze.
secondaryDescription: Once you start playing, you can't put it down. Even if you hit yourself, it doesn't hurt.

name: [Duel] Brass Knuckles
description: Triggering Perfect Dodge increases Daze inflicted by the Agent by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 5s.
secondaryDescription: Frighten the enemy with your imposing manner and then rain down the punches.

name: [Duel] Gong of Jubilation
description: Upon Stun recovery, the enemy's ATK is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 30s.
secondaryDescription: Hit it hard by your ear... and you'll see double all day.

name: [Dodge] Sports Shades
description: Dodge Counter DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>75%</color> and Daze inflicted increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
secondaryDescription:
Pro goggles designed to keep the eyes safe during high-speed sports.
"See! I can see everything!"

name: [Dodge] Skateboard
description: When in the Counter state, Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
secondaryDescription: "Hey, everyone! Eyes on me!"

name: [Dodge] Shuttlecock
description: On triggering Perfect Dodge, Agents gain <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Agility and enter Vital View for 4s. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
secondaryDescription: One must remain calm and ensure precision during a spike; otherwise, you'll only end up snapping fragile feathers with a roar.

name: [Dodge] Tennis Racket
description: When entering Vital View by triggering Perfect Dodge, the post-Dodge Dash Attack is replaced by Dodge Counter that can be used repeatedly up to <color=#2BAD00>6</color> times.
secondaryDescription: If you can't hit back, at least try to dodge. Getting smacked by that ball hurts.

name: [Dodge] Fencing Sword
description: Extends the duration of the Counter state by <color=#2BAD00>8</color>s.
secondaryDescription: A fragile but formidable weapon.

name: [Dodge] Yoga Ball
description: The post-Dodge Dash Attack is replaced by Dodge Counter. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>3</color>s. Triggering this effect grants the Agent 1 stack of Agility.
secondaryDescription: If you can maintain one pose without moving, then you can slow down the flow of time.

name: [Dodge] Killer Paddle
description: Upon being attacked, quickly press Dodge to <color=#2BAD00>immediately break free</color> and recover 50% of the DMG taken as HP. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>4</color>s.
secondaryDescription: It's all about the final, show-stopping spike.

name: [Dodge] Skate Shoes
description: Dodge Counter DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>50%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Made for those who seek the ultimate sprinting speed. If you can't stop, you'll probably crash.

name: [Dodge] Sneakers
description: Perfect Dodge is <color=#2BAD00>easier</color> to trigger, and Dodge Counter DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Every kick is a trend.

name: [Dodge] Skis
description: Triggering Dodge Counter generates <color=#2BAD00>7</color> Energy for the Agent.
secondaryDescription: Gracefully dodge obstacles or eat snow like no one else.

name: [Dodge] Hard Hat
description: Using Dodge increases the Agent's DEF by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 5s.
secondaryDescription: All defensive measures are a means to better offense.

name: [Affinity] Absolutely Flawless
description: Soldier 11 has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Indulgent Blaze]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, she gains the <color=#FFAF2C>Refreshing Rations</color> effect (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100946,1,2} more battles).
secondaryDescription: Soldier 11 is fully prepared, and in better shape than she's ever been.

name: [Affinity] My BGM is On
description: Billy has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Roaming Gunslinger]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, he gains the <color=#FFAF2C>Starlight Knight's Maintenance</color> effect. (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100947,1,2} more battles).
secondaryDescription: Billy hums the theme song to Starlight Knights while confidently declaring "Nobody can beat me while my BGM is on!" Clearly... he's in high spirits.

name: [Affinity] Muscle Mayhem
description: Anton has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Warm-Up Exercises]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, he gains the <color=#FFAF2C>Industrial Grade Motivation</color> effect. (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100948,1,2} more battles).
secondaryDescription: Anton is in excellent shape, effortlessly moving through chest exercises as if he's powered by endless energy and he's looking for a punching bag to hammer.

name: [Affinity] Bangboo Give Me Strength
description: Grace has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Lightning Piercer]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, she gains the <color=#FFAF2C>A Massage for Eous</color> effect (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100952,1,2} more battles).
secondaryDescription: Grace is in fine form. A Bangboo's hug doesn't just relieve exhaustion, it also bring a steady stream of strength.

name: [Affinity] Hostile Wake-Over
description: Ellen has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Arctic Ocean Predator]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, she gains the <color=#FFAF2C>Rest Longer To Work Better</color> effect (Effective for {CReplaceCardParam:BattleCount_Card1100953,1,2} more battles).
secondaryDescription: The bad news is that Ellen did not get a good night's sleep. The good news is that she's now refreshed and eager to clear any obstacles for the next night's quality sleep.

name: [Affinity] Fighting Style: Mixed Fruit Flavor
description: Lighter has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>The Champion</color>. Additionally, gain the <color=#FFAF2C>Declaration of Victory</color> effect.
secondaryDescription: Lighter's fighting style is more elusive than ever: rapid hooks, fierce jabs, brutal straight punches, and... is that a subtle mixed fruit aroma?

name: [Affinity] Path of Honor
description: Seth has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>Idealist</color>. Additionally, gain the <color=#FFAF2C>Silver Offensive Line</color> effect.
secondaryDescription: The pain didn't affect Seth's condition. Instead, it raised his spirit. These wounds are his medal of honor as a Public Security officer.

name: [Affinity] Overlord's Accompaniment
description: Caesar has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Spearhead Advance]</color>. Additionally, gain the <color=#FFAF2C>Impact Formation</color> effect.
secondaryDescription: For Caesar, obstacles on the path are irrelevant. As long as she can roll over them, they're not obstacles anymore.

name: [Affinity] Nitro-Fuel Feast
description: Burnice has evoked the Mindscape: <color=#FFAF2C>[Extra at No Additional Charge]</color>. After launching a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, your character can <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with</color> certain attacks near the end of the Basic Attack combo. Additionally, she gains the <color=#FFAF2C>[Endless Refills] </color>effect.
secondaryDescription: In Burnice's world, solving problems is simple... Gather some good friends from the squad and have a lively Nitro-Fuel Feast together!

name: Sharpened Perception
description: Both enemies and allies gain a CRIT Rate bonus.
secondaryDescription: Time seems to stretch out, everyone's actions slow down, and weak points appear more obvious.

name: Sharpened Pain
description: Both enemies and allies gain a CRIT DMG bonus.
secondaryDescription: The senses grow sharper until they exceed the limits of human endurance. Everything in the world grows brittle, including yourself.

name: Radicalize
description: Both enemies and allies deal more DMG.
secondaryDescription:
You're so absorbed in attacking that no thought is given to any consequence.
It's not that you don't want to — it's just that you can't.

name: Scabbed Infection
description: Enemies gain Anomaly Buildup RES but lose Daze RES.
secondaryDescription: A highly contagious Corruption that has little to no effect on Agents, but can cause Ether on the skin to multiply and scab over. This strengthens resistance while destroying overall stability.

name: Hardening Infection
description: Enemies gain Daze RES but have their DEF reduced.
secondaryDescription: A highly contagious Corruption that has little to no effect on Agents, but can cause rapid stiffening and excess rigidity in the limbs. This strengthens resistance to Impact damage but also increases the risk of fractures.

name: Stress Infection
description: Enemy Stun duration is reduced, and Max HP is decreased.
secondaryDescription: A highly contagious Corruption that has little to no effect on Agents, but greatly boosts motor coordination and reactive functions at a cost to active energy reserves.

name: Crystal Infection
description: Enemy Stun DMG Multiplier and Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced.
secondaryDescription: A highly-contagious Corruption that has little to no effect on Agents, but causes Ether to crystallize into hard plating. This strengthens resistance to strikes and is also more conductive to elements.

name: [Freeze] Freezing Gloves
description: Triggering Ice Mark additionally increases the Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Other than keeping the wearer's hands warm, they can shoot a cold mist from the fingertips. Just make sure you aren't too close to the target when using this function. You could get frozen right along with them.

name: [Freeze] Ice Shaver
description: <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>75%</color>. When <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color> is triggered, hitting enemies increases the Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 5s.
secondaryDescription: An old-school ice crusher with a hand crank. Most people see this as less of a daily necessity item and more of a toy.

name: [Freeze] Ice Maker
description: <color=#98EFF0>Freezing</color> an enemy increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> for 15s.
secondaryDescription: Work hard turning the handle until you work up a sweat and a thirst. That's when the true value of ice cubes becomes apparent.

name: [Freeze] Portable Ice Maker
description: <color=#98EFF0>Freezing</color> an enemy grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>18</color> stacks of Ice Mark.
secondaryDescription: Pour in the water and flip the switch. Then leave the rest to it.

name: [Freeze] Freezing Spray
description: Triggering Ice Mark increases the Agent's <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Light and handy, it can reduce fever and relieve pain quickly.

name: [Freeze] Freezing Gun
description: Upon triggering <color=#98EFF0>Shatter</color>, the Agent inflicts additional Daze equal to <color=#2BAD00>200%</color> of their initial Impact on the target, if the target is not Stunned.
secondaryDescription: This deadly weapon can produce shards of ice and shoot at great distances. Think twice before using it, even in the summer.

name: [Freeze] Ice Cube Tray
description: When an Ultimate hits an enemy and deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>, the Agent gains <color=#2BAD00>48</color> stacks of Ice Mark.
secondaryDescription: A simple and easy-to-use hockey mold. The biggest challenge is how to get the puck out of the mold.

name: [Freeze] Ice Bag
description: <color=#98EFF0>Freezing</color> an enemy increases the Agent's DEF by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>, stacking up to 4 times.
secondaryDescription: A bag that once held many ice cubes, they've since all melted.

name: [Freeze] Portable Cooler
description: <color=#98EFF0>Freeze</color> lasts <color=#2BAD00>3</color>s longer.
secondaryDescription: A must-have item for professional anglers. Besides fish, there are some other strange things inside.

name: [Freeze] Ice Bucket
description: Launching an EX Special Attack grants the Agent <color=#2BAD00>12</color> stacks of Ice Mark.
secondaryDescription: An ice bucket that only graces the finest of dining tables. Any drink it holds becomes instantly fancy.

name: [Freeze] Cutie Cold Pack
description: Agent <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Everyone loves it for its ice-cold touch. It's even popular among cats and dogs.

name: [Onslaught] Claw Hammer
description: Upon triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, the Agent inflicts additional Daze equal to <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color> of Max Daze +<color=#2BAD00>150</color> Daze. This effect can only be triggered against each enemy once every 5s.
secondaryDescription: It out may not be that they lack the strength if they can't pull it out, but rather that they fear the pain.

name: [Onslaught] Utility Knife
description: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> increases the Agent's CRIT Rate by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
secondaryDescription: Pain can creep close in the subtlest of ways...

name: [Onslaught] Window Breaker
description: Launching an EX Special Attack enables the Agent's <color=#F0D12B>Physical</color> attacks to inflict <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more Daze for 15s.
secondaryDescription: Hopefully, this stuff will always stay behind an intricate little window and will never have to be used.

name: [Onslaught] Gardening Shears
description: <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> deals <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: If all you have is a pair of gardening shears, everything looks like a branch out of place.

name: [Onslaught] Lightweight Wrench
description: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> increases the Agent's CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>12%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.
secondaryDescription: These little, lightweight tools are also used as a juggling prop or makeshift throwing weapons.

name: [Onslaught] Steel File
description: Triggering Perfect Assist increases the Agent's <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> for 15s.
secondaryDescription: The term "grind" beautifully encapsulates the idea of complete and extreme destruction.

name: [Onslaught] Roller Brush
description: Each Standard [Onslaught] Resonium owned increases Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>48%</color>.
secondaryDescription: One can never truly know what a wet, sticky roller brush has just been through.

name: [Onslaught] Pitchfork
description: Launching an EX Special Attack increases Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 12s.
secondaryDescription: Once you're holding it, the urge to stab something is always irresistible... and that's where the holes in these haystacks come from.

name: [Onslaught] Lumber Axe
description: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> generates <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy for the Agent.
secondaryDescription: Once you've found the best spot for chopping, each blow will become more effortless than the last.

name: [Onslaught] Steel Handsaw
description: Triggering <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> reduces the target's ATK by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 30s.
secondaryDescription: A saw's serrated shape contributes to only 1% of its overall intimidating presence, while the remaining 99% comes from horror movies.

name: [Onslaught] Pointed Shovel
description: Agent <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Many people associate shovels with painful memories of the wooden handle bouncing off their faces when they stepped on it.

name: [Assist] Gate Breaker
description: Vital View triggered by Evasive Assist lasts <color=#2BAD00>7</color>s. Defensive Assist inflicts <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> more Daze.
secondaryDescription: Harnessing the power of inertia, this device can help break through a target's defense. Don't forget to release your grip at the right moment, or else you'll go flying off with it.

name: [Assist] Hydraulic Buffer
description: Assist Follow-Up DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>100%</color>.
secondaryDescription: During rescue operations, this device will provide a buffer for you and your teammates to make sure you don't collide with each other's bodies... or lips.

name: [Assist] HF Communicator
description: Triggering Perfect Assist generates <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> Decibels.
secondaryDescription: This device emits loud and clear sound that is perfect for communication with your teammates. Its excellent voice amplification ensures that your voice is always delivered to your teammates... and also your enemies.

name: [Assist] Ether Reaction Device
description: Triggering a Perfect Assist increases all squad members' Anomaly Buildup Rate by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: This device analyzes the Ether activity of your squad members and adjusts its algorithms accordingly to facilitate Ether integration.

name: [Assist] Impact Feedback Device
description: Triggering Perfect Assist grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Rush.
secondaryDescription: This device can absorb and store a certain amount of impact, that you can then release at precisely the right moment.

name: [Assist] Dynamic Calibration Device
description: Triggering Perfect Assist grants all squad members <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Insight.
secondaryDescription: This device ensures visual calibration while moving quickly. While it can be a real game-changer in combat, it causes great strain on the operator's optic nerves.

name: [Assist] Holographic Decoy
description: Hitting enemies with an Assist Follow-Up increases all squad members' PEN Ratio by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 15s.
secondaryDescription: This device projects illusions in all directions, disrupting its target.

name: [Assist] Activity Transfer Device
description: Triggering Perfect Assist increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: This support device, resembling a relay baton, transfers active Ether energy from a target surface to the user.

name: [Assist] Hand Operated Generator
description: Triggering Perfect Assist generates <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
secondaryDescription: This device converts kinetic energy into electric energy. In short, it generates power as long as you are running.

name: [Assist] Emergency Enhancement Device
description: Triggering Perfect Assist increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: A micro enhancement device that works on the surface of the skin. While its effect is limited and temporary, it's incredibly convenient. All you need to do is attach it to your skin like a plaster, and you're good to go.

name: [Assist] Backup Shield Generator
description: Triggering Perfect Assist grants the Agent a Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>9%</color> of their Max HP for 10s.
secondaryDescription: A portable shield generator that sacrifices some of its protection for portability. Since it only provides a very limited level of protection, some would even say you get about as much protection as picking up a trash can lid.

name: [Ether] Scrap Amplifier
description: Each point of Anomaly Proficiency increases the Agent's <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>0.3%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An operational amplifier regulates the cycling speed of the surrounding Ether. As for the malfunctioning ones... they are typically repurposed into wireless speakers.

name: [Ether] Rusty W-Engine
description: <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
secondaryDescription: When your W-Engine completely fails in the Hollow, don't hesitate to use it as a disposable throwing weapon.

name: [Ether] Net Launcher
description: Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>45%</color> more DMG to <color=#FE437E>Corrupted</color> enemies.
secondaryDescription: This device launches a special Etheric grid that temporarily reduces the Ether activity of Ethereals upon contact.

name: [Ether] Cracked Drive
description: <color=#FE437E>Corruption</color> lasts <color=#2BAD00>3</color>s longer.
secondaryDescription: A drive disc covered in cracks. Playing it despite the cracks will only produce stress-inducing noises.

name: [Ether] Suppressive Bracelet
description: Launching an EX Special Attack grants <color=#2BAD00>2</color> stacks of Activity to all squad members.
secondaryDescription:
"Ah! This bracelet just won't stop sending me alerts! It's so annoying!"
"Just take it off. See? Problem solved."

name: [Ether] Deteriorating Filter
description: Dealing <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> grants all squad members 1 stack of Activity. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>8s</color>.
secondaryDescription: Once a trendy accessory popular in New Eridu, it was later banned due to concerns about causing anxiety among the public.

name: [Ether] Invalid Adapter
description: Each Standard [Ether] Resonium owned increases Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>48%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Much like a mobile phone data cable, it connects multiple Bangboo for data connection. However, it also shares another trait with data cables: it's prone to breaking.

name: [Ether] Frozen Timer
description: Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A device used to calculate the recommended exploration duration within the Hollows. The readings are frozen at the moment of its destruction.

name: [Ether] Depleted Battery
description: Agent <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A discarded battery, its power depleted, possibly discarded by a Bangboo with a backup battery module.

name: [Ether] Broken Chip
description: Launching a Chain Attack increases all squad members' Anomaly Proficiency by <color=#2BAD00>35</color> for 15s.
secondaryDescription: A discarded broken Bangboo core chip, with its owner nowhere to be found.

name: [Ether] Faulty Jammer
description: <color=#FE437E>Corrupted</color> enemies have their ATK reduced by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A firearm modified by Hollow Raiders using Ether technology—primitive, but highly effective.

name: Super Homerun
description: No more path ahead. You have to leave the Hollow.
secondaryDescription: I wanna, I wanna go home... I don't wanna try anymore!

name: [Synergy] Feather Cat Wand
description: Launching a Bangboo Chain Attack enables the Bangboo to deal <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> more DMG for 30s.
secondaryDescription: A Bangboo-shaped cat teaser that can provoke fierce attacks from cats, provided the user is swift and diligent enough.

name: [Synergy] Jingling Bell
description: Bangboo ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for each Combat Bangboo and Ally Bangboo in your squad.
secondaryDescription:
When your pet presses it, a corresponding voice will ring out, such as "hug me," "feed me," and "play with me"...
The dog at the newsstand on Sixth Street also uses such bells, but the voice is not as sappy.

name: [Synergy] Roly-Poly Bunny
description: Bangboo Active Skill DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Everyone's hands will eventually get sore, so the tumbler always gets back up in the end.

name: [Synergy] Laser Pointer
description: Launching an Active Skill or Bangboo Chain Attack generates <color=#2BAD00>15</color> Energy for the active Agent. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
secondaryDescription: A cute laser pointer, extremely attractive to animals.

name: [Synergy] Teething Toy
description: When a Bangboo hits an enemy, Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to that enemy for 10s.
secondaryDescription: A bone-shaped teething toy that will help keep your dog's teeth clean and sharp.

name: [Synergy] Dog Frisbee
description: When an Agent launches an EX Special Attack, Bangboo CRIT Rate is increased by <color=#2BAD00>18%</color> for 10s.
secondaryDescription: Catching a Frisbee in mid-air is always an impressive feat, no matter who or what catches it.

name: [Synergy] Goldfish Hideout
description: Bangboo Chain Attack DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Hide in the little house underwater, and the fish can avoid that bossy round face outside.

name: [Synergy] Wave Cat Scratcher
description: Bangboo ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>30%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Thank you, for saving the couch from unbearable pain.

name: [Synergy] Dash Tunnel
description: Bangboo CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>36%</color>.
secondaryDescription: It takes hours to wiggle and prepare, and the dash lasts only 1 second.

name: [Synergy] Insane Running Wheel
description: Bangboo Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>45%</color>.
secondaryDescription: A hamster decides to give the wheel a spin, and soon finds itself on an uncontrollable crazy ride!

name: [Synergy] Happy Merry-Go-Round
description: Bangboo PEN Ratio increases by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: This toy is designed for three cats to play together. The ideal scenario is one cat monopolizing all three balls, while the worst-case scenario is none of the cats showing any interest.

name: [Research] Overload Distribution
description: Each Pressure Overload restores <color=#2BAD00>5%</color> of Max HP and increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>5%</color>. (Current Bonus: {CReplaceCardParam:StressOverloadCount,0.01,2}%. Maximum: 50%.) In addition, grants <color=#FFAF2C>Pressure Management</color>.
secondaryDescription:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on overload-related matters.

name: [Research] Resource Conversion
description: Every 100 Gear Coins spent increases all squad members' DMG by <color=#2BAD00>0.5%.</color> (Current Bonus: {CReplaceCardParam:DamageShow,0.1,2}%. Maximum: 50%.) In addition, grants <color=#FFAF2C>Matthew Effect</color>.
secondaryDescription:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on resource conversion-related matters.

name: [Research] Trigger Instinct
description: For every 1% of HP lost, Agent DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>1%</color>. (Current increase: Please see Resonium Details. Maximum increase: 80%) In addition, grants <color=#FFAF2C>Peak Physique</color>.
secondaryDescription:
An exquisitely designed badge.
A special Resonium issued by the White Star Institute to investigators of Hollow Zero, for research on survival instinct-related matters.

name: [Tenacity] Guiding Lantern
description: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>12%</color> more CRIT DMG.
secondaryDescription: Guides the way to hope while signaling to the hunters lurking in the shadows.

name: [Tenacity] Medical Kit
description: When an Agent is attacked, the DMG is <color=#2BAD00>shared between all squad members</color>, and the DMG is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>. When any off-field Agent has less than 10% HP, they will share DMG but not lose HP.
secondaryDescription: From large items like first-aid supplies to small items like cold medications, it all fits inside.

name: [Tenacity] Flames of Survival
description: For every 10% of HP missing, the Agent deals <color=#2BAD00>7.5%</color> more DMG.
secondaryDescription: In the depths of despair, only the light of the flame can restore one's reason and confidence.

name: [Tenacity] Cut-Resistant Gloves
description: Triggering Perfect Assist or gaining a Shield increases the Agent's DMG by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 20s.
secondaryDescription: Only the hardest gloves can handle the sharpest blades.

name: [Tenacity] Military Canteen
description: Triggering an Ultimate grants the Agent Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> of their lost HP.
secondaryDescription: A canteen with dual filtration. It not only filters outdoor freshwater into drinkable water but also reduces the risk of consuming Ether from water sources in the Hollow.

name: [Tenacity] Toothpick-sized Can
description: When attacked, if the Agent's HP is below 30%, DMG taken is reduced by <color=#2BAD00>80%</color> for 20s. This effect can only be triggered once by each Agent in each combat.
secondaryDescription: Each bite was hard to swallow, but every one of them kept hunger at bay.

name: [Tenacity] High-Pressure Insulated Boots
description:
Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> more DMG to enemies with a higher percentage HP.
Agents deal <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> more DMG to enemies with a lower percentage HP.
secondaryDescription: Extra-thick at the bottom for enhanced protection and kicking power.

name: [Tenacity] Wilderness Map
description: When an Agent is attacked or triggers Perfect Assist, the Agent restores <color=#2BAD00>8</color> Energy. This can be triggered once every 7s across all squad members.
secondaryDescription: The red crosses marked as "no entry" on the map were all earned through pain.

name: [Tenacity] Survival Kit
description: Upon entering combat, the Agent gains Shield equal to <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> of lost HP.
secondaryDescription: All preparations are made to survive.

name: [Tenacity] Emergency Flashlight
description:
When the Agent's HP is below 50%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
When HP is above 50%, DMG dealt increases by <color=#2BAD00>8%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An adjustable brightness flashlight. Save the battery by keeping it dim unless it's an emergency.

name: [Tenacity] Insulated Sleeping Bag
description: Increases Agent Max HP by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color>.
secondaryDescription: An exceptionally warm sleeping bag. No need to worry about oversleeping. When it gets too hot, you'll naturally crawl out.

name: Curse_1105001_name
description: Curse_1105001_des
secondaryDescription: Curse_1105001_story

name: Curse_1105002_name
description: Curse_1105002_des
secondaryDescription: Curse_1105002_story

name: Metabolic Trauma
description: You can no longer recover HP.
secondaryDescription: Upon touching the crystal, a peculiar Ether matter corrodes your body, hindering its internal mechanisms and destroying its recovery processes. No amount of potions or medicine has any effect.

name: Gear Allergy
description: You can no longer obtain Gear Coins.
secondaryDescription: Upon touching the crystal, your body reacts strongly to certain metal components, and unfortunately, Gear Coins also trigger this allergic reaction.

name: Delirium
description: Significantly increases gained Pressure.
secondaryDescription: Due to the influence of the active crystal, you start to experience symptoms that affect your mental state, such as hallucinations and disorientation. Having to explore the Hollow under such circumstances puts you under even more pressure...

name: Curse_1106004_name
description: Curse_1106004_des
secondaryDescription: Curse_1106004_story

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Power Up I</color>
description: Protagonist HP <color=#2BAD00>+20</color>, ATK <color=#2BAD00>+2</color>

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Healing Hands</color>
description: HP <color=#2BAD00>+2</color> when the protagonist defeats an enemy with an attack

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Power Up II</color>
description: Protagonist HP <color=#2BAD00>+20</color>, ATK <color=#2BAD00>+2</color>

name: <color=#FFAF2C>CRIT Enhancement</color>
description: When the Protagonist attacks enemies, there's a <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> chance to trigger a critical hit, dealing double DMG

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Power Boost</color>
description: Protagonist ATK <color=#2BAD00>+7</color>

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Explosive Stamina</color>
description: Immediately obtain <color=#2BAD00>8</color> bombs

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Explosion Expert</color>
description: Bombs deal <color=#2BAD00>+10</color> DMG to enemies, explosion length <color=#2BAD00>+2</color>

name: <color=#FFAF2C>High Explosives</color>
description: Protagonist gains <color=#2BAD00>+50</color> HP.

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Detonate and Dominate</color>
description: Bombs will <color=#FFAF2C>explode immediately</color>. Protagonist ATK <color=#2BAD00>+1</color> when detonating a bomb

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Blast Suit</color>
description: <color=#2BAD00>Take no DMG from detonations, instead recovering 5 HP</color>

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Legacy Inheritance</color>
description: When taking DMG, generate 1 – 2 <color=#2BAD00>Gear Coin Tiles of 50 coins</color>.

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Shop Revamp</color>
description: Shopkeeper ATK <color=#FFAF2C>+20</color>, <color=#FFAF2C>number of items for sale is doubled</color> in the shop

name: <color=#FFAF2C>Windfall</color>
description: Automatically <color=#FFAF2C>spend HP to purchase</color> items upon running out of coins, for <color=#CF4029>1</color> HP per 50 coins

name: Relic_name_S2test_1320001
description: Triggering Perfect Dodge generates 6 Energy for the Agent. This effect can trigger once every <color=#2BAD00>10s</color>.
secondaryDescription: This orange juice is popular among girls. Each can packs the nutritional punch of thirty oranges. "We carefully choose only the finest oranges. One of ours is as good as ten of another kind. That means with just three oranges, you're getting the nutrients of thirty!"

name: [Ultimate] Healing Sachet
description: <color=#2BAD00>Decibels limit is increased to 6,000</color> for all squad members.

name: [Ultimate] Rhythmic Energy Saver
description: <color=#2BAD00>Reduces the Decibels required to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> to 2,000</color>.

name: Relic_1320103_name
description: <color=#2BAD00>Decibels limit is increased to 6,000</color> for all squad members.

name: [Dexterity] Talisman of Five Realms
description: When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>gain 1 Dexterity Count</color>, stacking up to 3 times. With 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Count</color>, consume all stacks to <color=#2BAD00>enter Dexterity State</color>, lasting 9s. While in <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity State</color>, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>ATK is increased by 60%</color>. When an attack hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> on the target. <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> is calculated when exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity State</color>, dealing <color=#2BAD00>additional DMG equal to 10% of DMG accumulated</color> during <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> to enemies.

name: [Dexterity] Zone Energy Shield
description: When in combat, all squad members <color=#2BAD00>gain 1 Dexterity Charge</color> (up to 32) every 0.5s. When taking DMG and losing HP, all <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Charge</color> will be consumed. When Dexterity Charge consumed is greater or equal to 8/16/24, <color=#2BAD00>Dexterity State</color> will last for 2/4/8s. With 32 <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Charge</color>, all Charge is consumed when an enemy is hit, <color=#2BAD00>entering Dexterity State</color> for 16s. In <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity State</color>, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>ATK is increased by 60%</color>. When an attack hits an enemy, <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> is inflicted on the target. <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color> is calculated when exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity State</color>, dealing <color=#2BAD00>additional DMG to enemies equal to 10% of DMG accumulated</color> during <color=#FFFFFF>Dexterity Curse</color>.

name: [Anomaly - Stun] Solvent Launcher
description: <color=#2BAD00>Daze caused by all squad members is increased by 10%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency is increased by 30</color>. When Stunning or inflicting Attribute Anomaly on enemies, triggers an additional strike, <color=#2BAD00>dealing DMG equal to 1,100% of the Agent's ATK</color> to the target and the surrounding enemies.

name: [Anomaly - Stun] Essence Pill
description: When Stunning or inflicting <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> on an enemy, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>randomly draws 3 to 6 times from the following 6 buffs</color>, with each buff stacking up to 6 times: Energy Regen increased by 0.02 pts/s, DEF increased by 4%, DMG taken reduced by 2%, Impact increased by 2%, Anomaly Proficiency increased by 3, and Decibel Generation Rate increased by 3%.

name: [Adversity] Combat Nutrient Pack
description: When an attack hits an enemy, the Agent enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Bloodfury</color> state for 2s. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Bloodfury</color> state, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>deals 75% increased DMG</color> and <color=#2BAD00>takes 10% reduced DMG</color>. <color=#CF4029>1% of the Agent's HP is consumed per sec</color> when their current HP is higher than 20%.

name: [Adversity] Emblem of Calamity
description: When the Agent's HP drops from above 20% to below 20%, the Agent <color=#2BAD00>gains a shield equal to 20% of their Max HP</color>.

name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Awakening of the Bees
description: Replaces <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Fuyubachi</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Fuyubachi — Maximum</color>. Upon activating this skill, Hoshimi Miyabi will <color=#2BAD00>dash forward</color> and deal <color=#98EFF0>Frost DMG</color> to enemies. After the skill is replaced, when Hoshimi Miyabi is knocked back or launched, using Basic Attack or Special Attack while a target is staggered will <color=#2BAD00>immediately trigger</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Fuyubachi — Maximum</color>, <color=#2BAD00>restoring 70% of the DMG she just received in HP and granting invulnerability for 0.5s</color>.

name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Dance of the Sparrows
description: When Hoshimi Miyabi is attacked by an enemy, she will <color=#2BAD00>automatically dodge the attack</color>, triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> lasts for 3s. The automatic dodge effect can trigger once every 12s. When the effect is triggered, Hoshimi Miyabi's <color=#2BAD00>DMG is increased by 80%</color>, lasting for 20s.

name: [Hoshimi Miyabi] Sparrows in the Flowers
description: After Hoshimi Miyabi activates <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Kan Suzume</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Dancing Petals</color>, she will <color=#2BAD00>automatically chain into the ALT</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Storm</color>, <color=#2BAD00>unleashing a blast of air to attack nearby enemies and inflicting a substantial amount of Daze</color>. When the enemy is Stunned, Hoshimi Miyabi gains 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Fallen Frost</color>, and the target's <color=#2BAD00>Stun DMG Multiplier is increased by 75%</color>.

name: [Billy] Explosive Bullets
description: Replaces <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full Firepower</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Full Firepower - Modified</color>. This <color=#2BAD00>decreases the rate of fire to increase bullet power</color>. Upon activating this skill, Billy will <color=#2BAD00>directly enter Crouching Shot</color>, triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Steady Shot</color> and <color=#2BAD00>increasing his DMG dealt by an additional 50%</color>. The buff will end when he moves, returns to idle, or is knocked back or launched.

name: [Billy] Rotating Drivetrain
description: When Billy uses his <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, he <color=#2BAD00>gains 2/2/4/4 stacks of Charge</color> (up to 4 stacks). When Billy performs a piercing attack in a large area around him during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Sanction</color>, press Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>consume 1 stack of Charge</color> and trigger the skill repeatedly, <color=#2BAD00>increasing its DMG by 150%</color>. When the effect is triggered, Billy's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate increases by 20%</color> for 10s. The effect stacks up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Billy] Mysterious Transmorpher
description: When Billy enters <color=#FFFFFF>Crouching Shot</color> during his Basic Attack, he triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Core Passive: Steady Shot</color>. After maintaining the buff for 1.5 seconds, he enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Descent</color> state, during which his attacks <color=#2BAD00>ignore 50%</color> of the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. Additionally, he <color=#2BAD00>continuously generates Decibels</color>, <color=#2BAD00>starting at 20 points/second and gradually increasing to 50 points/second</color>, reaching the maximum after 3 seconds. This effect lasts until he is knocked back or launched.

name: {AWAKEN_1191#[Ellen] Blade of Frost: Advanced}{NOAWAKEN_1191#[Ellen] Blade of Frost}
description: {AWAKEN_1191#<color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> will also automatically activate after the third hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Saw Teeth Trimming</color> or a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, dealing multiple hits of <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to enemies in a large area ahead. <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> <color=#2BAD00>reduces DEF by 30%</color> for 15s upon hit. When the additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> is triggered, the skill's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 25%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.}{NOAWAKEN_1191#The 3rd hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sharknami</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Reef Rock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color> <color=#2BAD00>trigger an additional Icy Blade</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enemies in a large area in front</color> and <color=#2BAD00>reducing their DEF by 30%</color>. When the additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> is triggered, the skill's <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 25%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blades</color> don't affect the original skill's alts.}

name: [Ellen] Dangerous Bearings
description: When <color=#FFFFFF>Roaming</color>, Ellen gains 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Charge</color> every 0.5 sec. When Ellen hits an enemy with Swift Scissors or Charged Scissor Strike during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>leaves an Icy Mist on the ground</color>, which deals <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG over time</color> to enemies and <color=#98EFF0>reduces their Ice RES</color> by 30% for 10s. Ellen's <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt level increases</color> and she <color=#2BAD00>gains 50% DMG reduction</color> while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>. This effect continues for 5s after leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>.

name: [Ellen] Hunter's Fin
description: Every 15s, Ellen applies a <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> mark that lasts for 15s to a random enemy. When hitting an enemy marked with <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or Swift Scissors/Charged Scissor Strike during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, using Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or Special Attack <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again allows Ellen to <color=#2BAD00>consume nothing</color> and <color=#2BAD00>immediately trigger the skill again</color> with <color=#2BAD00>its CRIT DMG increased by 25%</color>. If the target is defeated, Ellen will instantly apply a <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> mark to the next enemy. When she has <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color>, each extra point of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases Ellen's ATK by 5%</color>. This effect lasts for 10s and stacks up to 9 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Soaring Moonlight
description: During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten</color>, after performing a quick thrust, Tsukishiro Yanagi hovers in midair, <color=#2BAD00>continuously channeling thunderbolt strikes into the ground</color>, and dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color>. Tsukishiro Yanagi triggers the downward smash from <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten</color> by releasing or pressing Special Attack <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> again, or when the duration limit is reached. When her thunderbolt strikes hit enemies, it <color=#2BAD00>increases the Disorder DMG they take by 3%</color>, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Gekka Ruten</color>'s heavy attack hits enemies, Tsukishiro Yanagi gains shield equal to 20% of her Max HP, lasting 20s, triggering up to once per 20s.

name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Kagura's Dance
description: While triggering the fifth move of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> in the <color=#FFFFFF>Jougen</color> stance or triggering the fourth move of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> in the <color=#FFFFFF>Kagen</color> stance, repeatedly press or hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>extend the skill duration</color>, slash continuously, and increase <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> dealt by Tsukishiro Yanagi by 4%, stacking up to 15 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. During consecutive slashes, DMG taken by Tsukishiro Yanagi is <color=#2BAD00>reduced by 40%</color>, and after triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, pressing Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> <color=#2BAD00>transitions to continuous slashes of the alternate stance</color>.

name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Flowing Reflection
description: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Ruten</color>, Tsukishiro Yanagi <color=#2BAD00>gains 1 Charge</color> (max. 3 stacks). Upon reaching 3 Charges and triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, press Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>consume all Charges</color> and <color=#2BAD00>immediately follow up with Chain Attack: Celestial Harmony</color>. If an enemy attack is successfully parried during <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, following up with <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Celestial Harmony</color> <color=#2BAD00>will not consume any Charge</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Celestial Harmony</color>'s DMG will increase by 50%.

name: [Mobile] Imperial Decree: Dark Banner
description: When the active character lands a heavy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> for the next character. Press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> at this moment, and the next character will perform a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> centered on the enemy. <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> won't switch the current active character, and the damage dealt is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG. When a character performs a <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, it provides 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Comrade</color> to the whole squad, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Comrade</color> increases <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency by 20</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate by 10%</color> for <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> specialty Agents; increases <color=#2BAD00>Impact by 4%</color> for Stun specialty Agents; increases <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate by 5%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG by 10%</color> for Attack specialty Agents; increases <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate by 7.5%</color> for Support specialty Agents; increases <color=#2BAD00>shield efficiency by 10%</color> for Defense specialty Agents; and increases <color=#2BAD00>Sheer DMG by 7%</color> for Rupture specialty Agents.

name: [Mobile] Shatter Blade's Cry
description: When the active character lands a heavy attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, or triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> for the next character. Press <IconMap:Icon_Switch> at this moment, and the next character will perform a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> centered on the enemy. <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> won't switch the current active character and the damage dealt is considered <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG. <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> deals <color=#2BAD00>200% increased DMG, 50% increased Daze, and 100% increased Anomaly Buildup</color>. After the squad performs 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assists</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color> will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>.
