name: Astra Yao - Radiant Moment
description: For every 25 Energy consumed, Astra Yao gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, up to 3 stacks. During <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color>, continuously channeling an energy beam to attack enemies. Upon activating this skill, <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> will be consumed, with each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> <color=#2BAD00>extending the skill duration by 1s</color>. During this skill, <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level is increased</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>DMG taken is further reduced by 20%</color>. When the skill hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>target's DEF is reduced by 40%</color>. After gaining 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, switching back to Astra Yao will automatically trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color>.

name: Astra Yao - Hollow Symphony
description: For every 25 Energy consumed, Astra Yao gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases the DMG dealt by <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> by 15% when released and additionally released while she is in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state</color>. Holding <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to perform <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Finale</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color> consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>. Each stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases the attack's DMG</color> by 15% and <color=#2BAD00>restores 4 Energy</color> to Astra Yao. When Astra Yao hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color>, an additional 25 Energy will be consumed. When hitting enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>, <color=#2BAD00>an additional 4 Energy will be restored</color>.

name: Astra Yao - Harmonic Echo
description: During <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color>, <color=#2BAD00>increases CRIT Rate of all squad members by 20%</color>. When CRIT Rate reaches 100%, each 1% over 100% will <color=#2BAD00>increase CRIT DMG by 2%</color>, up to 100%. When the active character hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Astra Yao will <color=#2BAD00>recover 1 Energy</color> and <color=#2BAD00>launch an additional <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack</color>. This effect can trigger once every 1s.

name: Evelyn - Low-Combustion Coating
description: When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, it will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Entanglement</color>, significantly reducing skill duration. When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>the attack's DMG increases by 80%</color>.

name: Evelyn - Portable Detonator
description: When Evelyn exits <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, she enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ignite Preparation</color> for 20s, during which the next <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush</color> will be replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Ambush Blast</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Ambush Blast</color> <color=#2BAD00>is considered a Chain Attack</color>. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote</color>, <color=#2BAD00>she will exit Binding Seal</color>.

name: Evelyn - Ultimate Contingency Protocol
description: When Evelyn is about to be staggered by a frontal attack, she will consume <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Point</color> to <color=#2BAD00>automatically trigger Defensive Assist</color>, blocking enemy attacks and enabling an ALT <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up: Course Disruption</color>. When Evelyn activates <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 50%</color>, stacking up to 2 times for 20 seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

name: Jane - Phantom Armor
description: Significantly increases the <color=#2BAD00>sustained attack duration</color> of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>. Triggering a Finishing Move when about to be attacked activates <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>. When the sustained attack duration reaches maximum or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered by a Finishing Move, the Finishing Move will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>Salchow Jump: Airborne</color>. When this skill is activated, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> is <color=#2BAD00>increased by 50%</color> for 10s.

name: Jane - Boiling Predatory Instinct
description: When triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> or activating a <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> is <color=#2BAD00>greatly increased</color>, replacing the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> state with the <color=#FFFFFF>Overload Passion</color> state. In this state, Jane's <color=#2BAD00>ATK is additionally increased by 35%</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color> will automatically decrease over time, and hitting enemies with attacks <color=#2BAD00>no longer consumes</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Passion Stream</color>.

name: Jane - Venomous Edge
description: During the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Overload Passion</color> state, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep-Onslaught</color>. When using this skill, Jane will re-enter the <color=#FFFFFF>Passion</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Overload Passion</color> state. When this skill hits enemies, the target's <color=#2BAD00>All Anomaly Buildup RES is reduced by 40%</color> for 15s.

name: Corin - Chainsaw Operation Manual
description: Replace <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy!</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy! - Modified</color>. Hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to maintain sprint mode, ending when the chainsaw has continuously slashed enemies 30 times or when the button is released.

name: Corin - Overload Driver
description: During <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, holding <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack</color> <IconMap:Icon_SpecialReady> to continuously slash enemies for over 0.5 seconds will trigger the <color=#FFFFFF>Overclock State</color>, <color=#2BAD00>continuously gathering enemies</color>. When the attack hits enemies 10 times, it will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Overclock Overload</color>, <color=#2BAD00>additionally dealing one instance of</color> <color=#ELEMENT_PHYSiCS>Physical DMG</color> <color=#2BAD00>equivalent to 400% of Corin's ATK</color>.

name: Corin - Blasting Blowers
description: During the 1st, 2nd and 3rd hits of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, repeatedly press or hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>directly trigger the 4th hit of the Basic Attack</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>unleash a high-speed swirling slash towards enemies in front</color>.

name: Artifact_name_S2test_1330001
description: Increases Agent CRIT DMG by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
secondaryDescription: Smart ignition and precision blasts. How far it explodes all depends on how far you throw it.

name: Uproar of Decibels
description: All squad members' <color=#CF4029>Energy Generation Rate is reduced by 15%</color>, while <color=#2BAD00>Decibel Generation Rate is increased by 25%</color>.

name: Overlocked Dexterity Mode
description: All squad members' <color=#2BAD00>ATK increases by 30%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 40%</color>. When taking DMG and losing HP, <color=#CF4029>this buff is removed</color>. Effect is reset upon entering the next area.

name: Face of Chaos and Anomalies
description: All squad members' <color=#CF4029>ATK is reduced by 15%</color>. When Stunning or inflicting Attribute Anomaly on enemies, all squad members' <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG is increased by 40%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency is increased by 40</color> for 20s.

name: Will to Overcome Adversity
description:
When the Agent's HP is above 80%, <color=#CF4029>DMG dealt decreases by 40%</color>.
When HP is below 50%, <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt increases by 40%</color>.
When HP is below 20%, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate increases by an additional 15%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by an additional 30%</color>.

name: Nitro-Fuel Sharing Pack
description: Agents <color=#CF4029>take 20% increased DMG</color>, but no longer consume <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> when activating <color=#FFFFFF>Defensive Assist</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Evasive Assist</color>.

name: Navigation Data Set
description: Gain <color=#2BAD00>3</color> Navigation Data, which can be used to <color=#2BAD00>reset navigation</color> at Friendly Talk with Marlene.

name: Locator Card: Finance
description: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map that is <color=#2BAD00>related to Gear Coins</color>.

name: Locator Card: Shortcut
description: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map with the <color=#2BAD00>shortest route</color>.

name: Locator Card: Power
description: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map <color=#2BAD00>related to Challenge</color>.

name: Locator Card: Curse
description: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map <color=#2BAD00>related to Price Difference</color>.

name: Locator Card: Serendipity
description: You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to an area map <color=#2BAD00>related to Encounter Events</color>.

name: Locator Card: Mist Breaker
description:
You can perform <color=#2BAD00>1 Oriented Iteration</color> with Marlene in Friendly Talk to refresh the map to one with <color=#2BAD00>Mist</color> areas.
For every Mist area entered in the current Hollow, all squad members' ATK increases by <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 20%</color>, and Anomaly Proficiency increases by <color=#2BAD00>20</color>.

name: "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun
description:
A machine gun can be implanted on Tully's chest, firing out <color=#E48600>powerful projectiles</color>, but with a <color=#E48600>limited magazine capacity</color>. After firing all bullets in the magazine, it will <color=#E48600>reload</color>, and once reloaded can <color=#E48600>continue attacking</color>.

With each <color=#E48600>reload</color>, Tully will load projectiles corresponding to an attribute type of a randomly selected Agent in the squad.

Can be upgraded using <color=#E48600>Projectile Dreamland Resonium</color> obtained from the <color=#E48600>modification workshop</color>.

name: "Dreamland Equipment" Fireworks Dual Box
description:
Missile pods that can be installed on Tully's shoulders that will launch <color=#E48600>auto-tracking missiles</color> that automatically fire a small number of missiles at intervals during combat.

When an Agent activates their <color=#E48600>EX Special Attack</color>, it will use <color=#E48600>Maximum Firepower</color> to launch a massive missile barrage.

Can be upgraded using <color=#E48600>Shadow Pursuit Dreamland Resonium</color> obtained from the <color=#E48600>modification workshop</color>.

name: "Dreamland Equipment" Glimmering Whiskers
description:
Can modify Tully's ears into laser emitters that shoot out <color=#E48600>destructive energy beams</color> from their tips. When enemies suffer an <color=#E48600>Attribute Anomaly</color> or become <color=#E48600>Stunned</color>, it uses <color=#E48600>Enhanced Energy Beam</color> to fire a sustained laser attack. When the energy beam hits an enemy, it applies the Weaken effect, increasing the damage they receive.
Can be upgraded using <color=#E48600>Sharp Edge Dreamland Resonium</color> obtained from the <color=#E48600>modification workshop</color>.

description: When hitting an enemy, "Dreamland Equipment" Meteor Blazing Gun's <color=#FFAF2C>DMG to the target is increased by 0.5% per Rank per 10 stacks</color>, stacking up to 50 times.

repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Billy] Paintball Round
description: When Billy activates <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>/<color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, he <color=#2BAD00>gains 1/2/2/4 stacks of Charge</color>, stacking up to 4 times. When Billy performs a piercing attack in a large area around him during <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Sanction</color>, press Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>consume 1 stack of Charge</color> and trigger the skill repeatedly. Upon hit <color=#2BAD00>the enemy's DEF is reduced by 4%</color> for 12s, stacking up to 12 times, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Ellen] Arctic Hunt
description: Every 15s, Ellen applies a <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> mark that lasts for 15 to a random enemy. When hitting an enemy marked with <color=#FFFFFF>Hunting</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or Swift Scissors/Charged Scissor Strike from <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush</color>, pressing Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> or Special Attack <IconMap:Icon_Special> allows Ellen to <color=#2BAD00>immediately trigger the skill again</color> with <color=#2BAD00>no cost or other requirements</color>. When she obtains <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color>, each excess point of <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charge</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases Ellen's ATK by 12%</color>. This effect lasts for 10s and stacks up to 9 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

name: [Ellen] Icy Blade Execution
description: {AWAKEN_1191#<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Icy Blade</color> DMG Multiplier significantly increases: After launching <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Shark Sentinel</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe</color>, <color=#2BAD00>Basic Attack: Icy Blade will be automatically launched</color> to deal <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enemies in front in a large area</color> and reduces the target's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 40%</color>, lasting 8s. While launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Icy Blade</color>, Ellen will obtain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>.}{NOAWAKEN_1191#After activating <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Shark Sentinel</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sharknami</color>, an <color=#2BAD00>Icy Blade will be automatically unleashed</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enemies in a large area ahead</color> and <color=#2BAD00>reducing the target's DEF by 40</color>, lasting 8s. When the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> activates, Ellen gains 3<color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>; The additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> does not affect the branch or form of the original skill.}

name: [Ellen] Mist Tide Resurgence
description: When launching an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Ellen <color=#2BAD00>leaves behind a patch of Icy Mist</color> on the ground, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG over time</color> for 15s. Friendly Agents have <color=#2BAD00>increased Anti-Interrupt Level</color> and <color=#2BAD00>their DMG received reduced by 30%</color> in the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>. Upon leaving the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>, the effect continues for 5s. When Ellen attacks an enemy within the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color>, an extra instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Mist</color> DMG will be triggered.

name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Moonlit Clarity
description: When using the fifth attack of the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> combo in the <color=#FFFFFF>Jougen</color> Stance or the fourth attack of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> in the <color=#FFFFFF>Kagen</color> Stance, repeatedly press or hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>reactivate the slash</color> up to 4 times. Each reactivation <color=#2BAD00>increases</color> the <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> dealt by Tsukishiro Yanagi <color=#2BAD00>by 12.5%</color>, stacking up to 4 times and lasting 8s and repeated triggers reset the duration. During the reactivated slashes, Tsukishiro Yanagi <color=#2BAD00>takes 40% less DMG</color>. After activating <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Ruten</color>, press Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>quickly follow up with the reactived slashes of the other Stance</color>.

name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Awakening Moonlight
description: When squadmates inflict Attribute Anomaly on enemies, it can trigger Tsukishiro Yanagi's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> once every 6s. After triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> in this way, Tsukishiro Yanagi will hover in the air and <color=#2BAD00>continuously guide down lightning strike attacks</color>, dealing <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> with relatively high <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly Buildup Rate</color>.

name: [Tsukishiro Yanagi] Moonblade Shadow Pursuit
description: When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>, Tsukishiro Yanagi gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Shadow Pursuit</color>, stacking up to 3 times. When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, if Tsukishiro Yanagi has <color=#FFFFFF>Shadow Pursuit</color>, it will automatically consume 1 stack to execute 1 instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Graceful Dance</color> against the enemy. <color=#FFFFFF>Graceful Dance</color> is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> and can be triggered once every 1s.

name: [Jane] Phantasm Strike
description: <color=#2BAD00>Significantly increases the continuous attack duration</color> of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Salchow Jump</color>. Triggering the Finishing Move when there is an incoming attack activates <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>. When the continuous attack duration reaches maximum or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color> is triggered by the Finishing Move, the Finishing Move will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>Salchow Jump - Airborne</color>. When this skill is activated, own <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases by 70%</color> for 15s.

name: [Jane] Encircle and Hunt
description: <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep</color> will be enhanced to <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aerial Sweep - Onslaught</color>. When this skill hits an enemy, it inflicts <color=#FFFFFF>Wound</color>. This state causes the affected target to take <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> equal to 60% of Jane's ATK every second and accumulate <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly Buildup</color>, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Jane] Playful Pursuit
description: When other squad members trigger <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color>, Jane will launch an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> centered around the target enemy. This DMG will be treated as <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.

name: [Corin] Speed-Cleaning Technique
description: During the 1st, 2nd and 3rd hits of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, repeatedly press or hold Basic Attack <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to <color=#2BAD00>directly follow up with the 4th hit of the Basic Attack</color> and launch a <color=#2BAD00>high-speed spin slash at enemies</color> ahead, and when Corin triggers a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 20 Energy</color> once per 10s.

name: [Corin] Tea Break Time
description: Corin's <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> are replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy! - Modified</color>. Hold the <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> button to maintain sprint state, which ends after hitting enemies 30 times with consecutive chainsaw slashes or upon releasing the button. <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Oopsy-Daisy! - Modified</color> will <color=#2BAD00>reduce enemy DEF by 3%</color> when it hits, stacking up to 10 times and lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: BranchRelic_13500530_name
description: BranchRelic_13500530_des

name: [Astra Yao] Rainbow Concerto
description: During <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state, characters with <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> specialty gain <color=#2BAD00>30% increased CRIT DMG</color>, characters with <color=#FFFFFF>Anomaly</color> specialty gain <color=#2BAD00>60 increased Anomaly Proficiency</color>, and characters with Rupture specialty deal <color=#2BAD00>15% increased Sheer DMG</color>. When the active character hits enemies with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#2BAD00>Astra Yao will recover 4 Energy</color> and <color=#2BAD00>perform an additional attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color></color>. The Energy recovery effect can trigger once per second.

name: [Astra Yao] Crimson Beats
description: With enough energy, releasing or following up with a <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> attack while in the <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color> state will <color=#2BAD00>additionally deal two instances</color> of identical <color=#FFFFFF>Tremolo</color> DMG. When Astra Yao hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>, there's a 20% chance to gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Inspiration</color> effect, allowing her next <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge</color> to <color=#2BAD00>directly trigger</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, which can be followed up with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color>, lasting 30s.

name: [Astra Yao] Starfall Waltz
description: For every 25 Energy consumed, Astra Yao gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, up to 3 stacks. During <color=#FFFFFF>Idyllic Cadenza</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to unleash <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color>, continuously channeling an energy beam to attack enemies. Upon activating this skill, <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color> will be consumed, and with each stack consumed <color=#2BAD00>the skill duration will extend by 1s</color>. During this skill, <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level is increased</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>DMG taken is further reduced by 20%</color>. When the skill hits enemies, the <color=#2BAD00>target's DEF is reduced by 20%</color> for 30s. With 3 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight</color>, switching back to Astra Yao will automatically trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Radiant Moment</color>. When Astra Yao's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Interlude</color> hits enemies, it will consume 25 additional Energy, and when <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Chorus</color> hits enemies, it will <color=#2BAD00>restore 5 additional Energy</color>.

name: [Evelyn] Gilded Spiral Edge
description: When Evelyn exits <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Seal</color>, she enters <color=#FFFFFF>Ignite Preparation</color> for 30s, during which the next <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush</color> will be replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Ambush Blast</color>. <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Ambush Blast</color> <color=#2BAD00>is considered a Chain Attack</color>. When Evelyn uses <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote</color>, <color=#2BAD00>she will exit Binding Seal</color>.

name: [Evelyn] Lethal Etiquette
description: When any squad member's <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> hits enemies, Evelyn recovers <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>. When Evelyn consumes <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Tether Point</color> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare</color>, it will be replaced by <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Lunalux - Entanglement</color>, significantly reducing skill duration. When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> hits enemies, <color=#2BAD00>the attack's DMG increases by 80%</color>.

name: [Evelyn] Rogue Flames
description: When Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Garrote</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>'s heavy attacks hit enemies, they apply a <color=#FFFFFF>Burst</color> mark that lasts 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When other squad members' attacks hit an enemy with a <color=#FFFFFF>Burst</color> mark, they deal an additional instance of <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> equal to 370% of Evelyn's ATK and recover 20% of Evelyn's <color=#FFFFFF>Burning Embers</color>, once per 2s. After 3 instances of additional DMG are triggered, the enemy's <color=#FFFFFF>Burst</color> mark is removed.

name: [Yixuan] Phoenix Shadow
description: When Yixuan is attacked by enemies, she will automatically dodge the attack, trigger Vital View and leave the Grand Tai Chi Formation in place. Press Basic Attack to chain into Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption. The automatic dodge effect can trigger once every 12s.

name: [Yixuan] Resonance of the Spirit
description: Replace Quick Assist with EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break. When Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption hits an enemy or after launching EX Special Attack and Ultimate, Yixuan's <color=#2BAD00>Sheer DMG additionally increases by 20%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Yixuan] Gold Talisman of Mystic Feathers
description: While charging EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation, Perfect Block can be triggered, after which additionally restores 15 Technique Points and gains <color=#2BAD00>18% DMG boost</color> that lasts for 15s. Each Perfect Block against an enemy increases the next Ultimate <color=#2BAD00>DMG by 20%</color>, stacking up to 3 times.

name: [Ju Fufu] Mountain King Banishes Evil
description: After Ju Fufu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>, if she is not the currently active character, it will trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Tag Assist</color>, performing the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> around enemies. The skill's DMG is considered <color=#2BAD00>Aftershock DMG</color>. <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt increases by 75%</color> and <color=#2BAD00>Daze dealt increased by 45%</color>.

name: [Ju Fufu] Call of Wind and Thunder
description: After Ju Fufu activates <color=#FFFFFF>Offensive Assist</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she can quickly chain into the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> and enhance this skill, increasing the <color=#2BAD00>Daze dealt by 60%</color> and triggering an additional strike equivalent to the 4th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> after the skill ends.

name: [Ju Fufu] Tiger Spirit Talisman
description:
When Ju Fufu's 3rd <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> sequence hits an enemy, she <color=#2BAD00>gains 3 Might</color>.
After executing the 4th <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color> sequence, pressing Basic Attack again will trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw - Blazing Will</color>. If Hu Wei is present at this time and <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> is above 100, it will consume 100 <color=#FFFFFF>Might</color> to trigger Hu Wei's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron</color>.

name: [Alice] Duelist's Etiquette
description: When Alice lands a hit on the enemy with the 5th hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she accumulates <color=#FFFFFF>Marks</color> on hit targets. When she attacks an enemy with full <color=#FFFFFF>Marks</color>, all <color=#FFFFFF>Marks</color> are consumed to trigger the special <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> effect, <color=#F0D12B>Polarity Assault</color>. This ignores Anomaly Buildup to deal one instance of DMG equal to 100% of the original <color=#F0D12B>Assault</color> DMG. This can also interact with other Attribute Anomalies, including Physical Attribute Anomaly, to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color>.

name: [Alice] Swiftblade Spin
description: Alice's <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> are replaced with <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Featherblade</color>. When Alice uses <color=#FFFFFF>Swift Featherblade</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency increases by 150</color> for 15s.

name: [Alice] Aurora Ensemble
description: When Alice uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Northern Cross</color>, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00> CRIT Rate increases by 10%</color>, and their <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 20%</color> for 20s. When she uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Aurora Thrust - Southern Cross</color>, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 35%</color>, and their <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Proficiency increases by 50</color> for 20s.

name: [Yuzuha] Shaman's Charm
description: When Yuzuha uses her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Mastery increases by 40</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. She also reduces the enemy's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 18%</color> and their <color=#2BAD00>All-Attribute RES by 15%</color> for 30s on hit. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Yuzuha] Secret Technique: Umbrella Smash!
description: After <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, or the fifth hit of a <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to make Yuzuha perform <color=#FFFFFF>Umbrella Smash</color>. When this attack lands a heavy attack on enemies affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Sweet Scare</color>, it unleashes one <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max</color> attack, <color=#2BAD00>increases her ATK by 20%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00> increases her Anomaly Buildup Rate by 30%</color> for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Yuzuha will also gain a <color=#FFFFFF>Sugar Point</color> when she lands a hit on the enemy with the fifth hit of her <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack</color>.

name: [Yuzuha] Tanukis Abound
description: When Yuzuha uses <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Assist</color> or launches a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the whole squad gains 5 Energy and 160 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 12s. When she lands a heavy attack on the enemy with <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>DMG increases by 15%</color> for 20s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. It also triggers the <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> of the previous character. This <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> is upgraded to a Chain Attack. This effect can trigger once every 12s.

name: [Lucia] Dream Surge
description:
When Lucia upgrades a skill or uses an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Surge</color>, stacking up to 4 times.
Upon exiting <color=#FFFFFF>Dream</color> state, all <color=#FFFFFF>Surge</color> will be consumed with each stack consumed <color=#2BAD00>restoring 10 Energy for herself</color>.

name: [Lucia] Full Nocturne
description: The <color=#FFFFFF>Starlight Convergence</color> created by Lucia during her <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> covers a larger area and <color=#2BAD00>its duration increases to 20s</color>. When using <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color>, <color=#2BAD00>gain 200 additional Decibels</color>.

name: [Lucia] Spectral Focus
description: When entering the battlefield, Lucia <color=#2BAD00>gains ATK equal to 3% of her base Max HP</color>, and her <color=#FFFFFF>Harmony</color> <color=#2BAD00>deals 40% increased Ether DMG</color> to enemies.

name: [Yidhari] Piercing Light
description: When Yidhari performs a 3-stage charged attack with <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color>, she gains <color=#FFFFFF>Temporary Shield</color> each time she hits an enemy during the spinning horizontal attack. When Yidhari performs the final downward smash of this <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace</color> sequence, or when she performs an ALT <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush</color> during the charged attack ALT, all <color=#FFFFFF>Temporary Shield</color> will be consumed to <color=#2BAD00>increase the attack's DMG by up to 240%</color> based on the amount of <color=#FFFFFF>Temporary Shield</color> consumed. The Temporary Shield <color=#2BAD00>caps at 80% of Yidhari's Max HP.</color> All <color=#FFFFFF>Temporary Shield</color> will be reset if the spinning horizontal attack is interrupted.

name: [Yidhari] Biting Frost
description: When Yidhari consumes Adrenaline to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, she gains 4 stacks of <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Coil</color>: When <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attacks</color> hit an enemy, consume <color=#FFFFFF>Frost Coil</color> to attack the target enemy. This effect can only be triggered once per 1s.

name: [Yidhari] Dreamweaver's Heart
description: When Yidhari becomes the active character in combat, she immediately activates <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> (can only be triggered once per 180s). <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 15s longer</color>, and during <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil: Wellspring</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Sheer Force is increased by 800</color>.

name: [Dialyn] Deathrattle Toll
description: When Dialyn has 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> points, using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Get Lost!</color> will consume 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> and directly replace it with <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Service Stopped for Number Dialed</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Service Stopped for Number Dialed</color> hits a Stunned enemy, it will <color=#2BAD00>trigger the Totalize effect, dealing additional DMG equal to 2,700% of Dialyn's ATK</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Service Stopped for Number Dialed</color>'s <color=#2BAD00>DMG will increase by 30%</color>.

name: [Dialyn] Ringing Aftertone
description: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rock</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Scissors</color>, there's a 50% chance to gain 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Charge</color>, up to a maximum of 2 <color=#FFFFFF>Charge</color>. When activating <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Charge</color>, 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Charge</color> can be consumed to activate <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Paper!</color> again.

name: [Dialyn] Dying Descent
description: When dropping below 90 <color=#FFFFFF>Positive Reviews</color> from above 90, immediately <color=#2BAD00>restore 60 Positive Reviews</color> and <color=#2BAD00>restore teammate's Decibels by 750</color>. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

name: [Banyue] Sever Attachment
description: When not in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, after Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. Banyue's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> deals <color=#2BAD00>60% increased</color> Sheer DMG.

name: [Banyue] The Way of Asura
description: When Banyue uses <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color>, he gains a shield <color=#2BAD00>equal to 35% of his Max HP</color>, lasting 30s. This effect can trigger once every 30s. While shielded, Banyue's <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level increases</color> and <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> <color=#2BAD00>increases by 15%</color>.

name: [Banyue] Scorching Karma
description: For each 1 Energy or Adrenaline other squad members consume, if Banyue is not in <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state, he will recover 0.3 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>. With at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue's next switch-in will directly trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color>. When coming on-field through this method with at least 120 <color=#FFFFFF>Wrathful Fires</color>, Banyue immediately enters <color=#FFFFFF>Visage of Wrath</color> state and increases his <color=#FF5521>Fire DMG</color> by <color=#2BAD00>60%</color> for 20s.

name: [Ye Shunguang] Frosted Blade
description: After entering Enlightened Mind, upon first using Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum, <color=#2BAD00>automatically triggers Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>gains 45% Physical RES ignore</color> for 15s.

name: [Ye Shunguang] Clang of Jade
description: After Ye Shunguang activates Ether Veil: Verdict, <color=#2BAD00>all squad members will use Veil Vulnerability bonus when attacking</color>, instead of Stun DMG Multiplier, and the Veil Vulnerability bonus cap is reduced by 85%. Enlightened Mind state duration doesn't pause while off-field anymore.

name: [Ye Shunguang] Case Full of Light
description: Ye Shunguang's <color=#2BAD00>Qingming Sword Force generation rate increases by 100%</color>, Enlightened Mind duration is reduced to 10s.

name: [Zhao] Cold Moonlight
description: Zhao's <color=#2BAD00>Impact increases by 2</color> for every 1,000 initial max HP she has. All squad members' Ultimates and EX Special Attacks deal <color=#2BAD00>12% increased Daze</color>.

name: [Zhao] Frostmist Enigma
description: After charging Basic Attack: Final Verdict for 1s, Basic Attack: Final Verdict - Frostgleam can be unleashed, which <color=#2BAD00>increases CRIT Rate by 15% and CRIT DMG by 40%</color> for 15s.

name: [Zhao] Moonlit Dew
description: When Zhao activates Ether Veil, she recovers 30 Frostbite Points and <color=#2BAD00>increases ATK by 25%</color> for all squad members, lasting 50s.

name: [Aria] Delusion's Glow
description: After Aria completes her EX Special Attack, the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> on the field <color=#2BAD00>increases by 1</color>, and EX Special Attack: Instantly Hooked does not consume Energy.

name: [Aria] Sweetheart Strike
description: Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 20%</color>, and <color=#FFFFFF>Enhanced Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG additionally increases by 20%</color>; for every 10 points of initial Anomaly Mastery Aria has, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT Rate increases by 4%</color>; the third hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> on a target <color=#2BAD00>deals additional 50% of Aria's ATK</color> as <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>.

name: [Aria] Hear the Present
description: <color=#2BAD00>Aria's <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Harmony of Delusion</color> is triggered</color> when an enemy enters an Attribute Anomaly while Aria is off field. When a heavy attack is landed with <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Harmony of Delusion</color>, it can trigger the Abloom effect of Core Passive: Innate Stage Presence. Further, should the <color=#FFFFFF>Fandom Power</color> nearby be equal or greater than 2, she may proceed to launching the third hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch</color> after the attack. <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Harmony of Delusion</color> can trigger once every 8s.

name: [Sunna] Bubble Planet
description: <color=#2BAD00>Deal 50% more DMG</color> with EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, and Ultimate: Smash It All!. Bubblegum's Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted is changed to Basic Attack: Bubblegum Barrage. DMG dealt is <color=#2BAD00>regarded as <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> DMG</color>.

name: [Sunna] Tour de Rhythm
description: Reduces the number of attacks required to trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, and when an enemy is afflicted with <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color>, their <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 20%</color> for 10s. When <color=#FFFFFF>Cat's Gaze</color> hits a target afflicted with <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color> or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly</color>, it also triggers one instance of <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>: applies one additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>370%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>192%</color>/<color=#FF5521>480%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>30%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>48%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>19%</color> of original Attribute Anomaly DMG.

name: [Sunna] Dream Soundscape
description: BranchRelic_13601020_des

name: [Nangong Yu] Focus Shift
description: When other squad members trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Disorder</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, Nangong Yu will launch a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> around the target enemy. This attack is an <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color>. This effect can trigger at most once every 6s. When Nangong Yu's <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color> heavy attack hits a target afflicted with <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Anomaly</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Anomaly</color> it triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> once, which deals additional Attribute Anomaly DMG equal to <color=#FE437E>230%</color>/<color=#2EB6FF>120%</color>/<color=#FF5521>300%</color>/<color=#F0D12B>20%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>30%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>12%</color> of the original Attribute Anomaly DMG. This effect can trigger once every 6s.

name: [Nangong Yu] Beat Sync
description: When Nangong Yu triggers a Precise Charging, <color=#2BAD00>restore 4 Energy</color> for all squad members. When any squad member uses a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, restore120 Decibels for all squad members.

name: [Nangong Yu] Spotlight Solo
description: Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 60. For every 1 <color=#FFFFFF>Downbeat</color> consumed, <color=#2BAD00>she restores 0.15 Energy</color>. After triggering Precise Charging with the first hit of <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Adorable Explosive Impact</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to launch a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>. When Precise Charging is triggered, <color=#2BAD00>Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 20%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Cissia] Coiled Strike
description: When activating <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss</color>, based on the time the character is airborne, <color=#2BAD00>the skill's CRIT DMG increases by 15%, and it deals 1 additional instance of <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to 450% of ATK</color>. This effect stacks up to 3 times and lasts until the skill ends.

name: [Cissia] Venomous Concoction
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> deals <color=#2BAD00>additional <color=#2EB6FF>Electric DMG</color> equal to <color=#2BAD00>300%</color> of own ATK</color>.

name: [Cissia] Ouroboros Loop
description: After using <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, gain <color=#FFFFFF>Viper Strike</color>: when any non-<color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color> attack hits an enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>triggers a free special <color=#FFFFFF>Corrode Bone</color></color> that cannot inflict Daze. This effect can trigger once every 1s, and lasts for 6s.

name: [Starlight - Billy] Crimson Gun Demon
description: When successfully performing a Block during <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, gain 1 Charge stack, up to 1 stack max, which <color=#2BAD00>increases the DMG</color> of the next <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: High-Traction Wheels</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Rocking Footwork</color> <color=#2BAD00>by 100%</color>.

name: [Starlight - Billy] Knight's Belt
description: After using <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Retribution</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to perform <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Stunt Show</color>, dealing <color=#F0D12B>Physical DMG</color> to surrounding enemies. This skill is a guaranteed CRIT. During this skill, <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG increases by 80%</color>, <color=#2BAD00>recovers 10 <color=#FFFFFF>Determination</color>/s</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Anti-Interrupt Level increases</color>.

name: [Starlight - Billy] Heated Cacophony
description: After using <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Duel King</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Retribution</color>, press <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 8s and <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color>'s DMG Multiplier is 1,200%. When successfully performing a Block during <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Drive Suppression</color>, the next <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Duel King</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack: Starlight Retribution</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color> can trigger an additional <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Duel King</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter: Follow-up Cannon</color> hits an enemy, <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt against the target increases by 12%</color>, stacking up to 2 times, only one stack can be applied per enemy per use of a skill, lasting 20s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Promeia] Whirlwind Judgment
description: When Promeia triggers <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>, and when triggering <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Shrouded in Shadow</color>, she <color=#2BAD00>recovers 15 additional</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. When triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color>, her <color=#2BAD00>Abloom DMG increases by 6%</color>, stacking up to 10 times, lasting 60s.

name: [Promeia] Frostbound Shadow
description: Attacks no longer recover <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color>. Instead <color=#2BAD00>recover an additional</color> <color=#2BAD00>5/s</color> <color=#FFFFFF>Corrosive Chill</color> . With <color=#FFFFFF>Trial by Cold</color>, <color=#2BAD00>switching on-field replaces the normal switch-in</color> with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Execution - Layered Frost</color>, this effect can trigger once every 10s. When <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Execution - Merciless Judgment</color> hits an enemy, the enemy's <color=#2BAD00>Ice RES is reduced by 24</color> for 20s, repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Promeia] Execution Finale
description: When a character in the squad Stuns an enemy, Promeia <color=#2BAD00>recovers 5 Corrosive Chill/s</color> for 10s. Promeia's <color=#2BAD00>Attribute Anomaly DMG against Stunned enemies increases by 60%</color>, and <color=#2BAD00>Disorder DMG increases by 60%</color>.

name: [Velina] Lace-Veiled Blades
description: When Velina inflicts <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> on an enemy, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>Attribute Anomaly DMG increases by 30%</color> for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Additionally, <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> <color=#2BAD00>lasts 3s longer</color> and <color=#2BAD00>deals 20% more Daze</color>.

name: [Velina] Graceful Serenade
description: When Velina triggers <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color>, she recovers <color=#2BAD00>10 Energy and 200 Decibels</color> and consumes all <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enhance the DMG</color> of this <color=#A6C5FD>Windswept</color> by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> for each point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color> consumed. Upon using her <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Velina gains 1 point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>. If this <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color> triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>， recovers 1 additional point of <color=#FFFFFF>Windbite</color>

name: [Velina] Candescent Wind Crown
description: While <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color> is present on the field, the whole squad's <color=#2BAD00>Energy Generation Rate by 40% , Decibel Generation Rate increase</color> by 30%, and <color=#FFFFFF>Sweeping Cyclone</color>'s <color=#2BAD00>duration is extended by 3s.</color>

name: [Norma] En-Nah Frontline
description: When Norma unleashes a <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Dodge Counter</color>, she gains 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Combo</color>, causing her DMG to ignore 6% of the target's <color=#FF5521>Fire RES</color>, stacking up to 5 times. When Norma is hit, she loses 1 stack of <color=#FFFFFF>Combo</color>, with a maximum loss of 1 stack every 5s. Norma's <color=#FFFFFF>Dash Attack</color> can trigger <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>.

name: [Norma] Grand Finale
description:
When squadmates activate an <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, Norma <color=#2BAD00>immediately gains 100% Preheated Chamber</color>. Can be triggered at most once every 40s;
When any Agent in the squad activates a <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, the corresponding Agent's <color=#2BAD00>Decibel Generation Rate increases 25%</color> for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

name: [Norma] Menacing Bangboo
description: When any Agent in the squad defeats an enemy in the <color=#FFFFFF>Tech Divide</color> state, all Agents in the squad gain <color=#2BAD00>2.5% ATK</color> in the Hollow during this run, stacking up to 10 times.

name: [Pyrois] Sword of Dawn
description: Pyrois gains <color=#2BAD00>20 points of Solar Prominence</color> upon triggering <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Dodge</color>, up to once every 10s. Hitting enemies with different attacks <color=#2BAD00>improves Pyrois's Solar Prominence recovery efficiency by 30%</color>.

name: [Pyrois] Ironclad Honor
description: Pyrois's <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color> <color=#2BAD00>DMG is increased by 20%</color>. Unleashing <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate: Total Annihilation</color> immediately <color=#2BAD00>grants Pyrois 1,500 Decibels</color>. This effect can trigger once every 30s.

name: [Pyrois] Flame of Illumination
description: Upon triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>Perfect Block</color> with an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, Pyrois <color=#2BAD00>recovers 10 Energy and 20 Solar Prominence</color>.

name: [Remielle] Empty Wing Pilgrimage
description: When Remielle is in the <color=#FFFFFF>[Phase Flux]</color> state and her Assist Finishing Move hits a target afflicted with <color=#FE437E>Ether Anomaly</color>, <color=#2EB6FF>Electric Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#FF5521>Fire Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#F0D12B>Physical Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#98EFF0>Ice Attribute Anomaly</color>, or <color=#A6C5FD>Wind Attribute Anomaly</color>, <color=#2BAD00>triggers an additional instance of [Abloom]</color>, dealing a fixed 220% multiplier of the corresponding Attribute Anomaly DMG.

name: [Remielle] Tempered Edge Radiance
description: When Remielle is the active character, <color=#2BAD00>regenerate 0.4 Energy per second</color>. Upon using <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color>, <color=#2BAD00>gain 2</color> special <color=#FFFFFF>[Void Radiance]</color>.

name: [Remielle] Feathered Flow of Silver
description: When Remielle uses [Basic Attack: Fleeting Flash], she does not consume any stored <color=#FFFFFF>[Radiant Glow]</color>.

name: [Sigrid] Gear 1
description:
Unlock <color=#FFFFFF>[Retraction Stance: Formation Break]</color>: Outside of <color=#FFFFFF>[Sky Patrol Stance]</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to activate <color=#FFFFFF>[Retraction Stance: Formation Break]</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color>;
If attacked at the moment <color=#FFFFFF>[Retraction Stance: Formation Break]</color> is activated, a Block can be triggered. Upon a successful Block, enter [Sky Patrol Stance].

name: [Sigrid] Gear 2
description: When triggering a <color=#FFFFFF>[Chain Attack]</color>, hold <IconMap:Icon_Normal> to skip the Chain Attack window and continue chaining follow-up attacks and character switching;

name: [Sigrid] Gear 3
description: While in the <color=#FFFFFF>[Aerial Suppression Stance]</color> state, the Energy Cost of <color=#FFFFFF>[EX Special Attack]</color> is reduced.

name: Rose
description: It is both intention and courage.

name: Viola Philippica
description: Honest and humble, like a hermit standing beyond the hustle and bustle.

name: Tranquil Crescent Moon
description: All disturbances will fade away with the moonlight.

name: Lily
description: The sweet aroma of lilies is a blessing of happiness and harmony.

name: Butterfly Orchid
description: Happiness is like the fluttering shadow of a butterfly moving toward you.

name: King's Flower
description: The king of flowers, effortlessly commands admiration.

name: Daisy
description: Daisies always carry the morning dew, innocent and fresh.

name: Bellflower
description: The bellflower represents unwavering faith, which evokes resilience and protection.

name: Lamp Branch
description: The Lamp Branch gently sways, with good luck waiting for you just around the corner.

name: Caramel Dream
description: Caramel Dream makes one feel as though they are immersed in the sweetness of a fairy tale.

name: Multicolor Peony
description: The peony represents lingering affection.

name: Sunflower
description: Sunflowers always follow the sun, just like a loyal heart that never leaves.

name: Tulip
description: Tulips symbolize tolerance and reconciliation.

name: Sunset Umbrella
description: When you need a moment of peace, it will shield you from the wind and rain.

name: Memorial Flower
description: One cannot help but sigh at separation, just as one cannot cease longing.

name: Nineveh
description: Transcendent beauty is often dangerous and alluring.

name: Evolvulus
description: Evolvulus expresses that sincere trust which requires no words.

name: Crispy Star Biscuit
description: Crispy Star Biscuits are one of life's simple pleasures.

name: Firefly Mushroom
description: It is the key to stepping into a fantasy, turning the night into a stage where miracles unfold.

name: Water Lily
description: It is a sacred beauty that floats above the earthly realm.

name: Snapdragon
description: Their bright colors embrace the world with passion.

name: Wooden Pot
description: The warm wooden base feels like the embrace of the earth.

name: Cerulean Pot
description: The simple blue-green hue depicts the tranquility and elegance of time.

name: Carved Base
description: Engraved with a profound charm, understated yet dignified.

name: Metal Base
description: A combination of simplicity and modernity, with no extra lines.

name: Red Flame Drive
description: 解锁后，用拳头的连续近战攻击，命中敌人时可以积攒热力值，满热力值时，下一次拳头攻击会清空热力值，并使伤害翻倍

name: Wind Flurry
description: 解锁后，玩家的拳脚衔接速度加快，拳头变为火属性攻击，打断等级增加，且普通拳不再清空热力值

name: Divine Annihilation
description: 解锁后，可以通过大招键发动界王拳，近战大招

name: Power Punch
description: 解锁后，玩家可以长按拳、脚蓄力攻击，蓄力时根据自身热力值，快速提升蓄力等级

name: Star-Devourer
description: 解锁后，玩家在蓄力时受到攻击，会立刻提升蓄力段数

name: Gale Kick
description: 解锁后，玩家可以在普通拳后，接脚，发动回旋踢

name: Heaven's Impact
description: 解锁后，玩家可以在回旋踢后，接双手下砸派生，玩家在蓄力下砸时，会消耗所有热力值，并转化为伤害

name: Vector Wings
description: 解锁后，玩家可以在攻击、受击中途闪避

name: Charge Resonance
description: 解锁后，玩家闪避时，会持续积累热力值

name: Void Deconstruction
description: 解锁后，成功闪避时，缓速周围敌人

name: Fire Wing Fuel
description: 增加气槽最大值（暂未生效）

name: Pulse Barrage
description: 解锁后，玩家在远程形态射击时可以积攒热力值，满热力值时，松开射击键会清空热力触发终结射击

name: Blazing Storm
description: 解锁后，玩家在远程形态可以使用喷火器

name: Incendiary Ammo
description: 解锁后，攻击点燃的敌人时，触发火焰爆炸并造成额外伤害，获得热力值，对被点燃单位造成的伤害大幅增加，打断等级增加。

name: Voidwing Module
description: 解锁后，玩家可以一边快速移动一边射击 + 数值性能

name: Destruction Beam
description: 解锁后，可以通过按大招键发动眼部激光

name: Flame Tide Pursuit
description: 解锁后，远程模式下满热力自动发射导弹雨

name: Dual Domain Heat
description: 解锁后，切换近远程形态时，立即回复80%热力值

name: Pulse Shield
description: 解锁后，部分血量转化为一段时间内不受伤则回复的护盾

name: Alloy Frame
description: 解锁后，强化自己有盾时的抗打断能力

name: Fatal Reconstruction
description: 解锁后，转化更多血量至护盾，击杀敌人时，魔神邦布可以补充自己的护盾。

name: Backup Energy Module
description: 解锁后，有盾时无视远程攻击

name: Shield Burst
description: 解锁后，可以通过长按大招键发动神罗天征，补满自己的盾，造成AOE伤害，近战大招

name: Shield Break Marker Plug-In
description: Attacks against marked enemies can pierce shields

name: Soul Eater Plug-In
description: Defeating enemies restores 60 Energy.

name: Speed King Plug-In
description: Successfully performing quick-time interactions grants 20 bonus Energy.

name: Invincible Speed Plug-In
description: The fastest ally gains full starting Energy.

name: Let's Try It Again Plug-In
description: After a Mark is removed, your fastest unit takes another action immediately. Limited to once per round.

name: Your Turn Belongs to My Plug-In
description: Upon an enemy's defeat, the one who dealt the final blow may act instantly. Limited to once per round

name: Weaken Plug-In
description: When using a skill, if the target is an enemy, randomly dispel one stat buff from the main target

name: Purification Plug-In
description: Dispels the mark on allies when they receive a stat buff

name: Lifesteal Plug-In
description: After defeating an enemy unit, the one that dealt the final blow gains a healing buff at the start of each turn for 2 turns

name: For All Plug-In
description: When a support ally uses a skill that grants a buff, it grants an extra turn. Limited to once per round.

name: Penny's Lost Notes: The Price
description:
The Creator's strength has been stolen time and time again over the years, and the Exaltists no longer follow the guidance of their sacred texts. They feast upon Gibor's remains, leaving a trail of atrocities in their wake.
Why does no one wish to forgo their own gain and offer their strength to the Creator instead...

name: Hot Pot Soup Base
description:
Simmer's mildly spicy hotpot base, with its steaming broth and fresh ingredients, is enough to warm even the coldest heart.

<color=#B5B5B5>Having both</color> <color=#D9A600>Breaking Thunder - Standard</color> <color=#B5B5B5>and</color> <color=#D9A600>Joyful Blaze - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>'s Broken Clues will unlock the secret location of</color> <color=#D9A600>Pale Breath - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>.</color>

name: Hollow Wayfinder
description: An old-school hollow wayfinding instrument. Its design suggests it was an early model deployed by the Defense Force, equipped with basic boundary measurement and route-planning functions.

name: Broken Oni Mask
description: A broken Oni mask, its ornate patterns suggest its owner once held a prestigious position.

name: Abandoned Bangboo
description: According to HAND's records, someone once used this Bangboo device to send an apocalyptic alert to HAND. After discussion between the Intelligence Division and Deputy Chief Yanagi, it was temporarily archived due to insufficient evidence.

name: Leave Request Form
description: The leave request form was filled with various excuses (all of which were rejected), including but not limited to: psychological therapy at Waifei Peninsula, sprained index finger from writing, burned tongue from team-building hotpot dinner...

name: Complete Literacy Guide
description: On the practice pages of the book, it reads: "Never visit a burger joint without a reason." Below it, in elegant handwriting: "How can I get Soukaku to study without thinking about food?"

name: Section 6 Chief's Schedule
description: The record shows various meetings and appointments for Hoshimi Miyabi, though it seems she skipped most of them. There's a small note written by her on the side: "Meetings seem to be a rather ineffective form of training."

name: Newspaper from the Future
description: A newspaper from the future, reporting the joyous news that humanity has finally triumphed over the Hollow.

name: Penny's Lost Notes: The Feast Begins
description:
According to both the institute's documents and the hidden messages discovered after deciphering the exalted scriptures, the apocalypse is inevitable.
If that's the case, then perhaps the only path left is to cast our mortal bodies into the fire and offer up humanity's strength to Them — to join Their grand feast, become beings under Their protection, and claim immortality in the world that follows the end.

name: Nitro-Fuel Ultra Fire Special
description:
The Outer Ring's special ultra-concentrated Nitro-Fuel, packed with all kinds of wild ingredients. Just a single drop feels like it could instantly cheer you up.

<color=#B5B5B5>Having both</color> <color=#D9A600>Breaking Thunder - Standard</color> <color=#B5B5B5>and</color> <color=#D9A600>Joyful Blaze - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>'s Broken Clues will unlock the secret location of</color> <color=#D9A600>Pale Breath - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>.</color>

name: Nitro-Fuel Theme Park Blueprints
description: Looks like someone's dream project — a Nitro-Fuel themed amusement park they planned to build in the Outer Ring. Inside are all kinds of bizarre attractions: giant Nitro-Fuel cans, periodic showers of flaming meteors, and elevator-mounted speaker arrays. It all looks dangerous, but strangely fun.

name: Warm Fuzzball
description: A soft, warm-looking fuzzball. Judging by its texture and color, it seems to have been collected from a feline Thiren...

name: Flickering Light Ball
description: A strange disco ball. It gives the impression that once it lights up, a one-hour loop of high-energy beats will start playing in everyone's head.

name: Holy Fuel Barrel
description: A limited-edition golden Nitro-Fuel barrel from Burnice's collection. The drink inside is long gone, but even as an empty barrel, it still radiates the Outer Ring's raw power.

name: Carlishe Nourishing Shampoo
description: Carlishe 30-Second Ultimate Hair Repair: premium care that restores heat- or dye-damaged hair. Available at Lumina Square.

name: Temporary Shipping Order
description: A temporary expedited delivery slip from Leaps and Bounds logistics. Client: Penny; Courier: Burnice; Destination: Northeast side of the Papago Hollow... (the more specific address seems to have been scratched out).

name: Scratch Card from the Newsstand
description: A scratch card sold at the newsstand. From the parts where the coating's been scraped away, it looks like it won the grand prize, "Golden Ice Cream."

name: Penny's Lost Notes: Sacrifice
description:
"According to Mentor Yeshde'ah's notes, death is not the endpoint."... "I am willing to be the bait that lures sustenance into the depths of the Divine Maze."... "I am willing to cast off my flesh and guide my spirit toward the realm of immortality."
May all return to the Creator. May the Creator shelter me and all humankind.

name: 1,000 Heartbreak Ballads
description:
A full CD collection of heartbreaking ballads released by High Ambitions Entertainment. Just skimming the tracklist gives you chills — it feels like the kind of music that could drown you in sorrow...

<color=#B5B5B5>When held, unlocks</color> <color=#D9A600>Joyful Blaze - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>'s secret locations.</color>

name: Krampus Decryption Plug-In
description:
A cracking plug-in marked with the Krampus emblem, with a small line inscribed below: A trusty tool for bypassing access-control mechanisms.

<color=#B5B5B5>When held, unlocks</color> <color=#D9A600>Breaking Thunder - Standard</color><color=#B5B5B5>'s secret locations.</color>

name: Bunnygrass
description: A vegetable that herbivorous Thiren love to eat. It's delicious in salads, and when boiled in hotpot with dipping sauce, it becomes incredibly flavorful.

name: Krampus Mission File
description: An internal TOPS mission file. From the intact sections, the operation was led by Zhao, a member of Krampus. The mission briefing highlights that a researcher named Penny had provided certain trade information, which led to the approval of this operation.

name: One Denny
description: Some kind of personal collectible. The worn edges suggest it's been around for quite a few years.

name: Vintage Timer
description: An old-style timer once used to predict Hollow disasters. Judging from the symbols on it, it seems tied to the training schedule of a prominent family.

name: Deep Pit
description: A deep, pitch-black pit. Just looking at it fills you with a crushing sense of dread, as if you might fall in at any moment.

name: Phantoms of the Past
description: It appears to be a lingering phantom from the past, muttering words like "family," "worth," and "little bunny" under its breath...

name: [Attack: Eradication] Netherflame Reignited
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Orphie & Magus accumulate Energy over time. With enough Energy, press <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> to summon Orphie & Magus to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies and grant all Agents the <color=#FFFFFF>Zeroed In</color> effect for 15s. Agents with <color=#FFFFFF>Zeroed In</color> gain <color=#2BAD00>500 ATK and their attacks ignore 20% of the enemy's DEF</color>.

name: [Attack: Eradication] Masquerade
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Hugo accumulates Energy over time. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Hugo to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. This skill always CRITs, and when a heavy attack from this skill hits an enemy, it <color=#FFFFFF>triggers the Totalize effect</color>, dealing <color=#2BAD00>DMG equal to 100%/20%/10% of the target's Max HP</color> to normal enemies/Elite enemies/Boss enemies respectively. When Hugo's <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> hits a Stunned enemy, it ends the enemy's Stunned state and deals <color=#2BAD00>additional DMG equal to a percentage of Max HP</color> to Elite enemies/Boss enemies based on remaining Daze duration, up to an additional 20%/10%.

name: [Anomaly: Infliction] Flame in a Cup
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Burnice accumulates Energy over time, starting with 75 Charge. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Burnice to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. Hitting enemies inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> effect. <color=#FFFFFF>Scorched</color> enemies have <color=#2BAD00>all attribute Anomaly Buildup RES reduced by 42%</color> for 40 seconds.

name: [Anomaly: Infliction] Featherlight Snowfall
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Vivian accumulates Energy over time.With enough energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Vivian to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. Upon hitting enemies affected by Attribute Anomaly, inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Abloom</color> effect on them and <color=#2BAD00>an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG</color> at a ratio based on the original Attribute Anomaly DMG of <color=#FE437E>6,129%</color> / <color=#2EB6FF>3,040%</color> / <color=#FF5521>7,600%</color> / <color=#F0D12B>533%</color>/<color=#98EFF0>760%</color>/<color=#A6C5FD>304%</color>.

name: [Stun: Knock] One and Done
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Lighter accumulates Energy over time, starting with 75 Charge. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Lighter to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. Hitting enemies inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect. Enemies inflicted with the <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect have their <color=#2BAD00>Stunned duration extended by 3s after being Dazed</color>. The <color=#FFFFFF>Collapse</color> effect ends when the enemies recover from the Stunned state. When Lighter's <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> hits normal/Elite/Boss enemies, it <color=#2BAD00>directly accumulates 100%/30%/15% Daze</color> respectively.

name: [Stun: Knock] Spectral Pierce
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Trigger accumulates Energy over time, starting with 75 Charge. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Trigger and launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies. Hitting an enemy inflicts the <color=#FFFFFF>Pierce</color> effect. Enemies with the <color=#FFFFFF>Pierce</color> effect have their <color=#2BAD00>Stun DMG Multiplier increased by 20%</color>. The <color=#FFFFFF>Pierce</color> effect ends when the enemies recover from the Stunned state. When Trigger's <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> hits a normal enemy, elite enemy, or boss enemy, it <color=#2BAD00>accumulates 100%/30%/15% Stun</color>.

name: [Support: Saturation] Elegant Creed
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Rina does not accumulate Energy over time, instead she accumulates Energy when any Agent in the squad consumes Energy/Adrenaline. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Rina to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>. During <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>, <color=#2BAD00>DMG dealt by all Agents in the squad increases by 70%</color> for 10s.

name: [Support: Saturation] Denny Magnet
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Nicole accumulates Energy over time. With enough Energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Nicole to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies and enter <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color> for 10s. During <color=#FFFFFF>Vital View</color>, all Agents in the squad <color=#2BAD00>ignore 50% of the enemy's DEF</color>.

name: [Rupture: Activation] Soulfire Showdown
description: <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color>: Manato accumulates Energy over time. The lower the HP of the active character, the faster Manato's Energy Generation. With enough energy, press Auxiliary Assist to summon Manato to launch an <color=#FFFFFF>Auxiliary Assist</color> attack on enemies, equalize all Agents in the squad ' HP and <color=#2BAD00>restore 20% HP</color>. all Agents in the squad gain the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> status. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Molten Edge</color> status, Agents' <color=#2BAD00>CRIT DMG is increased by 50%</color>, lasting 40s.

name: [Defense: Battle Shield] Backup Barge-In

While an Agent has <color=#FFFFFF>Radiant Aegis</color>, they have unlimited <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Points</color> <color=#2BAD00>, their DMG dealt increases by 35%, and DMG taken in a single instance cannot exceed the Shield amount</color>.

Everyone went all in for the six-can family pack, but no one has ever seen a can with a number ending in 0 or 5.

However, {M#Belle}{F#Wise} might have recorded it on video, so why don't you go ask {M#her}{F#him}... maybe you can still find it?

name: Iris of the Shore
description: Vivian's Outfit.
secondaryDescription: Birds soar into the starlit skies, while irises bloom by the pond. Though this enchanting moonlit night may be brief, please let me see the lingering anticipation in your eyes in the moment I bloom.

secondaryDescription: The young woman's perfect symmetry is only ever slightly compromised when she wears the school crest — such is the elegant and noble Thymefield spirit.

name: Sea of Thyme
description: Alice's Outfit.
secondaryDescription:
Though it wasn't completely symmetrical, she did not mind this gift from a dear friend.
The girl pushed open the locked door and walked along the pink beach after the sudden downpour, the cool waves brushing over her ankles. There were no unknowns left to frighten her.

name: Tanuki Under the Shade
description: Yuzuha's Outfit.
secondaryDescription: Can you tell what the umbrella conceals? A tanuki, a trap, a ghost, or a girl's sly, spirited smile?

name: Tanuki in Broad Daylight
description: Yuzuha's Outfit.
secondaryDescription: Ghost stories aren't born only in shadows. Unconvinced? Just lock eyes with that playful young lady splashing in the water. She'll possess your thoughts, while Kama sneaks away with your drink.

name: Hundred Flavors
description: Pan Yinhu's Outfit.
secondaryDescription: Yunkui Summit's largest disciple uniform, spacious enough for this senior brother's belly and all his seasonings. And that iron wok on top is a first of its kind. But... putting a pan you just used for stir-frying on your head? Doesn't it burn?

name: Culinary Jewel
description: Pan Yinhu's Outfit.
secondaryDescription:
Senior Yinhu once dreamed of becoming a renowned chef, but in this day and age, there's always some thug looking to smash your bowl.
—"Go on, try smashing one."

name: Clouddrift Illumination
description: Ye Shunguang's outfit.
secondaryDescription:
Cloud-woven silk, a blade's gleam reflected in its folds. The attire mirrors the person.
But who truly chose this dress? Was it her... or the deeper self within?

name: Touch of Dawnlight
description: Ye Shunguang's outfit.
secondaryDescription: The gentle glow of sunlight and warm breeze seem to welcome your next encounter as you walk down the streets.

name: Loyal Wild Soul
description: Komano Manato's Outfit.
secondaryDescription:
The standard attire of the unofficial mediator in Sailume Bay, enough to intimidate petty thugs.
Still, it sometimes draws wandering eyes.

name: White Heart Silhouette
description: Komano Manato's Outfit.
secondaryDescription:
A young Manato made a solitary vow to himself — and from his deep reverie, a lone pale shadow was born.
Mimicking his attire enhances Manato's already exceedingly intimidating presence.

Freshly baked cake, rich and fragrant coffee, and the gentle warmth of the afternoon sun...
Wrapped in moments of softness, it's time to begin today's tea break.

A pure-white "angel" clad in "demonic" wings. Take a deep breath, get ready... once the spotlight comes on, it's the Angels of Delusion's time to rebel.

The boundary between angel and demon tilts with the lights, dissolving within her reflection.

Fairy made this namecard specially to welcome the newest member of Random Play. That said, actually handing it out in a social setting would still take a fair amount of courage.

"I am the undying flames of disaster."
"Then, let me light the way forward for us before I burn out."
