name: Eridu Tycoon
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
The only publicly released image of the founder of the New Eridu City Fund.
Although such an image with the founder buried in gold coins may evoke jealousy, who can refuse the lucrative earnings and the prestigious avatar from the City Fund?

name: Efficient Summer Getaway Plan
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
A hard to resist and highly efficient summer getaway plan: Enjoy the ocean's embrace and let it wash away the heat!
Also: Bangboo diving equipment is on sale right now! Check out the super hot brand "City Prisoner."

name: Hidden Ending
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
Almost no one noticed that a regular social service Bangboo left its post, except for its cat.
Was the ability to trace the data logs due to a glitch in the system, or was it love?

name: Chief Classical Music DJ
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription: A DJ who is on good terms with Elfy. Despite wearing the latest headphones, this DJ's real love is classical music, drifting through the melodies with the listeners... until both fall into a peaceful slumber.

name: Heartwarming Game
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
On a snowy winter's day, warmth still verberates from the bubbling hot soup, the fireplace lit at night, and Belle's hands as she rubs them together.
However, when these warm hands grasp soft snow, then tighten around it and pack it in...

name: Reflections of Fireworks
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
Through the distance, with eyes that see through the Hollow, at this moment, only the brilliant fireworks are reflected.
Leaving behind Commissions, forgetting the Ethereals, shaking off the apocalypse — at the moment the year changes, only you and I remain.

name: "My Love For You"
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
"I don't care what anyone thinks, just as I don't care if the sky will collapse or if tomorrow will come..."
"All I care about right now is whether the owner of that name cares as much about me right now."

name: Strolling Hand in Hand
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
No matter which world we're in, the one who roams with me, crossing endless space, is always you.
No matter how many journeys we take, the one who forgets to plan and ends up scrambling... is still you.

name: Stunt Coordinator Needed ASAP!
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
When recommending the antagonist actor, the senior sister from Yunkui Summit emphasized that her fellow townsman excels in both martial arts and acting skills, appearing fierce yet remarkably patient.
...Senior, could you please recommend an equally outstanding stunt coordinator to save our two panicking leads?!!

name: Underwater Sightseeing Tour
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
Upon checking the photos when they were back at home:
In Wise's camera reel, there were vibrant corals, lively schools of fish, and Belle in her graceful poses.
In Belle's camera reel, there were shimmering white lights, unidentifiable creatures, and a blurry Wise.

name: Lotus Lucid Dream
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
In the seemingly endless summer days, these moments of glory, life-threatening peril, turning tides, and graceful exits... belong to Phaethon.
While others of rippling streams, lotus-lit ponds, lazy daydreams, and drowsy eyes... belong only to Belle and Wise.

name: Sweet Dreams in the Breeze
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
"That Bangboo... will it be able to find its way home?"
"...I'm so sleepy. How about we finish the story after we wake up?"
"Don't forget..."

name: Maple Rest
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
One-Dennyboo sent a postcard: it's doing great with the kitten you helped rescue.
Even better, they've found a home now! Time to embrace the warm autumn sun and maple leaves — with fully charged batteries and delicious canned food waiting for them at home.

name: Exclusive Fan Support
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription:
"Wise, you've gotta wave the glow stick to the beat! Just holding it up doesn't count!"
"Left–right–left, up–left–down–down... Belle? What was it again? Give me a minute, I'll get the sequence down."

name: All Magic Is a Miracle
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription:
The world likes to hide the things that matter most, only to quietly bring them forward when least expected.
With a turn of the fingers, before the applause fades, our eyes meet for an instant, and the miracle arrives right on time.

name: Perfect Expression Control
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription:
The marble game taking the city by storm welcomes every Bangboo friend — hop in your bubble and smash into your pals!
High-speed cameras are rolling: even if everything's spinning, remember to blink gracefully as you brush past each other!

name: Camera Sense
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription: In the play of light and shadow, every treasured moment is meticulously captured into the frames through the lens.

name: Focus on This!
description: A commemorative avatar for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription:
Mysteries pile up, and fate weaves us together in ways we can't unravel.
But at least, on this journey to seek the truth, we'll walk side by side, always and forever.

name: Fragrant Infusion
description: Avatar reward obtained when your Hollow Zero Investigation License reaches a specific level.
secondaryDescription: You might already have received the flower seeds gifted from Hollow Zero? Invest a little life force as nourishment, and it'll cling to you as it emits a fragrance — what a fair exchange.

name: Shiyu Defense: Adaption
description: "Shiyu Defense: Critical Node" full S-Rank clear commemorative avatar.
secondaryDescription: Amidst the upheaval, you remain the eternal anchor.

name: Endless Ascension: Smooth Path
description: Commemorative avatar for specific floors in the "Simulated Battle Trial".
secondaryDescription: Breaking through the siege and battling to the summit, the path ahead lies wide open.

name: Deadly Assault: Line Breaker
description: Commemorative avatar for "Deadly Assault" challenge
secondaryDescription: The Hollow is a labyrinth — those unskilled in strategy face no return, no survival.

name: Final Dose
description: Commemorative avatar for reaching the designated investigation level in "Hollow Zero: Lost Void."
secondaryDescription:
Accept this gift from the shadows, and perhaps you'll find the strength to escape being "lost."
But more likely: you'll remain lucid, battling like a cornered beast... only to join the ranks of your foes, becoming the next howl in the shadows.

name: Endless Last Stand - Impasse
description: Commemorative avatar for specific floors in the "Battle Trial: The Last Stand."
secondaryDescription: At the journey's end, a spark remains; A blade cuts through, and a new world gains.

name: Plundering the Core
description: Commemorative avatar for reaching the designated Investigation Progress level in Hollow Zero: Lost Void.
secondaryDescription:
Its thin, sharp fingers tightly grip the key that controls the entire "Lost Void."
If you stare for too long... you might unknowingly become one of the manipulated.

name: Gazed Upon in This Moment
description:
An avatar reward for the limited-time event "Festival Channel."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
Before you realize it, a gaze has been watching you for quite a while now — wait, just one gaze... that's actually pretty rare?
"Objection. This eye is merely a visual representation of program execution. During this time, I haven't just been watching — every line of code of New Eridu's most powerful AI assistant has been running for Master."

name: Blessed by Glory: The Crown
description: Commemorative avatar for specific scores in "Battle Trial: Glory".
secondaryDescription: The strong crown themselves with the glory of fierce battles.

name: A Thousand Paths, A Thousand Changes
description: Commemorative avatar for "Threshold Simulation: Branching Echoes."
secondaryDescription: Take different paths and embark on countless adventures.

name: Sān-Z: The Never-Ending Show
description: Commemorative avatar for the Filmgoer Thank-You Gift limited event.
secondaryDescription:
Every roll of film from the past holds your silhouette.
Every story yet to unfold awaits your companionship.
New Eridu, the show never ends!

name: Discovering Truths
description: Threshold Simulation: Myriad Endgame Commemorative Avatar.
secondaryDescription: On the gridlines of data, the one and only true path is calculated.

name: Everburning Heart
description: Threshold Simulation: Myriad Endgame Commemorative Avatar.
secondaryDescription: So long as the road of pursuit remains, the heart has yet to fall silent.

name: Crowned by Waves: Apex
description: Commemorative avatar for specific scores in "Battle Trial: Tidal Wave."
secondaryDescription: Crown-bearer who has reached the apex, claim your ultimate glory.

name: Simulated Annihilation: Terminus
description: Annihilation Simulacrum commemorative avatar.
secondaryDescription:
"Venture into certain death and seize the one who stands against ten thousand!"
"...Uhh, Belle, this is only a data exercise. Maybe tone down the dramatic energy a little..."

name: M-Boo En-Nah En-Nah
description: Commemorative avatar for the collaboration with McDonald's Mainland China.
secondaryDescription:
A relaxing and joyful party time! All the BFFs have gathered... now,
who else is everyone waiting for?
Ta-da! M-Boo is right outside, delivering a feast of deliciousness!

name: Subtle Wink
description: Community event reward avatar.
secondaryDescription:
An invitation from Lumina Square has been received.
The breeze is gentle, the clouds are light, and the sun is just right... Why not set aside the Hollows, the Ethereals, and work for now, and sway leisurely amidst the crowd on this pleasant afternoon?

name: Gimme a Fanta!
description: Commemorative avatar for the collaboration with Fanta.
secondaryDescription:
Grab a Fanta, let the joy burst~
When those feel-good bubbles dance and rise, injecting Fanta's colorful dopamine into this moment — right now, let's make it pop with color!

name: A Flavorful Journey Home
description:
An avatar reward for the limited-time collab event "Operation Yum."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription: A platter of delicious food arrives at your doorstep. No matter the flavor, it always awakens that original feeling of warmth hidden deep in your heart, just like a gentle call from childhood at the dinner table, bringing back all the tenderness in the world.

name: Time for a Shining Eridu!
description: 2025 Zenless Zone Zero FES Commemorative Avatar.
secondaryDescription:
Thanks to Fairy's thoughtful planning, you finally get a break from your busy schedule.
Today's most important commission is to move with the beat and shine across New Eridu!

name: Crazy Support Day
description: Commemorative avatar for the collaboration event with KFC.
secondaryDescription:
Help the monochromatic K Boss take some color photos! The secret...? Inject some pink angel Fandom Power!
Crazy Fandom Day — don't you dare miss it!

name: Best Before
description: Commemorative avatar for the Operation Yum collab event.
secondaryDescription:
Perfectly controlled heat, perfectly balanced flavor. The perfect meal, served up by Bangboo culinary experts!
Best enjoyed right now!

name: Honorary Citizen
description: The standard namecard for Inter-Knot users.
secondaryDescription: Beyond the shadows of the Hollows, what we fight for and are proud of — is New Eridu.

name: Lucky Start
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription: Howl is waiting for you — go across the street to pick up a little luck and start your day in New Eridu!

name: Heatwave-Bound
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription: A 10-year consecutive winner of "The Ridu Tour" Best Summer Vacation Spots ranking. Reason: "Sunshine never gets old."

name: Mini Adventure Story
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
A commemorative namecard of the movie "7710 and Its Cat."
Watchers who wish to break the fourth wall obtained a story of regrets. Life and movies were always as separate as night and day... right?

name: Bardic Afternoon
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
A membership card for Bardic Needle.
Sharing music with an elegant lady under the gentle afternoon sun is quite the delightful experience. However, one will have to wait until the music plays to see if the needle has landed on what you want.

name: Sibling Friendship
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
"I love having snowball fights with Wise! Whoever wins gets to put a snow Bangboo on the other. He always lets me win~"
"The snowballs Belle makes hurt... a lot. I don't know how she manages to make them... Every time I have to quickly surrender to avoid further pain..."

name: Essential Agenda
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
This Family Day event's shift photographer and Head of Family Security, Lil Six, is here to capture beautiful moments for you:
The most important activity, the essential moment in the agenda— no matter if my bangs flap in the wind or if the wound from that snowball hasn't healed, we'll go out together to watch the fireworks!

name: Dream After the Rain
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
If the remainder of my life were to be nothing but repeating lines I've already recorded, at least I could still say "I love you" over and over.
The day we reunited after the disaster was too sudden... But when the rain clears and spring arrives, flowers will bloom, ready to be handed to my "beloved."

name: Pixel World Adventures
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
Taming soul-hounds, taking on greedy serpents, leaping over Turbo taxis... Nothing slows Phaethon down in the pixel world!
Victory after victory, it's time to resupply! Wait a sec — before we left, didn't someone say they'd bring the batteries?

name: "Tigerbane Legend"
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
"I hear Yunkui Summit is surrounded by dark miasma, and a glorious, ferocious tiger dwells within, sowing strife among the people. A heroic pair of siblings decide to act, disguising themselves as tigers and sneaking in..."
"Wait! Director! Didn't you say you'd use a green screen to edit all our actions in?! AAAHH!"

name: Special Snorkeling Photo Session
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
I arrived at the best snorkeling spot in New Eridu, recommended by the heir of a certain prominent family! But I politely turned down the photographer she suggested.
Maybe... when faced with a vibrant, unfamiliar world, there's no better photographer than curiosity; and when it comes to those we spend every day with, no technique beats patience and love.
—That doesn't guarantee a beautiful result, though.

name: Where Sky Rests in Water
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
"A lazy summer afternoon, lying on the water's surface, beneath the lotus flowers and leaves to cool off... This is exactly how animals in fairy tales must live!"
"Uh... if by 'animals' you mean like those half-asleep capybaras, and the lotus flowers and leaves are those freebie hair clips you just brought back from the accessory shop, Belle..."
"But... why am I the one wearing the flower?"

name: Upon a Pillow of Clouds
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
No Knock Knock alerts from my phone, no Agents politely or urgently knocking on my door, no emergency evacuation notices from PubSec echoing through the streets, even Fairy's processing sounds are as soft and airy as the wind passing through the clouds...
Finally, time to rest.

name: One Denny's Autumn Outing
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Premium Plan.
secondaryDescription:
In every story about autumn, I've gathered golden leaves, plush grass, and burning crimson slips of paper — but what I love most of all... is when you lean against my shell.
A Bangboo's Logic Core may just be a piece of machinery, yet in this warm, fuzzy moment, I could swear I hear it beating inside my chest.

name: New Idol Program
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription:
"I already told you, a lively, adorable video store manager like me, plus being a smart, fearless Proxy, I'm totally idol material..."
"Huh? Wise, are you okay?!"
"Belle, ch—change the song... this one's way too fast..."
Once the last encore chant was done, Wise sat down on the ground and, with the last bit of energy he had, managed two weak swings of his glowsticks.

name: Between White Doves and Fireworks
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription:
An amateur magician claims their top hat is bottomless, big enough to hold every miracle in the world. Maybe white doves bursting into flight, maybe fireworks waiting to be lit...
Or maybe you, smiling and waving at me.

"This... doesn't even count as magic, does it?"
"Really? The person who once tucked me under her hat as a kid didn't see it that way."

name: Isle of Gentle Dreams
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription:
A remarkable anti-gravity device that lets Eous drift off in any direction.
"ehn... nhe-ehn? (So this is what it feels like... after "managing your weight"?)"

"What?! Bangboo don't need to manage their weight! Who's been putting ideas in your head?!"
"Perhaps... it was that fitness meal takeout bag from our last order?"
"Ugh... I'm never ordering from that place again!"
"I agree. But... is that really because of Eous?"

name: Shadowlight Intermission
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription:
"Born anew from the theater, we step onto the stage before the curtain calls. Though the stars may dim for now, we... will make everyone shine bright." — Entrance line of an actor from a mysterious theater somewhere.
"Belle... do we seriously have to say that out loud when we make our entrance?"

name: The Truth of the World!
description: A commemorative namecard for the New Eridu City Fund: Growth Plan.
secondaryDescription:
Amid the overwhelming chaos of scattered clues, we are both the truth behind it all and each other's solution.

"Belle... those really just look like normal dog paw prints..."
"—Wise! A true master detective pays attention to every detail!"
"Pays attention to detail? So you can chase after them and make me ask the owner, 'Can I pet your dog?'"
"...That's just an older brother's job!"

name: "The Other Side"
description: A birthday gift for a Proxy.
secondaryDescription: Wishing the most amazing Proxy and the greatest video store manager in New Eridu — and my {M#brother}{F#sister} a happy birthday!

name: "You Sure Are Awesome, Purr~"
description: Obtain via limited-time event
secondaryDescription: Proof of being a good citizen with the image of the only mascot of Public Security imprinted — from the number of people who have these, it seems like Officer Mewmew thinks there are no bad citizens.

name: Popular Freebie
description: Obtain via limited-time event
secondaryDescription: A freebie from "The Ridu Tour" magazine... Considering how a reader has to buy the full volume to get this freebie, each one signifies an impressive profit for the magazine raked in by this event.

name: BFF Best Friends Forever!
description: Commemorative namecard for the collaboration with McDonald's Mainland China.
secondaryDescription:
No matter where you are, you can recall the BFFs you used to share fried chicken with when you order a BFF Platter.
Perhaps we may part ways in life, but our friendship and memories will forever be hot, juicy, and crispy, just like fried chicken!

name: Gulliver, Reporting In
description: A namecard reward for Version 1.4 "A Storm of Falling Stars" pre-registration event.
secondaryDescription:
Allow me to introduce the liaison officer dispatched by Section 6 for this special commission.
Its gaze is bright, it's got a steady and precise shot, it's steady and meticulous, and friendly and reliable. It is... Agent Gulliver!

name: "Fight On!"
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Bangboo vs Ethereal."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
"En-nah, neh! (Bad Ethereal, eat my kick!)"
—Visual recording from the Marcel Group's Combat Bangboo Examination, featured examinee: Nutty.

name: Assistant Director Pass
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Springtime Snapshots."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
Your Assistant Director Trial Card has arrived! Clapperboard? Check. Megaphone? Charged. Monitor? In position!
With the spring breeze in the air and the sunlight just right, friends are stepping into the spotlight — "Action!"

name: "Instant Trigger"
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Soul of Steel: Golden Bond."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription: We each have our own duty to protect, and our own reasons to fight. Even as the heavy iron fist falls, it can't erase the heart that shines with golden resolve.

name: A Special Day
description: A birthday gift for a Proxy.
secondaryDescription:
This might not be much of a surprise, since we all know it always comes, year after year.
Even so, it's best not to disturb Eous' rehearsal! If the launch angle isn't just right, it could end up knocking over those expensive, fragile, discontinued VHS tapes...

name: Delicious Light
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time collab event "Operation Yum."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
Is there perhaps a world made from the ground up with simple, classic, and delicious food?
And at the center of this world, the us of the past, without worries or troubles.

name: Dopamine Vacation Plan
description: Commemorative namecard for the collaboration with Fanta.
secondaryDescription:
The ideal vacation plan includes many activities: meals with friends, pleasant walks, and peaceful moments of rest...
The one thing you need for all of it is a can of Fanta — pop the tab and let orange joy burst and flow through your holiday!

name: Rhythm Raver
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Rhythm Rave."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the rave~
We irresponsibly promise to help you leave all your daily woes behind and let your true self run wild! Feel free to share your deepest thoughts with our staff — even if you're a Bangboo complaining about your owner. We promise to forget it immediately.

name: Project Shining Hollow
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "SNAP! Shining Strike."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
Click-click-click! The Ethereals quake in fear!
Click-click-click! His name resounds through every Hollow!
Everyone, join me in giving a cheer and thunderous applause to the one and only Ethereal Terminator, the Hollow savior, Mr. Click!

name: "To Be Continued"
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Neo Golden Mecha."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
To give wings to an unfinished dream, waiting for it to become a shooting star beneath the night sky. To boast before my younger, naive self, swearing I'd witness the brightest dawn.
And when I look back, that golden dream still stands, watching beyond the horizon — we never truly left our childhood behind.
"Golden Mecha, stand tall upon the earth!"

name: Sparkling Wonderland
description: 2025 Zenless Zone Zero FES commemorative namecard.
secondaryDescription:
After receiving more than a few enthusiastic invitations, the Proxy siblings showed up right on time at "The Best Sounding Spot in New Eridu."
What they didn't expect was to become the stars of the audience — after all, not many fans have lightsticks that glow in every performer's color at a joint concert.

name: Sān-Z: Undying Spark
description: Commemorative namecard for the limited-time event "Filmgoer Thank-You Gift."
secondaryDescription:
"From that very first spark, we've blazed a path across the world — but this is nowhere near the end. As long as the fire in our chests keeps dancing, the story doesn't end."
"We hope you'll stay with us on the journey to come. Let's set off together and light up the next chapter of New Eridu!"
— Sān-Z STUDIO

name: Maze Exit
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Joint Investigation: The Divine Maze."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription: The joint investigation into the Divine Maze has finally wrapped up. Thanks to the efforts of our Agents, the squad broke through Papago's maze and fulfilled HAND's request. Yet from the eerie sounds at the Hollow's entrance to the sudden return of old shadows, every unanswered mystery hints at one thing — the end of this case might just be the beginning.

name: The Shape of Delusion
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Angels of Delusion Training in Progress."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
The girls seize their imaginings the way you'd lift a naughty kitten, tracing the outlines to give them shape... clumsy, soft curves that stack together like building blocks you can form into anything.
During their time with the "assistant," those blocks piled higher and higher, becoming charming stages and castles... and with a bright melody underfoot, they stepped upward, turning everyday life into a tiny musical.

name: Deliciousness Ready to Roll
description: Commemorative namecard for the collaboration with Hormel.
secondaryDescription:
Clear skies and bright sunshine put everyone in a good mood. It's the perfect time for a little outdoor escapade.
Grab a couple of friends and share some tasty, easygoing moments together.
Take off on a spontaneous outing — deliciousness is ready to roll!

name: A Perfect Story on Screen
description: "Gravitational Storytime" commemorative namecard.
secondaryDescription:
A ticket stub from "Gravitational Storytime" that bears witness to time spent with someone important — time called "togetherness."
The Gilded Carrot Day screening story reaches a perfect ending, and the memories spun by "Gravity" will shine for all time.

name: Returning Photos to Dreams
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "Adventure Footage Freeze Frame."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
It carried his dreams and charged into the depths of the Hollow.
He gathered its memories in his hands, piecing together the scattered images of their adventures.

name: Pursuit of the Paranormal
description:
A namecard reward for the limited-time event "A Look Into Ridu's Legends."
Limited-time reward.
secondaryDescription:
All the coordinates on the Ridu urban legend tour map have been woven together into one web address used only for urban legends.
"To those who came chasing urban legends, welcome to Spook Shack!" This is the first greeting every visitor sees after opening the link.

name: Stargazy (Improved)
description: A birthday gift for a Proxy.
secondaryDescription:
Prepared by a local Bangboo chef based on a legendary recipe from the early days of Roscaelifer, this pastry tastes quite different from the original due to the recipe being lost to time, leaving everyone sighing in regret.
Legend says it once had a romantic name: "Stargazy."

Note: No Eous units were harmed during the making of this cake!

name: Delusion Support Project
description: Commemorative namecard for the collaboration with KFC.
secondaryDescription:
"I heard they're an incredibly famous brand — we absolutely can't mess this up! B—But why did they pick us in the first place...?"
"You must know, right, Xiao'Yu? Ms. Cecilia mentioned that a few days ago, you..."
"...Oh, I don't really know either! But I heard that once this project's finished, Sunna won't have to worry about lunch money ever again~"
"R—Really? Then that's another fixed group expense we can cut down on!!"
"—Wait, Sunna! Weren't we just saying we should figure out why they picked us first...?"

name: With Food Comes Fortune
description: Commemorative namecard for the Operation Yum collab event.
secondaryDescription:
Marcel Group has rolled out an updated version of the taste Chip, and Bangboo can now distinguish the flavors of over a thousand different foods.
—Unfortunately, that still doesn't include the experimental dishes cooked up in your kitchen through pure "I reckon this'll work" logic.

name: Winding Roses
description: Namecard reward from Hollow Zero Investigation License Level.
secondaryDescription: A gift from Hollow Zero that's impossible to refuse — if fortunate, the recipient will be surrounded by the scent of 'flowers' for the rest of their days.

name: Something Certain
description: Namecard reward from Hollow Zero: Lost Void Investigation License Level.
secondaryDescription: "Here lies Alowyn. We may not know her past, but we know she is a friend." An inscription in memory of Alowyn. Beside it blooms a tiny flower.

name: Puppeteer's Letter
description: Namecard reward from Hollow Zero: Lost Void Investigation License Level.
secondaryDescription:
The puppeteer pulling the strings in the Lost Void still lurks in the shadows... Only this strange letter tells of its presence, an invitation.
Give up control of your body and it shall give you the right to wander here... until your consciousness dissipates, until forever...

name: Thousand Wishes of Dawn
description: A commemorative namecard from increasing the Suibian Temple Restoration Level in "As Time Passes: A Decade of Suibian Temple"
secondaryDescription:
Every fold of the skyletter hides murmurs of the mortal world, bobbing and undulating on the horizon, until they vanish.
Once the night wind carries away the last glow of sunlight, the tides formed from heartbeats calm, people realize... Those unspoken blessings of peace and safe return have been read by the clouds countless times.

name: Savor the Thrill of Battle
description: Commemorative namecard for specific scores in "Battle Trial: Glory."
secondaryDescription:
Whether you came out of the "Endless Tower" beaten down, cornered by endless enemies, or barely clinging to life...
Now's the time to celebrate your win. Stand tall and declare, "None of them were a match for me!"

name: Final Gambit
description: Commemorative namecard for "Threshold Simulation: Branching Echoes."
secondaryDescription:
Explore every possible path in "Threshold Simulation," and watch long-buried secrets emerge from the mist.
Choose carefully, but never lose the courage to move forward.

name: Smash Through Everything!
description: Commemorative namecard for specific scores in "Battle Trial: Tidal Wave."
secondaryDescription:
Whether treasure or enemies lie behind the wall doesn't matter. Just grab the weapon in your hand and smash everything to pieces!
Break through every obstacle, climb to the top of the tower, and soak in the cheers of victory!

name: Because Tomorrow Still Comes
description: A commemorative namecard obtained by increasing the Central Computing Hub repair progress in "The Genius and the Miracle Chip!"
secondaryDescription:
"Then... I suppose it's time for us to say goodbye."
—"What is goodbye?"
"It's writing a long letter, filling it with all your memories and well wishes, and sending it toward tomorrow as you set off."
—"Then... we can also say — let's go!"

May we always have an endless past to draw from, and a tomorrow vast enough to dream freely toward.

name: Rank-Forged Blade Ballad
description: Achieve a 2-Rank rating in Deadly Assault's Desperation Mode to automatically unlock a limited-time namecard reward.
secondaryDescription:
The cosmos stretches boundless, and the stars burn with unrivaled brilliance.
From this very ground we rise, iron blades in hand, forging legends that will never fade.

name: Anby's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Anby's Mindscape: Well-Disciplined
secondaryDescription:
A card with a core member of the Cunning Hares printed on it.
A movie OST plays upon calling this number. Anby sometimes likes to deliberately answer calls late so that everyone has a chance to listen to her favorite song.

name: Nekomata's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Nekomata's Mindscape: Curious Left Tail
secondaryDescription:
A card with the newest member of the Cunning Hares printed on it.
Every namecard handed out means another chance at landing an outstanding commission! Looking forward to this, the new member has diligently designed this namecard and even drawn a small bell in the corner.

name: Nicole's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Nicole's Mindscape: A Hare's Cunning
secondaryDescription:
A card with the manager of the Cunning Hares printed on it.
Contact this number right now? It is highly recommended that you disable all automatic debit services on your device prior to contacting this number.

name: Soldier 11's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Soldier 11's Mindscape: Elite Soldier
secondaryDescription:
A card with the lead striker from Obol Squad printed on it.
Using the contact info on this card to contact Soldier 11 naturally trips Defense Force systems, but it's also the most stable and efficient channel of communication — she has promised to always arrive on time.

name: Yidhari's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Yidhari's Mindscape: A Story Without an Audience
secondaryDescription:
A namecard printed with the image of Spook Shack contributor, Yidhari.
The card is one of a kind, made especially for a person she cares about. The back is particularly creative—
Alongside Yidhari's carefully handwritten name and contact details are what look like suction-like marks, the combined autograph of her "little ones"!

name: Corin's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Corin's Mindscape: Amateur Maid
secondaryDescription:
A card with a shy maid from Victoria Housekeeping printed on it.
At first, Corin diligently listed all the housekeeping services she provided. After being contacted a little too frequently, she was forced to also list the explicit prices of each service.

name: Caesar's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Caesar's Mindscape: Absolute Trust
secondaryDescription:
A namecard with the image of the safety consultant from Leaps and Bounds.
It looks very professional, meticulous, and thorough — if you can overlook that the last digit of the contact number was filled in with a pen. Seems like this safety consultant often needs help from a more meticulous friend.

name: Billy's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Billy's Mindscape: Teachings of the Starlight Knights
secondaryDescription:
A card with the combat intelligent construct of the Cunning Hares printed on it.
Clearly mimicking the style of the Starlight Knight's official card, even the anti-counterfeit protection is copied near exactly... It may be copied poorly, but it's still near exact.

name: Hoshimi Miyabi's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Hoshimi Miyabi's Mindscape: Martial Discipline
secondaryDescription:
A card with the image of HSO Section 6's Chief printed on it.
Completely useless when actually trying to get in contact — after all, communication from within Hollows is difficult — this card is, nonetheless, an immense honor to possess. Both sides are imprinted with elegant and ancient-looking patterns, but the image doesn't seem to have anything to do with the Hoshimi family.

name: Koleda's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Koleda's Mindscape: "Mind Your Own!"
secondaryDescription:
A card with the president of Belobog Heavy Industries printed on it.
A professional namecard is a must for any president — but not this one, which is for friends only. However, due to the president's busy schedule, the chance of getting through to her "friend hotline" is vanishingly slim.

name: Anton's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Anton's Mindscape: Rotational Training
secondaryDescription:
A card with the worksite overseer of Belobog Heavy Industries printed on it.
A friendly reminder to hold your phone slightly away from your ear when contacting the number on this card, unless you are well-prepared for the noise of the construction site and the thundering "bro."

name: Ben's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Ben's Mindscape: Careful Accounting
secondaryDescription:
A card with the head of finance of Belobog Heavy Industries printed on it.
The most commonly used namecard in all Belobog. Ben printed 4 separate backup phone numbers on it to ensure important affairs and remittance time can be promptly communicated.

name: Soukaku's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Soukaku's Mindscape: Attendance Meal Allowance
secondaryDescription:
A card with a member of Section 6 printed on it.
While having a lot of commemorative value, this card has almost no practical use. Even if Soukaku could actually be contacted with it, her "guardian" in the squad would once again filter out the commissions she can take on.

name: Lycaon's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Lycaon's Mindscape: Attendant Training
secondaryDescription:
A card with a Victoria Housekeeping attendant printed on it.
Very few clients ever receive a copy of this elegant, refined card. It symbolizes approval from a wolf Thiren, and can be thought of as a light pawprint upon the back of your hand.

name: Lucy's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Lucy's Mindscape: Ironfist Overseer
secondaryDescription:
A card with a Boar Thiren Overseer from Leaps and Bounds Express Services Co. printed on it.
This namecard has an exquisite texture and design from a Throne Quarter print shop. But currently its only use is in contacting the little boars roaming the Outer Ring for delivery.

name: Lighter's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Lighter's Mindscape: Mercenary Leader
secondaryDescription:
A card with the image of Leaps and Bounds Logistics Company's Hollow affairs consultant printed on it.
The edges of the card are charred and burned but luckily don't cover the prices. "Any fighting is guaranteed to be a good show," is also written on it... Is this really proper Hollow consulting?

name: Burnice's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Burnice's Mindscape: Optimistic by Nature
secondaryDescription:
A namecard with the image of the marketing consultant from Leaps and Bounds.
It looks like someone doodled over it. The handwriting on the contact details is very... wild. The names of many drinks are scribbled on the back, but there's a big circle drawn around the Nitro-Fuel, and a note that says "min 1 pack for delivery."

name: Grace's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Grace's Mindscape: Chief Mechanic
secondaryDescription:
A card with a Belobog Heavy Industries engineer printed on it.
To avoid being disturbed, Grace usually hands out random namecards with a special direct hotline to her "kid" that's most gifted at chatting... But don't worry. This card is not one of those.

name: Ellen's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Ellen's Mindscape: Overtime-Intolerant
secondaryDescription:
A card with an apathetic Victoria Housekeeping maid printed on it.
These namecards had to be "carefully" prepared under the watchful gaze of the head maid and a professional attendant. Besides handing these out to clients, some have also been given to classmates stuck in the same group project.

name: Asaba Harumasa's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Asaba Harumasa's Mindscape: White Lies
secondaryDescription:
A card with the image of a HSO Section 6 member printed on it.
This card has two printed editions with the only difference being the contact number. For one of these versions, the only thing that one will hear when calling is a notice that the number they have dialed does not exist... Apparently, most of the victims of this are the bigwigs at HSO.

name: Rina's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Rina's Mindscape: Head Maid's Specialty
secondaryDescription:
A card with a Victoria Housekeeping maid printed on it.
You can summon a gentle and beautiful maid with this namecard. But if you weren't the direct recipient... please come clean about it BEFORE drinking any coffee she serves~

name: Tsukishiro Yanagi's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Tsukishiro Yanagi's Mindscape: Tsukishiro Style Management
secondaryDescription:
A card with the image of HSO Section 6's Deputy Chief printed on it.
A valuable card that's considered a token of Section 6's friendship and commitment to the members of the HSO. Apart from contact information, it also carefully lists various means of seeking assistance in emergencies.

name: Zhu Yuan's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Zhu Yuan's Mindscape: Public Security Special Training
secondaryDescription:
A card with the image of the of the team leader of a Criminal Investigation Special Response Team of some department.
In theory, all Public Security Officers share a contact number that represents safety and responsibility, but the number on this card of Zhu Yuan's is her personal number.

name: Qingyi's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Qingyi's Mindscape: Drink Hot Water
secondaryDescription:
A card with an outstanding officer from the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team printed on it.
Hard currency within the NEPS. Possession of this namecard is equivalent to owning your own support force you can drop in at any minute, equally competent at evidence inspection or case analysis.

name: Jane's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Jane's Mindscape: Anonymity
secondaryDescription:
A card with a criminology specialist printed on it.
It's supposed to be a namecard, but there are no contact numbers on it... It isn't easy for anyone, no matter who, to get hold of that lady.

name: Seth's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Seth's Mindscape: Slow Reflexes
secondaryDescription:
A card with a rookie officer from the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team printed on it.
The NEPS standard namecard format is simple and clear. While taking the profile photo, Officer Seth was asked not to let his unkempt bangs cover up his ears.

name: Piper's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Piper's Mindscape: Truck Expert
secondaryDescription:
A card with a truck driver from Leaps and Bounds Express Services Co. printed on it.
The steadiest of hands whose delivery routes traverse the Hollows and the Outer Ring. Contact them for any long-distance deliveries — but please note, safety of fragile items cannot be guaranteed.

name: Hugo's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Hugo's Mindscape: Fruit of the Poisonous Tree
secondaryDescription:
A card featuring the image of a famous phantom thief.
On the back, bold letters read: "The one and only in all of New Eridu", accompanied by a flamboyant handwritten signature.
After all, if everyone recognized this gentleman thief... he might be doomed to endlessly change identities on the ever-shifting stage of light and shadow.

name: Orphie & Magus' Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Orphie & Magus' Mindscape: "Tactics Manual"
secondaryDescription:
A name card printed with the image of the gun-type Intelligent Construct Magus and her wielder, Orphie.
Name, rank, squad affiliation, contact details, all neatly laid out on this card. The precise formatting and carefully chosen content reflect the owner's serious personality.
But flip it over, and on the back... there's a red T. rex breathing fire, drawn in permanent marker?

name: Astra Yao's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Astra Yao's Mindscape: Interwoven Staff Notation
secondaryDescription:
A business card featuring the image of a glamorous superstar.
It's widely known that any number on a celebrity's card leads to an agent who answers like a programmed, automatic response. But if it's a card she hands to you personally... perhaps it's different?

name: Evelyn's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Evelyn's Mindscape: Metamorphosis
secondaryDescription:
A business card featuring the image of a not-too-famous security consultant.
For those ready to spend a small fortune on security, this clean and straightforward card symbolizes a second chance at life. Unfortunately, the well-reputed "Life Protection Service" is currently unavailable for purchase.

name: Vivian's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Vivian's Mindscape: "Another and the Same"
secondaryDescription:
A namecard printed with a photo of Mockingbird's versatile assistant, Vivian.
Mockingbird's business cards have never circulated publicly — if one were placed in a private auction, collectors would surely bid fiercely for it.
There's no contact information on this card, yet it's said that anyone who holds it won't have to wait long before the graceful and mysterious assistant finds them — through a method they'd never anticipate.

name: Zhao's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Zhao's Mindscape: Frostveil Blade
secondaryDescription:
A namecard printed with an adorable bunny Thiren's image.
It's got that classic Krampus Compliance Authority style — neat, professional, and packed with phone numbers... everything from Krampus' legal hotline to their complaint desk. But on the back, there's a handwritten note and a single number:
"Forget those numbers. Call this one if you want to reach me."

name: Pulchra's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Pulchra's Mindscape: Territorial
secondaryDescription:
A card featuring an image of the former Outer Ring mercenary now working for Leaps and Bounds logistics company.
It's the standard business card used by employees of Leaps and Bounds, but on the back, there's a line of text: "Private services available." Apparently, while others' got their cards slow, this one was printed twice in the first month.

name: Trigger's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Trigger's Mindscape: "Homecoming"
secondaryDescription:
A card featuring an image of the Obol Squad sniper.
In addition to the contact information printed on the card, there is a neatly handwritten list of backup contacts, emergency contacts, final emergency contacts, code words to use in case of danger, and several commonly used Morse codes for requesting help. She seems truly afraid of losing contact with you.

name: Yixuan's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Yixuan's Mindscape: Cycle of Yin and Yang
secondaryDescription:
A card imprinted with the image of Yunkui Summit's Yixuan, also identifying her as a Special Investigator with the Hollow Investigative Association.
Yixuan Shifu is apparently quite elusive, and only a fated few ever receive her guidance. Who knows — this card might be your invitation into the sect.

name: Soldier 0 - Anby's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Soldier 0 - Anby's Mindscape: Past Glory
secondaryDescription:
A card featuring the unfamiliar image of a friend.
In this city, who doesn't have secrets or a past they prefer to keep hidden? Perhaps we don't need to cross that line; in the long, cold nights, we can still find warmth in each other.

name: Ju Fufu's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Ju Fufu's Mindscape: Righteous Young Hero
secondaryDescription:
A card imprinted with the image of Yunkui Summit's most senior disciple.
Instead of dialing her number, the sect's exclusive voice-transmission technique calls a disciple in an instant. So beyond the contact details, it even includes the incantation to call the "super scary big tiger":
Senior, Shifu has been kidnapped by Ethereals!

name: Alice's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Alice's Mindscape: Symmetrism
secondaryDescription:
A name card bearing the image of the heiress of the Thymefield family.
Many high-society figures have tried to get their hands on this noble family's contact info, only to end up with a "business card" that's all symmetry and no number. But this one's special... it has the young lady's name written in graceful script, plus a cute, perfectly symmetrical doodle of a bunny — showing just how much she values the person receiving it.

name: Ukinami Yuzuha's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Ukinami Yuzuha's Mindscape: Fairytale of the Haunted City.
secondaryDescription:
A business card from Mystic Wares, with Ukinami Yuzuha's name and phone number handwritten on the back.
Call the number, and you'll be greeted by Baorong's deep, booming voice as the custom ringtone. It's a bit startling, but according to Yuzuha, it's not a prank — it's just an effective way to fend off telemarketers.

name: Pan Yinhu's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Pan Yinhu's Mindscape: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
secondaryDescription:
A namecard featuring Yunkui Summit's official chef.
To street vendors, it's the bargaining chip the clever Panda Thiren uses, to seasoned foodies, it's a limited-edition ticket to a meet-and-greet with the mysterious master chef, and to the struggling masses, it's a lifeline left by the Yunkui disciple determined to put others first.

name: Ye Shunguang's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Ye Shunguang's Mindscape: Swordswoman
secondaryDescription:
A namecard bearing the image of Ye Shunguang.
This card never circulates publicly; it's said that only a select few "fated recipients" ever obtain one. Possessing it grants a one-time "Void Hunter assistance."
On the back is a hand-drawn doodle of a face and a line of neat handwriting:
"No matter when... if you ever need me, just come find me. If I can help, I'd be happy to!"

name: Komano Manato's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Komano Manato's Mindscape: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
secondaryDescription:
A card printed with an image of Sailume Bay's unofficial mediator.
This business card can smooth over a number of minor issues, but its use is limited to certain areas of Waifei Peninsula. During Manato's make-up exams, the card functions merely as a simple referral.
A sketch of a "grand and imposing" canine Thiren was drawn on the back, though in crayon, making it feel a little less threatening.

name: Lucia's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Lucia's Mindscape: The Best Partner
secondaryDescription:
A name card featuring the Night Emissary's image.
While exploring a Hollow on the edge of the city, the Investigative Association stumbled upon this card. It had been placed deep within an Ethereal nest, with a doodle of a witch brandishing her staff sketched on the back.
"At first we thought it was some kind of distress signal, but later realized it really was just a business card... Seriously, who in the world would hand something like that to an Ethereal?!"

name: Seed's namecard
description: Get by unlocking Seed's Mindscape: "A Story of Sprouting"
secondaryDescription:
A card printed with the image of Obol Squad's heavy weapons specialist.
It carries a faint floral scent, but no name, no contact info, nothing remotely helpful — only a few indecipherable doodles and notes that look like the owner scrawled them at random. Whether it's a major company eager to learn the secrets behind her inventions or a military official furious about being blindsided by a giant mech, no one's reaching her through this card.
If the scent of flowers suddenly grows stronger while you're reading the card, take a look around — you might just find a girl nearby who looks like a water sprite. When someone truly piques her interest, she just shows up on her own.

name: Banyue's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Banyue's Mindscape: Ignorance Binds Like Chains
secondaryDescription:
A name card with the image of Banyue, a newly appointed Krampus Judge and head of a martial arts school.
The design is plain, but it bears a distinctive and solid weight.
On the back, Banyue's name is engraved with the bold strength of a blade and chisel.

name: Dialyn's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Dialyn's Mindscape: Call from the Hollow
secondaryDescription:
A name card bearing the image of Dialyn, the Krampus Judge and TOPS customer service representative.
Dialyn receives countless calls every workday, but the special number printed on this card can be reached by only one person.

name: Sunna's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Sunna's Mindscape: "Transformation Apple"
secondaryDescription:
A namecard featuring Sunna from the Angels of Delusion.
The background weaves together mint green and pebble white, accented with peach-pink lace patterns. With such an adorable card, its owner must be just like this soft pastel stock — evoking thoughts of a fresh summer day.

name: Aria's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Aria's Mindscape: Delulu
secondaryDescription:
A namecard featuring Aria, the Angels of Delusion's lead vocalist.
A beloved collectible among Delulus, calling the number printed on the card plays the Angels of Delusion's newest track, and after connecting, you can also look up details on their recent and upcoming shows.

name: Nangong Yu's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Nangong Yu's Mindscape: Chips on the Scales
secondaryDescription:
A card with the Angels of Delusion's captain, Nangong Yu printed on it.
It features a classic black background with gold foil stamping and faint wing patterns embossed along the edges. When you call, you'll hear the sweet voice of a staff member handling the Angels of Delusion's business inquiries. But rumor has it there's a tiny chance the Angels' captain herself might pick up...

name: Cissia's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Cissia's Mindscape: Chains and a Warm Nest
secondaryDescription:
A card with the Public Security case specialist Cissia printed on it.
Other than the official formatting and Public Security emblem, it also bears two faint tooth marks.

name: Starlight - Billy's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Starlight - Billy's Mindscape: Knight's Chivalry
secondaryDescription:
A card printed with an image of Knight Billy and his upgraded armaments.
A special, customised Starlight Knight official fan's namecard. Though real heroes need no anti-counterfeit proof, there is indeed a gilded one on the card... This hero, however, is a familiar yet unfamiliar one.

name: Promeia's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Promeia's Mindscape: Cruel Moonlight
secondaryDescription:
A namecard featuring Krampus Judge Promeia.
Aside from her name and position within Krampus, the namecard appears completely blank. Holding it brings a calm, cool sensation.

name: Velina's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Velina's Mindscape: Conquest by Etiquette
secondaryDescription:
A business card bearing the image of the Administrative Director of the External Strategy Department.
Its design is elegant and restrained, with clean lines and not a trace of unnecessary flourish — neither overly familiar to the point of impropriety, nor so cold as to create a sense of distance. Every detail strikes a perfect balance. Among the elite of Roscaelifer, owning one is considered a mark of pride.
But when an ordinary video store owner accepts it as part of a routine exchange, they discover something unexpected — beneath the card lies another one. Written in neat, graceful handwriting is a private number, separate from the public line.
So... is this, too, some unspoken form of "special treatment"?

name: Norma's Namecard
description: Get by unlocking Norma's Mindscape: Natural-Born Villain Paradox
secondaryDescription:
A business card bearing the image of Norma, Chief Technician of the External Strategy Department.
Specially designed for high-ranking department officials, the card's elaborate decorative patterns also function as physical watermarks. Yet the space intended for a serious professional photo is instead covered with playful Bangboo scribbles.

name: "Ending Theme"
description: Get by unlocking Anby's Mindscape: Charging Field
secondaryDescription:
A card with Anby's personal photo printed on it.
"What am I listening to? Hmm, it's a fantastic ending theme..."
"It's from the movie we watched together last time... When I thought you were secretly crying."

name: "Patience of a Cat"
description: Get by unlocking Nekomata's Mindscape: Predator Lineage
secondaryDescription:
A card with Nekomata's personal photo printed on it.
"Meow~! Are you sure~ you don't want to play with me? I've been waiting all this time, meow—"
"You know what it means when a cat slaps its tail against the ground, right—meow?"

name: "Precise Focus"
description: Get by unlocking Nicole's Mindscape: Corrupting Energy Field
secondaryDescription:
A card with Nicole's personal photo printed on it.
"Quick, check out this one! Pretty sweet, huh... Don't I look totally delicate and cute?"
"Did I not get the Bangboo charm you picked out in frame? Oh, it's a little out of focus... Better take another shot!"

name: "Trust Your Life"
description: Get by unlocking Soldier 11's Mindscape: Scorching Flow
secondaryDescription:
A card with Soldier 11's personal photo printed on it.
"My loyalty belongs solely to the Defense Force..."
"But as a mutually-recognized comrade-in-arms, I can entrust my life to you."

name: One of a Kind
description: Get by unlocking Yidhari's Mindscape: At Last, a Peaceful Dream
secondaryDescription:
A card with Yidhari's personal photo printed on it.
"From the moment I saw your eyes in that illusion, I understood..."
"After that, I no longer feared my mind would be consumed by the void, nor that I would be lost to the abyss."
"Because within the illusion, I found the one and only reality I could look to."

name: "Good Friends"
description: Get by unlocking Corin's Mindscape: Accumulated Release
secondaryDescription:
A card with Corin's personal photo printed on it.
"{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} P—Proxy, you w—wanna know about my teddy bear?"
"This is my good friend... N—No, it's not like you. Y—You are..."

name: "After the Battle"
description: Get by unlocking Caesar's Mindscape: Overlord's Will
secondaryDescription:
A card with Caesar's personal photo printed on it.
"Let's go, Proxy. The trouble here's been dealt with... but could you help me put on some medicine?"
"I'm the boss! I don't wanna make everyone worry..."

name: "Perfect Pose"
description: Get by unlocking Billy's Mindscape: Starlight Hero
secondaryDescription:
A card with Billy's personal photo printed on it.
"Proxy! How'd ya like my perfect pose... Hey hey hey, c'mon now! I say, c'mon now — I can't hold this all day! Ah!"
"Didja geddit, didja geddit? Did you manage to get my high-density alloy abs in the shot?"

name: "Today's Training"
description: Get by unlocking Hoshimi Miyabi's Mindscape: Prodigious Talent
secondaryDescription:
A card with a personal photo of Hoshimi Miyabi printed on it.
"Would you mind lending me a hand? I may have... overdone it on today's training."
"It's not an issue with sword swinging training... Alright, well, the thirty-fifth corrupted... it was tougher than expected."

name: "Pink Bear"
description: Get by unlocking Koleda's Mindscape: Saturated Blast
secondaryDescription:
A card with Koleda's personal photo printed on it.
"Hey, don't look at me like that — I'm not a kid looking to be pitied!"
"What? What's wrong with the pink bear bandaid..."

name: "Everyone Get Fired Up!"
description: Get by unlocking Anton's Mindscape: Break the Limit
secondaryDescription:
A card with Anton's personal photo printed on it.
"Hey, bro! Everyone get fired up!"
"Don't exercise without warming up first, or you might get injured!"

name: "Careful Contemplation"
description: Get by unlocking Ben's Mindscape: Wild Spirit
secondaryDescription:
A card with Ben's personal photo printed on it.
"Hmm? Do I look very serious right now?"
"I'm in a slight pickle... 26 Dennies are missing from last month's accounts, and I can't seem to figure out how..."

name: "Take a Break"
description: Get by unlocking Soukaku's Mindscape: Northern Wind
secondaryDescription:
A card with Soukaku's personal photo printed on it.
"I'm just going to lie down for a bit. Just a little while longer..."
"I get tired so easily if I don't eat much for breakfast! I'll just rest a little while longer..."

name: "Thank You For Requesting Me"
description: Get by unlocking Lycaon's Mindscape: Ruthless Hunter
secondaryDescription:
A card with Lycaon's personal photo printed on it.
"Proxy? Could you assist me in tying this bandage..."
"Very well... A little tighter... It shan't hurt. It must be tight to prevent injuries."

name: "Little Boars, Coming Right Up"
description: Get by unlocking Lucy's Mindscape: Fierce Fangs of Fire
secondaryDescription:
A card with Lucy's personal photo printed on it.
"Want this little boar doll? Then come and get it yourself..."
"I finally found a comfortable position, and I'm not moving from it."

name: "Black Boxing Gloves"
description: Get by unlocking Lighter's Mindscape: Survivor
secondaryDescription:
A card with Lighter's photo printed on it.
"If you need any help that you'd rather your more... 'honest' friends not find out about, just hit me up."
"I'll deal with it and make sure no one gets away to continue harassing you."

name: "An Invitation or Provocation?"
description: Get by unlocking Burnice's Mindscape: Burning Invitation
secondaryDescription:
A card with Burnice's personal photo printed on it.
"I decided before leaving that today, we drink until dawn!"
"Lemme think... considering your performance before... let's start with five cups of Nitro-Fuel as a warmup!"

name: "A Promise Unbroken"
description: Get by unlocking Grace's Mindscape: Detonation Trigger
secondaryDescription:
A card with Grace's personal photo printed on it.
"Sometimes I want to just pull apart someone as interesting as you to see what makes you tick..."
"Don't worry. I wouldn't do that though... I'd be beside myself if any parts got lost!"

name: "I'll Take Care of It"
description: Get by unlocking Ellen's Mindscape: The Feast Begins
secondaryDescription:
A card with Ellen's personal photo printed on it.
"Tsk, that sounds like a real pain..."
"What am I to do with you... As a friend, I'll take care of that thing you mentioned. But in exchange, you'll help me out at the next parent-teacher meeting... Okay?"

name: "Feathered Blade Approaching"
description: Get by unlocking Asaba Harumasa's Mindscape: Tacit Understanding
secondaryDescription:
A card with Asaba Harumasa's personal picture printed on it.
"Ahem... I'm not one of those powerful recon soldiers, agile and able to travel thousands of miles for a surprise strike..."
"But my arrows are pretty fast, hm... Probably faster than anything that would attempt to take your life."

name: "The Truth"
description: Get by unlocking Rina's Mindscape: Stormy Night's Fright
secondaryDescription:
A card with Rina's personal photo printed on it.
"You can trust me completely... Your wish is my command~"
"Wish! Wish!" "Command! Command!"

name: "Final Emergency Plan"
description: Get by unlocking Tsukishiro Yanagi's Mindscape: Inhuman Blood
secondaryDescription:
A card with Tsukishiro Yanagi's personal photo printed on it.
"Though I'd like to make a cool promise, something like: No matter what danger you're in, please place your trust in Section 6!"
"But I think for most people, it's more fortunate if they never need to contact us."

name: "Justice and Order"
description: Get by unlocking Zhu Yuan's Mindscape: Expanded Energy Pack III
secondaryDescription:
A card with Zhu Yuan's personal photo printed on it.
"Be it the NEPS or the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, they both exist to preserve justice and order."
"As do I."

name: "Drink Hot Water"
description: Get by unlocking Qingyi's Mindscape: Eight Meridians
secondaryDescription:
A card with Qingyi's personal photo printed on it.
"Good morning! Are you looking for a water bottle?"
"If you can't find one, why don't you take this flask with you?"

name: "Anonymity"
description: Get by unlocking Jane's Mindscape: "Shady" Technique
secondaryDescription:
A card with Jane's personal photo printed on it.
"Don't you think that's interesting — getting a namecard from a nameless person?"
"But there's a way to get hold of me on it, anyway — whether you believe it or not~"

name: "Leave It To Me"
description: Get by unlocking Seth's Mindscape: Idealist
secondaryDescription:
A card with Seth's personal photo printed on it.
"I'm going to be the best officer of them all!"
"Ow! Even if it's something as basic as soothing a cat... Just leave it to me! Yeowch!"

name: "Taste in Shows"
description: Get by unlocking Piper's Mindscape: Mild Excitement
secondaryDescription:
A card with Piper's personal photo printed on it.
"Ha... I'm not young like you, and I'm getting tired already."
"Let's listen to something interesting so we don't get exhausted from driving... How about the Ridu Lucky Star?"

name: Conspirator
description: Get by unlocking Hugo's Mindscape: Crown of Thorns
secondaryDescription:
A card featuring a private photo of Hugo.
"All cursed crowns will eventually shatter into stars."
"Now, allow me to invite you to leap with me — into this mist filled with thorns and flowers."

name: Peach-Flavored Flash Suppressor
description: Get by unlocking Orphie & Magus' Mindscape: Magic Seed
secondaryDescription:
A business card printed with a private photo of Orphie & Magus.
"I've got another secret to share... Actually, Magus really likes being around you too, Proxy!"
"Orphys, I'll be more mindful of how I talk from now on, okay? So stop talking, and take this pink ribbon off me too!"

name: Firelight Palm
description: Get by unlocking Astra Yao's Mindscape: We Are the World
secondaryDescription:
A card with a personal photo of Astra Yao.
"The criteria for choosing gems? It's certainly not boring numbers like clarity, craftsmanship, or weight~"
"But if you're too shy to even look me in the eye, how would you ever know the real reason they're being given to you?"

name: Impromptu Combat Practice
description: Get by unlocking Evelyn's Mindscape: Bond of Light and Shadow
secondaryDescription:
A card featuring a personal photo of Evelyn.
"Of course, I'll stay on guard... Wait, do you mean to say because I'm unarmed, I'm completely defenseless right now?"
"Hmm, want to spar? Right now — I'll give you three seconds to get ready before I have you pinned on that couch."

name: Love Like a Bouquet
description: Get by unlocking Vivian's Mindscape: "Vivian"
secondaryDescription:
A namecard featuring a private photo of Vivian.
"How should I describe you...? You are like the mist at midnight, the wind on a clear day, the shimmering light on water, like... everything I adore."
"I cherish this moment... because, right now, in your eyes, there is only me."

name: "Non-Business Card"
description: Get by unlocking Zhao's Mindscape: No Value Has Its Own Value
secondaryDescription:
A card featuring a personal photo of Zhao.
"Why... would you even want something like this? In terms of actual value, it's less useful than my employee ID..."
"A keepsake? Well... okay. As long as you like it. But you're not allowed to take it outside, alright?"
"Not even my coworkers have seen this photo."

name: Moment of Vulnerability
description: Get by unlocking Pulchra's Mindscape: Behind the Mask
secondaryDescription:
A card featuring a private photo of Pulchra.
"What, it's the first time you're seeing my nose? Ah, right. When we go to restaurants, I always lift my mask a little from the bottom to eat."
"Is a Thiren's nose moist like a real cat's? Why do you ask? Uhh... I suppose so. That's why wearing the mask helps keep my nose healthy."

name: The Bloom of Asphodels
description: Get by unlocking Trigger's Mindscape: Beyond the River of the Dead
secondaryDescription:
A card featuring a private photo of Trigger.
"Proxy, please come a little closer... close enough that you won't slip through my fingers."
"I want to remember the outline of the person who trusted me with their back... Is this selfish? If it is, then let me be a little selfish."

name: "Clarity of Mind"
description: Get by unlocking Yixuan's Mindscape: Swift Yet Still
secondaryDescription:
A namecard featuring a private photo of Yixuan.
"A mystic must safeguard a pure mind, free from distractions at all times."
"That should be simple enough for you... but if you don't yet know how, I'm happy to teach you."
"As your Shifu, tell me what you wish to learn, and I'll teach you without reservation."

name: Gelatin Silver Dance
description: Get by unlocking Soldier 0 - Anby's Mindscape: Prequel Protagonist
secondaryDescription:
A card with Soldier 0 - Anby's personal photo printed on it.
"Proxy, between a sequel and a prequel, which do you think has a higher chance of becoming a flop?"
"...I see. I'm curious as well... about the days before you became who you are today."

name: "Super Scary Big Tiger"
description: Get by unlocking Ju Fufu's Mindscape: Roar of My Inner Tiger
secondaryDescription:
"Speckled tails of clouds unfurl like ancient manuscripts, while blossoms of flame issue commands like a tiger-tally."
"Such majestic might it seems to shake down the moon atop the mountain, and an aura that would level caves beneath the earth."
—Composed by the awe-inspiring and caring Senior of Yunkui Summit.

name: Within Her Heterochromatic Gaze
description: Get by unlocking Alice's Mindscape: A Heart of Thyme
secondaryDescription:
A card printed with a personal photo of Alice.
"Hey... can you take a look at me? My asymmetrical eyes... do they look weird?"
"No? Then why did you instinctively look away...? Keep your eyes on me."
"I can see myself reflected in your pupils. So maybe if we keep making eye contact like this... I'll learn to feel okay about it."

name: Proof of Companionship
description: Get by unlocking Ukinami Yuzuha's Mindscape: Put Down Roots.
secondaryDescription:
A student ID card with Ukinami Yuzuha's name and photo. It was retired when the school upgraded to chip-based cards.
"Even though we've got new IDs, the school's pretty lax — most of us still use both. With this, you could walk right in like you're one of us. I've actually always wanted to see what it'd be like to be classmates for a day."

name: "Greater Hermit of the City"
description: Get by unlocking Pan Yinhu's Mindscape: Meridian Theory
secondaryDescription:
A card with Pan Yinhu's personal photo printed on it.
"Uh... did I just nod off? So all of that was just a dream..."
"...It's fine. I just dreamed I got legendary-grade cookware and used it to save the world."
"Besides, using the mystic arts to keep the peace here isn't really any different."

name: Another Self
description: Get by unlocking Ye Shunguang's Mindscape: Lantern Wish
secondaryDescription:
A namecard printed with one of Ye Shunguang's personal photos.
"On that bleak, lightless path, there was another version of 'me' at my side..."
"...But now, we're unified."
"'We' will treasure the memories of our past... and the memories of you."

name: The First Safehouse
description: Get by unlocking Komano Manato's Mindscape: Beyond Dreams of the Past
secondaryDescription:
A card with Komano Manato's personal photo printed on it.
"This safehouse was the first shelter I set up for myself when I was eight."
"Even though I used to say silly stuff like 'I don't need any friends,' somehow... I think I still believed I'd be sharing this place with someone one day."
"Looks like I've got some bandages left from before. Proxy, hold on, I'll patch this up real quick... ngh!"

name: The Story Continues
description: Get by unlocking Lucia's Mindscape: The Never-Ending Journey
secondaryDescription:
A card with Lucia's personal photo printed on it.
"Alright, sun's almost up, so that's it for tonight's Night Emissary lesson..."
"You want to know more, and what happens next?"
"Sure! Every night at midnight, second-floor windowsill of the Sixth Street video shop — be there or be square!"

name: Pale Blue Flower of Sorrow
description: Get by unlocking Seed's Mindscape: "Theory of the Heart"
secondaryDescription:
A card printed with a private photo of Seed.
"Guess the cockpit is still a bit too small for both of us... Stop squirming around, Proxy.
"Now I'm going to dim the lights... Keep your eyes closed until I say so!
"Okay... Proxy, promise me you won't freak out no matter what you see..."
"...Check out this bioluminescent flower — I found it in the Hollow, it's a brand-new species~ Let's come up with a name for it together~"

name: No Way Back
description: Get by unlocking Banyue's Mindscape: Descended Vidyaraja
secondaryDescription:
A card with Banyue's personal photo printed on it.
"Desire burns like fire, hatred cuts like a blade, and ignorance binds like chains..."
"I was once trapped by fate and doubt..."
"But now, nothing clouds my mind."

name: Meet With Me
description: Get by unlocking Dialyn's Mindscape: Truth
secondaryDescription:
A card with Dialyn's personal photo printed on it.
"Hearing your voice always lifts my mood more than anyone else's~"
"But instead of guessing your mood through the phone..."
"I'd rather see you in person, standing right here before me."

name: Teardrop Necklace
description: Get by unlocking Sunna's Mindscape: "Hollow Big Bang"
secondaryDescription:
A card with Sunna's personal photo printed on it.
"In the story, the girl's lone tear gave shape to the necklace and returned rain to the entire kingdom."
"So does that mean a crybaby like me... might be able to do something that amazing someday?"

name: Kingdom of Delusion
description: Get by unlocking Aria's Mindscape: Construct's Dream
secondaryDescription:
A card with Aria's personal photo printed on it.
"This song is dedicated to all of you! Every single Delulu!"
"If something's bothering you, maybe you could ask the great Wishing Sprite?"

name: Tear Gland Insurance
description: Get by unlocking Nangong Yu's Mindscape: An Angel's Delusion
secondaryDescription:
A card with Nangong Yu's personal photo printed on it.
It has a distinct texture and gives off the faintest spicy scent that leaves the tip of your nose feeling warm.
"When tears need permission, this is the only switch."
"The real me, saved just for you."

name: Couch Royalty
description: Get by unlocking Cissia's Mindscape: Home and Sixth Street
secondaryDescription:
A card with Cissia's personal photo printed on it.
Found wedged inside the couch cushions at the video store, with faint bite marks along the edge.
"This seat's taken. By one person only.
—Or I'll bite."

name: Hero Pose
description: Get by unlocking Starlight - Billy's Mindscape: Starlight Knight
secondaryDescription:
A card with Starlight - Billy's personal photo printed on it.
"Fight like a hero! Charge ahead like a hero!"
"And of course, strike an epic hero-worthy pose too~"

name: The Only Option
description: Get by unlocking Promeia's Mindscape: To Be Continued
secondaryDescription:
A card with Promeia's personal photo printed on it.
The face in the photo seems somewhat unnatural, with a faint hint of red hidden beneath the gray-blue tones.
"It was just a photo for leave approval."
"I didn't end up using it, so you can have it."

name: Beyond Etiquette
description: Get by unlocking Velina's Mindscape: Chief Angel
secondaryDescription:
A card with Velina's personal photo printed on it.
"Your once-in-a-lifetime request was simply for this photograph? You needn't have gone to so much trouble. It's my pleasure."
"Then, it seems I'll have to reluctantly postpone my chance to earn a favor from the legendary Proxy Phaethon."
"Another picture? Certainly... no professional smile, you say? Hmm, noted."

name: En-Nah Time
description: Get by unlocking Norma's Mindscape: The Primary Cause of Genius
secondaryDescription:
A card with Norma's personal photo printed on it.
"People are way harder to deal with than Bangboo, aren't they?"
"That's why, every now and then, I'd like us to enjoy some simple and genuine moments together, just like Bangboo do."

name: Dynamic Wallpaper: Bangboo Angler Club
description: Dynamic wallpaper that can be displayed or changed in the main menu.
secondaryDescription: This dynamic wallpaper captures Bangboo enjoying their leisure time at Port Elpis. A soothing visual that brings you a peaceful moment during a busy day.

name: Dynamic Wallpaper: Round and Roll Assembly
description: Dynamic wallpaper that can be displayed or changed in the main menu.
secondaryDescription:
"En-nah enne! (Aim, strike — gotcha!)"
"En-ne, enen-nah! (...Dummy... Can't catch me!)"
This dynamic wallpaper captures the image of Bangboo playfully undergoing training on a sunny day.

name: Dynamic Wallpaper: Delusions in Progress
description: Dynamic wallpaper that can be displayed or changed in the main menu.
secondaryDescription:
"Just add one more syllable at the end, finish it off with a harmony, and that should do it..."
"Whoa... Then I gotta try singing it first! Starting from this note right here—"
"Nangong, c-cut it out with Sunna already... Her heart rate just shot way up!"

name: Bangboo Diet Plan
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: "Wait, wait! That's the wrong way! Come back!" Captured during a delivery with a Hollow Raider. Seeing Bangboo trying so hard to run backwards on the conveyor belt was too cute, so I forgot to help.

name: BOOM!
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: A commemorative photo taken while experimenting with explosives in a Hollow. A real, seasoned Hollow Raider doesn't look back at the explosion.

name: Please don't answer...
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: There's two things in life one should miss: love ending in regrets and a phone ringing unexpectedly on a street at midnight.

name: Pet "Tumtum"
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: A close-up photo of the cat "Tumtum." You can't help but utter "Let me pet you! C'mon, let me pet you!" upon seeing it.

name: PhotoName_3600005
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
