description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription:
A picture taken with {NPC_103174203}. {M#Belle}{F#Wise} helped to take the photo.
It's a precious image taken shortly after adopting {NPC_103174203}. Her eyes look so clear and full of wisdom. Looking at the picture makes you want to rub it.
Gazing at this picture satisfies you when you can't pet {NPC_103174203}.

name: "The perfect chance! Bam!"
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: Captured by the Bangboo Alliance. This is the decisive moment as they launched the final strike against the reigning champion.

name: Which one of us is more handsome?
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: Before being ordered to move the signboard, Gerant asked General Chop to take a commemorative photo. Honestly... it looks better than the real one.

name: "First Time on Stage"
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: A photo of the famous Twin Dancers taken during their ballet training. Though the picture is a little blurry with how much time has passed, that elegance and beauty still remain.

name: "Terrifying!"
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: A fan-exclusive photo of streamer Archie. It features her iconic live reaction: "Terrifying!"

name: A Corner of the Banquet
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: A photograph taken by Big Daddy captures the lively feast inside the Cheesetopia diner. Within just a few days, this once-abandoned establishment has been revitalized, and it looks like Blazewood will become even more bustling in the future.

name: Special Feast
description: A precious commemorative photo that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
secondaryDescription:
Is Victoria Housekeeping also interested in sandwiches?
Though... "using simple ingredients and simple methods to create something delicious" is probably something that people would expect of maids.

name: Unforgettable Tonight
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription:
On Gilded Carrot Day, you had hoped to take a photo with everyone, but you never managed to catch everyone together at the same time.
Later that night, when you got home, Fairy quietly lit up the screen and pulled up a whole folder of photos "borrowed" from Lumina Square surveillance system. You selected the one with the most people and printed it...
Thanks, Fairy! Genuinely appreciate it this time.

name: Phantom of the Lost Lands
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription:
The Puppeteer of the Lost Void has finally revealed its true form — but whether it truly possesses the intelligence to control Ethereals, or is a product of an experiment or someone's hidden schemes... everything remains inconclusive.
The Hollows never have an obligation to be honest.

name: Cherished Flowers
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription:
The reason for cherishing a flower might lie in its delicate shape and fragrant scent, the intention of the giver, or one's mood during its appreciation...
But it could also simply be because it's extremely expensive.

name: A Summer Night's Moment
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: A moment captured by Therese's camera after the Fantasy Music Festival. Old friends, new companions, and most importantly, family... Though the summer night may pass, our smiles will forever be frozen in this most beautiful summer memory.

name: Cheers!
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: A snapshot Blaze caught on her phone of everyone clinking glasses on the day the Simmer hot pot restaurant reopened. There are a million flavors in Ridu, yet nothing beats hot pot with your ride-or-dies.

name: Yesterday Once More
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: You happened to catch a glimpse of this photo and said "cute" — next thing you knew, Norma was so pleased with herself that she printed a copy for you too. This is the first photo of Norma and Victor together, snapped by Velina on a whim. When this photo was taken, Norma asked Velina: why do we always meet new friends, only to say goodbye to them? You asked Velina how she answered back then, but she turned the question right back around on you. So, if it were you answering — you might tell young Norma: that's not goodbye. It's a new beginning. Because everyone here is something special, deserving of an even brighter future. That's exactly why you can send each other off to new tomorrows with full hearts and nothing but hope.

name: A Commemoration for Tomorrow
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription:
A group photo from Victor's retirement party — Norma got a print made for you to keep as a memento.
If tomorrow is destined to bring farewells, at least we have memories to give us courage.
If memories are destined to fade, at least we have photographs to keep them alive.

name: Wildness' Blessing
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: The Sunflint was woven and painted by several members of the Sons of Calydon. Although the craftsmanship is not complicated, it must have taken a lot of time to make it. The legend speaks of a hero who was saved from a sea of flames by divine protection... If such a space that defies natural laws truly harbors a deity, would it be an enemy to mankind, a friend, or merely a cold, detached observer of the world?

name: Thorns and Stamen
description: A memorable moment worth commemorating. Can be used to decorate your room.
secondaryDescription: After resolving the crisis in the Converging Lands, Orchidea sent a thank-you gift. Delicate flower stamens and stubborn thorns convey a friendship from the wild; beneath the seamless "Silent Riddle" lies a thrilling adventure.

name: En-Nah Rising Star Medal
description: A special souvenir that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
secondaryDescription:
Coach Aster was so impressed and delighted by its assistant coach's work that it applied for a medal from the training department of the company... Unfortunately, the application was rejected, so it made this medal by itself.
It's pretty sweet token of friendship, don't you think?

name: The Dream Endures
description: A precious commemorative photo that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
secondaryDescription:
A group photo shared by Belle in the group chat, taken when everyone gathered at the video store before the get-together. Aside from nearly flaking out herself, it's definitely just as beautiful as in the dream.

*Note: You can always trust the best AI assistant in New Eridu.

name: Cash In
description: A precious commemorative photo that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
secondaryDescription: On a quiet night, a secret showdown was unfolding on Reef Island near the Torchlit Lighthouse. The long-dormant submarine had finally resurfaced, and it might just be the most valuable catch of a lifetime for everyone involved.

name: Damaged Data Card
description: A special souvenir that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
secondaryDescription:
Ray's experimental Data Card. The data inside has been damaged, and seems to have only symbolic meaning now.
"Don't worry, it only contains some corrupted files."
"Take it away from the outpost and toss it somewhere far... the farther, the better."

name: Star Bracelet
description: A special souvenir that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
secondaryDescription: A bracelet handmade by Venus — that alone makes it worth treasuring.

name: PhotoName_3651013
description: A special souvenir that can be displayed on the Memory Board.
secondaryDescription: PhotoDesc_3651013

secondaryDescription: PhotoName_3690003

name: Carffiti Mark·「Final Curtain」
description: Used for taking photos. Redeem in the "Association Supplies - Special Display Cabinet" Store.

name: Fries Lamp
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: "Would you like small, medium, or large fries? Our special event offers extra-large glowing fries — perfect for sharing with your BFFs!"

name: "Waiting to Melt"
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Some people interpret this black Bangboo as "We will eventually melt amidst endless Ether Corruption."
But others think the designer was just trying to remind people not to put these figures near too much heat.

name: "Waiting to Weather"
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Some people interpret this gray Bangboo as "The changes we make to the world will eventually weather away."
But others think the designer was just trying to remind people not to put these figures out in the open.

name: Greta's Lover
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
It is created based on the video footage preserved by Greta of "Mr. White."
It's not just an unfinished building with questionable construction quality, but also the lover of the tunnel boring machine — although it... or rather, the building, remains silent on the matter.

name: Sān-Z Beats: Drumbeat
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
This figure is based on the drummer of the band that designer Yi works with, who is also one of the spokesboo of the Bangboo clothing brand under Sān-Z STUDIO.
Due to limitations in the instrument size, it always needs an extra amplifier during performances, compared to human drummers.

name: Sān-Z Beats: Stretto
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Based on the record knight of the band that designer Yi works with and one of the spokesboos of the Bangboo clothing brand under Sān-Z STUDIO.
It can only manage to get into the dinosaur performance costume that Yi designed with the help of the drummer and bass player.

name: Sān-Z Beats: Hum
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
This figure is based on the bassist of the band that designer Yi works with, who is also one of the spokesboo of the Bangboo clothing brand under Sān-Z STUDIO.
The mustache was stuck on afterward as it's rather shy and doesn't want to be recognized.

name: A Corner of the Sand Table
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
To command your small Bangboo against the vicious Ethereals, you must first master tactical preparation! The sand table left by Coach Aster's friend will be crucial to your strategy.
And if the esteemed battle instructor needs a keepsake... taking a piece of the "fierce battle" from the table would surely be forgivable.

name: "4WD - Crimson Comet"
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Nitrogen Brothers/Bangboo 4WD/Racing Series

"The crimson meteor you saw on the track that day? Just the trail of my taillights left across your windshield."

name: "4WD - Street Legend"
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Nitrogen Brothers/Bangboo 4WD/Racing Series

"I'm not a racer, just a delivery guy forced into this by a greedy tofu shop owner."

name: "4WD - Wasteland Knight"
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Nitrogen Brothers/Bangboo 4WD/Off-Road Series

"Whether crushing opponents or gravel, it's the same steady rhythm — this is the spirit of a knight of the wild."

name: "Waiting to Dial"
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Some interpret this payphone-shaped Bangboo as a statement: "Our true selves are destined to dissolve into the signals of communications and media."
Others think the designer just really loves long phone calls.

name: Heartfelt Wish
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
"May your dreams come true, may everything go your way" — even the most impossible wishes are whispered countless times during the New Year.
...Perhaps, they aren't truly "impossible"? After all, wishes are just prophecies of the future, aren't they, Eous?

name: Radiant Gold
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
In my dream, I became a king with a golden touch, gaining infinite wealth and exchanging it for boundless happiness... until the day my hand touched Eous!
...Wait, stop. Let's be honest — this is clearly just a recolored version of the custom Eous souvenir from before. How much extra did you spend...? This can't possibly be real gold, right?!

name: Knight Errant's Helm
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: A personally given certification from the "Knight Errant Quixie"! Wearing this means you're a qualified knight! But... who could possibly wear such a tiny helmet?

name: 0WD - Frostedge
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Nitrogen Brothers / Bangboo Specialty Vehicle / Snowfield Series
"They say the human eye can only capture up to 60 frames per second, but for me, a single blink is all it takes to vanish into the endless snowfields."

name: 1WD - City Hunter
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Nitrogen Brothers / Bangboo Motorbike / City Series
"Drifting, weaving, overtaking. What you see as the ultimate challenge is just another day in my life."

name: Flash Yum Plate
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: The limited edition dining plate from Crispy Delights is inspired by Crispyboo's warm and welcoming hospitality. They say any dish served on this plate will sparkle and shine, but upon closer inspection... isn't that glow just coming from the built-in lights under the plate holder?

name: Sweet Summer Days
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Bangboo Garden Kingdom: Sweet Summer Days
A new design series launched by Sān-Z STUDIO, with design inspiration drawn from everyday fruits and vegetables.
The combination of Boonapple, Watermel-en, and Booboonut sparks imagination - memories of summer days are always filled with the sweetness of seasonal fruits.

name: Health Plan
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Bangboo Garden Kingdom: Health Plan
A new design series launched by Sān-Z STUDIO, with design inspiration drawn from everyday fruits and vegetables.
The combination of Boorocoli, Boomato, and Corn Cobboo makes you think - besides healthy eating, have you worked out today?

name: The Veggie Squad
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
Bangboo Garden Kingdom: The Veggie Squad
A new design series launched by Sān-Z STUDIO, with design inspiration drawn from everyday fruits and vegetables.
The combination of Cabbooge, Auboogine, and Boonip reminds us to reflect on ourselves - a balanced diet needs vegetables every day.

name: The Way of Fine Porcelain: Prosper Together
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
According to the designer, he didn't create this Bangboo, but rather discovered its form within the mineral materials.
It sits there with eyes closed, serving both as an incense burner and a lucky charm, born from a persistent chant—
"Little Bangboo, little Bangboo, help me prosper quick!"

name: On the Ridu Table: En O'Clock (Midnight Black)
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: Is there anything more blissful than being woken up by little Bangboo's "ehn-na-ehn-na", reaching out to turn it off by its tiny ears, and then drifting back to a sweet dream surrounded by Bangboo?

name: On the Ridu Table: Boo-rick Phone (Ebony Black)
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: When the call connects, don't be surprised if you hear "ehn-na-ehn-na" from the other end — that's just the dial tone for the Bangboo Kingdom.

name: On the Ridu Table: En O'Clock (Daylight Orange)
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: Is there anything more blissful than being woken up by little Bangboo's "ehn-na-ehn-na", reaching out to turn it off by its tiny ears, and then drifting back to a sweet dream surrounded by Bangboo?

name: On the Ridu Table: Boo-rick Phone (Ivory White)
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: When the call connects, don't be surprised if you hear "ehn-na-ehn-na" from the other end — that's just the dial tone for the Bangboo Kingdom.

description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: A collab ornament from the Simmer hot pot shop! Carbonated Nitro-Fuel gives you extra punch!

name: Hot Pot Party: Crispy Pan-Fried Dumplings
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: A collab ornament from the Simmer hot pot shop. Got dumplings on my head and scallions on my face~

name: Hot Pot Party: Cream Pudding
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription: A collab ornament from the Simmer hotpot shop. The spicy hotpot gets you sizzlin' and hissin', while the creamy pudding cools you down!

name: Model: Frostfall Sickle
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
A limited-edition toy crafted to mimic a W-Engine.

Clutching a wavering ideal.
Running and shouting across the barren red earth, then falling into sleep, only to wake up grown.
Choosing chains of one's own making.
Living on as a blade, scraping by. Investigating, interrogating, hunting... endless, numb, cold.
Waiting for the promised judgment.
Plucking a rotting new bud and stepping into winter, until at last welcoming life's final hope... death, warm and peaceful.

name: Street Tales: Fish Through the Market
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
A Bangboo came up to ask for directions, its silence deafening.
"En-nah? (Excuse me, how do I get to Lumina Square?)"
"En-nah-nah!? (How did you know I caught a big fish today!?)"

name: Model: Starlight Rider Faceplate
description: A unique and interesting collectible that can be displayed in your room.
secondaryDescription:
A limited-edition toy crafted to mimic a W-Engine.

What is a knight?
The crimson knight says, "Carrying out the justice in my heart!" The amber knight says, "Dealing with each sin in this world!" The verdant knight says, "Protecting everyone's hope!"
So what is a knight, in the end? The advanced tactical construct suddenly falls into serious thought over this profound question, no different from the philosophers who have long pondered the ultimate meaning of existence.
Regrettably, this great and noble meditation on chivalric aesthetics is cut short in under ten seconds by an unceremonious interruption from a companion.
"Billy, you've watched 'Starlight Knight: A Knight's Proof' a hundred times already. So what even is the proof?"
"I'll know when I've watched it another hundred times!"
—At the Cunning Hares' place, two people arguing over the remote.

name: Letter From Xiao'Guang
description: Ye Shunguang had left some old belongings in Failume Heights, but thankfully with your help, they were all recovered. To show gratitude, Xiao'Guang left you a letter explaining the origins of these items — it seems he has something special he wants to tell you...
secondaryDescription: Attached to the letter was a delicate feather, a group photo of the Yunkui Summit folks, a broken peace knot, a heavily revised recipe, a handwritten guide for Yunkui Summit newcomers, and a burnt-out floating lantern... These old items carry Xiao'Guang's cherished memories of Yunkui Summit, and she hopes you can keep them safe for her.

name: Golden Belt of Boo-gress
description: Can be used to raise the Group Training level of Collaboorators.
secondaryDescription:
A progress certificate awarded by Norma to hardworking Collaboorators training in the data space. Is effective at raising Group Training level.
"How's training feeling?"
"En-nah-en-nah! (Feeling like the next training session is gonna be a total walk in the park!)"

name: Genius's Experimental Special
description: A special item used to reconstruct Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 basic quality module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber drink made exclusively for Collaboorators, made from Norma's attempt at "brewing" through code.
"That whole thing about glitches in the code is just a joke. Who in the dataspace wouldn't want to get their hands on Norma's special mix?"

name: Genius's Inspirational Special
description: A special item used to reconstruct Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 advanced quality module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber drink made exclusively for Collaboorators, carefully "brewed" by Norma through code.
"Enneh enna! (You're right, but this is Norma's signature special blend. It updates premium mods, boosts traits, and helps Collaboorators rise to the top!)"

name: Genius's Perfect Special
description: A special item used to reconstruct Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 superior quality module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber drink made exclusively for Collaboorators, "mixed" by Norma with every last line of code she had.
"Ehn-na! Ehn-na! (Legend has it that only those who savor the most perfect cyber drink in data space won't get blasted by the Central Computing Hub's lasers!)"

name: Boo to the Rescue - Style A
description: Can be used to load a random Collaboorator in the load terminal's Rally Protocol
secondaryDescription:
Norma specially designed the "Collaboorator" data loading code, which can download partial Bangboo data from the Marcel Group as a "Collaboorator" to enter a volunteer Bangboo's data space and boost its computing power.
"Ehn-na? Ehn-na? Ehn-na! (Overtime? But I'm just a piece of data... Wait, I'll do overtime — just don't delete me!)"

name: Boo to the Rescue - Style B
description: Can be used to load a random Collaboorator in the load terminal's Expansion Protocol
secondaryDescription:
Norma specially designed the "Collaboorator" data loading code, which can download partial Bangboo data from the Marcel Group as a "Collaboorator" to enter a volunteer Bangboo's data space and boost its computing power.
"Ehn-na? Ehn-na... En-nah-nah! (Even as a data model, I still get to work? Th—This is absolutely amazing!)"

name: Boo to the Rescue - Style C
description: Can be used to load a random Collaboorator in the load terminal's Final Protocol
secondaryDescription:
Norma specially designed the "Collaboorator" data loading code, which can download partial Bangboo data from the Marcel Group as a "Collaboorator" to enter a volunteer Bangboo's data space and boost its computing power.
"Ehn-ne! Ehn-ne... ehn-ne-nhe! (A request... A request just came in! Oh, good thing I'm a data model, wait... Doesn't that actually make me better suited for the job?)"

name: "Best Booddy" Medal
description: Reward certificate obtained by completing Data Domain Training stages.
secondaryDescription:
Norma presented a shiny virtual medal to the "Collaboorator" who pushed through rigorous training in the data space, praising them for defeating countless code errors, boosting computing capacity, and making remarkable contributions to repairing the Central Computing Hub!
"En-nha na!（Thanks, everyone! I'm gonna become the greatest Collaboorator!）"

name: Genius's Experimental Special - Attack
description: A special item used to reconstruct Attack Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 basic quality attack module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, casually "blended" by Norma using code.
"Training failed? No sweat! Down Norma's special brew and when the system updates, you'll still be the world's #1 Collaboorator!"

name: Genius's Inspirational Special - Attack
description: A special item used to reconstruct Attack Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 advanced quality attack module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, meticulously "blended" by Norma using code.
When a Collaboorator downs an attack-type inspiration special, this is what happens:
"Ehn-ne! (Never had such a rockin' start to training!)"

name: Genius's Perfect Special - Attack
description: A special item used to reconstruct Attack Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 superior quality attack module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, painstakingly "blended" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-ne? (If I drink this, will I get a mod that boosts ATK?)"
(After a few sips...)
"Ehn-ne! Ehn-ne? Ehn-ne-ne! (That's disgusting! Who made this? Norma? Still disgusting!)"

name: Genius's Experimental Special - Defense
description: A special item used to reconstruct Defense Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 basic quality defense module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, casually "blended" by Norma using code.
"En-nah en-nah! (Nothing can make me cry anymore, I'm a tough Bangboo!)" "But can Bangboo even cry?" "En-nah-en-nah... (Waaah, I can't even cry?)"

name: Genius's Inspirational Special - Defense
description: A special item used to reconstruct Defense Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 advanced quality defense module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, meticulously "blended" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-na! Ehn-na? (After drinking this, I feel like my shoulders really got broader! Wait, do I even have shoulders?)"

name: Genius's Perfect Special - Defense
description: A special item used to reconstruct Defense Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 superior quality defense module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, painstakingly "blended" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-na? (If I drink this, will I get totally ripped?)"
(After a taste test session...)
"Ehn-na! (Norma, I can take on ten of 'em!)"

name: Genius's Experimental Special - Support
description: A special item used to reconstruct Support Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 basic quality support module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, meticulously "blended" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-ne! Ehn-ne-ne! (I'm here to help! After all, this is our blood-pumping combo move!)" —Bold words from a Collaboorator after downing the drink in one gulp.

name: Genius's Inspirational Special - Support
description: A special item used to reconstruct Support Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 advanced quality support module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, meticulously "mixed" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-ne-ehn-ne? (Is this what a true support master looks like?!)" — A certain Collaboorator who sampled the drink immediately leaned back in awe.

name: Genius's Perfect Special - Support
description: A special item used to reconstruct Support Bangboo Modules. Can refresh 1 superior quality support module for a Collaboorator.
secondaryDescription:
A cyber beverage exclusively for Collaboorators, painstakingly "mixed" by Norma using code.
"Ehn-na? (If I drink this, I can protect all my friends?)"
(After some tasting...)
"Ehn-nah? Ehn-nah! (Protect all my friends? All I need to do is taking out every enemy!)"

description:
Nineveh's DMG <color=#CF4029>increases by 40%</color> and she <color=#CF4029>summons Hornets more frequently</color>.

name: Bamboo Ink Whispers
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: It's cute, but why do I hear birds calling overhead?

name: Azure Crane
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription:
The streets filled with warmth, through spring and autumn together under the roof.
Failume Heights community welcomes you.

name: Jade & Scarlet Knots
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription:
Twin emerald hoops, a scarlet thread entwines our bond.
Twin practitioners of the craft, united in spirit.

name: Scarlet Blossom Ears
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Soft fox ears, adorned with blooming flowers. I'll be able to pass as a Thiren from now on!

name: Lemme See
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Look in my eyes! Put it on, and you'll instantly become a fortune-telling master.

name: Leisurely Summer
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: The sea unfurls as it pleases, the foamy waves rippling in the wind. This must be what a relaxed life without worrying about electricity bills feels like.

name: Azure Spiral
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: As for the ocean, why not ask the magical seashell on my collar?

name: Tangerine & Emerald
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: The dynamic back straps, once fastened, give the illusion of +1 agility.

name: Zest Against the Tide
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: What should I do? I feel like I actually want to exercise after putting it on. Does this design have some kind of hypnotic effect?

name: Emerald Flame Lock
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: The zipper can't hold back... a Proxy's inner desire to lead the trend.

name: Waifei Wonder Shades
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: As a Proxy, wearing photochromic glasses is perfectly reasonable and logical...

name: Black Cat's Night Hunt
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: One stroke of green steadies a thousand sails, while the black cat dispels a hundred evils.

name: Sunken Waves
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: The Porcelume surface is dusted with blue floral patterns, and golden waves exude a graceful charm.

name: Mountain Crane Seal
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: A crane dwells in the mountains, a serpent in the seas. Shielded by mountain and sea, my mystic arts reigns supreme.

name: Golden Wings Breeze
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Wearing the golden feathers, I feel like I can confidently charge higher prices for future orders.

name: Homebound Frosthelm
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: I'm daydreaming again. Once I put on this hat, I feel like part of the upper echelons of New Eridu, and I don't have to pay for electricity...

name: Blazing Charm of Evil Suppression
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Gather the radiant energy of the sun to ward off spirits and vanquish fiends.

name: Resplendent Sunglasses
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: With eyes that pierce like flame, one beholds the extraordinary; a heart blazing on the right path can scorch the remnants of chaos.

name: Angels of Doglusion
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Braving wind and rain, thinking of Nangong Yu day and night!

name: Scarlet Snowglow
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: A white hat pure as snow, red threads like flames, a gleaming silver buckle, and effortlessly flowing mystic power.

name: Inkdance Blossom
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Never touch Senior Sister's tail; one touch and an angel becomes a devil.

name: Emberfire Serenity
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Crimson flames condense into sigils at your side, whirling swordlight keeps calamity at bay.

name: Split-Broth Mini Hot Pot
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Don't listen to my sister — spicy hot pot makes you run hot. A split pot is way healthier.

name: Shroomy Wealth
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: I heard the Waifei locals think mushrooms bring in wealth because their round shape looks like coins... so what if I wore one on my head?

name: Scrutinizing Expenses
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: If I didn't have a household and a business to run, I wouldn't bother being this frugal.

name: Prosperity Comes
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Pin a cabbage to the chest, and wealth will follow.

name: Happy Neigh Year
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Wishing you peace and prosperity in the Neigh Year! (Speaking of, how am I meant to see in this...)

name: Delulu Emblem
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Beneath the emblem lies my heart, that pounds fiercely for the angels.

name: Angelic Voice
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: The angels' voices are going to blow the whole stage wide open. And all you doubters can just... kneel before them!

name: Heed the Starwish
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Listen! This is the sound that will pull you into endless delusion!

name: Heartbeat Rhythm
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Learning to pick up the signals from your heart... sometimes thrilling, sometimes a tiny bit annoying~

name: Angel Hotline
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: A cheering heart in flight, tuning the soul to the signal that links it to angels.

name: The Crane Calls Home
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: The Cloud Crane soaring through the Nine Heavens keeps its resolve, and Suibian Temple... um... what was it... Suibian Temple is where the mind evolves!

name: Windguide Talismans
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Demons and monsters, Ethereals of the Hollows. With spiritual talismans, victory surely follows.

secondaryDescription: Time sways softly with every step. Don't forget the quiet murmurs of those long afternoons.

description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Put on your academy badge and begin your school days!

name: Theorem of Laziness
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Wearing a bow tie doesn't mean the day has to be hectic.

name: Fairwind Knot
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Legend says in ages past and ages yet to come, little knots could safeguard travelers as they passed through the storm-wracked seas.

name: Bangboo-tiful Collaboorator
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription:
An amazing headpiece hand-sewn by the little Bangboo to show their gratitude. It's the ultimate symbol of earning Bangboo approval and becoming a true friend of Bangboo. <color=#FFAF2C>Wearing it</color> will let you head into <color=#FFAF2C>Spotlight Theater</color>~

"...Do I really look like a Bangboo right now?"
"En-nha, nhe! (From afar you do. Up close though, just Bangboo-like!)"

name: Farsight Philosophy
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: As the saying goes, the higher you stand, the farther you see. But looking down from Roscaelifer... that's REALLY, REALLY high! Aren't people scared of heights up here?!

name: Mr. Beard
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: You're allowed to wear earrings at school? Aurelia Academy's dress code is surprisingly relaxed... Oh, and could I have a back-row window seat?

name: Grace in Motion
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: The academy's taste in clothing is as dependable as always... Hold on, this bow tie looks like it belongs to Belle?

name: Sir Panda
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Anyone who loves Bangboo can't say no to Sir Panda.

name: Golden Echoes Player
description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: A portable player made by Golden Echoes Records, whose name and song choices are so good they make you wish you'd found it sooner.

description: A Proxy accessory that can be worn with some of Wise's Proxy outfits.
secondaryDescription: Who exactly decided that Roscaelifer citizens have to start preparing for afternoon tea the moment it hits 3 PM?
